Nurse

Stellenbeschreibung:
Job Title: Nurse

International SOS is the world’s leading medical and security services company with over 12,000 employees working in 1,000 locations in 90 countries. International SOS Government Services administers the TRICARE Overseas Program providing high-quality, accessible health care services for U.S. Military service members, family members, retirees, and other eligible beneficiaries overseas.

About the role

- Perhaps you live abroad and would like to return to Poland?
- Do you have a Polish nursing license?
- Looking to apply your experience in a new environment?
- Is it time to move away from the demands of clinical care in a hospital environment?
- Do you speak Polish and English?

We are looking for a Nurse (known internally as a Near Patient Nurse) based in Poznan or within proximity, to support our global patient care program, TRICARE. You will be responsible for providing medical case management for patients, visiting them at healthcare provider sites, writing medical reports and providing medical updates.

This is a fantastic opportunity for nurses to move away from the demands of a clinical environment to an on-site case manager role using their medical expertise.

Key responsibilities

- The nurse would provide comprehensive in-patient clinical case management
- Develop and maintain effective relationships with providers, (medical and administrative) internal and external stakeholders and suppliers to ensure excellent delivery of service
- Regularly visit or contact the care providers (civilian and military treatment facility centers) to obtain updates for medical cases
- Liaise with patients to obtain detailed clinical information including past medical history to allow for accurate on-going case management
- Support the medical collection team in obtaining the discharge summary and medical records from the care provider

About you

- Registered General Nurse or equivalent with minimum 3 years of experience with registration to practice in Poland
- Recognized qualification to minimum diploma level or equivalence in practice demonstrated through portfolio/CV
- A demonstrable commitment to professional development
- Able to communicate Polish and proficiently in English
- Own a car and have a clean license
- Passionate about international healthcare

Benefits

- 15,900 PLN car allowance per annum
- 2,400 PLN home allowance per annum
- Structured career development track, with opportunities for progression and advancement
- Warm, supportive, and open company culture
- An opportunity to thrive in a global environment
- We celebrate diversity on a global scale and encourage every colleague to bring their personal best by creating an environment of inclusion and equal support

At International SOS, we offer a great working environment, thanks to our commitment to flexible working, diversity, and development.  We encourage every person to be their personal best by creating an environment of inclusion, equality and support.

jobs.title: AI Manager (m/w/d) (KI-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Willst du KI in echten geschäftlichen Mehrwert für die DLG verwandeln? Als **AI Manager (m/w/d)** spielst du eine zentrale Rolle in der Group IT. Du bist dafür verantwortlich, die KI‑Strategie der DLG weiterzuentwickeln und umzusetzen – in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den verschiedenen Geschäftsbereichen. In dieser Rolle treibst du nicht nur die Richtung und Umsetzung von KI‑Initiativen voran, sondern baust auch ein Team von KI‑Spezialist*innen auf und führst es. Du schaffst die Grundlage dafür, wie wir KI‑Lösungen entwickeln, skalieren und im gesamten Unternehmen betreiben.

Über das Unternehmen

Die DLG-Gruppe zählt zu den führenden Genossenschaften Europas in den Bereichen Lebensmittel, Energie und Baustoffe. Unser Auftrag ist es, langfristigen Mehrwert für unsere landwirtschaftlichen Eigentümer und für die Gesellschaft zu schaffen – durch verlässliche Produkte, innovative Lösungen und nachhaltiges Wachstum in all unseren Geschäftsbereichen. Mit rund 7.000 Mitarbeitenden in 18 Ländern und auf Basis unserer genossenschaftlichen Struktur gestalten wir unsere Zukunft durch gemeinsame Werte, nachhaltige Ziele und den festen Glauben an die Kraft der Zusammenarbeit.

Die team SE mit Sitz in Flensburg ist ein wesentlicher Bestandteil der DLG-Gruppe. Unsere zentralen Unternehmensfunktionen sind standortübergreifend zwischen Flensburg und dem DLG-Hauptsitz in Fredericia organisiert. Gemeinsam unterstützen wir die Geschäftsbereiche über Ländergrenzen hinweg und tragen zu einer effizienten, integrierten und zukunftsfähigen Organisation bei, die Skaleneffekte und Synergien optimal nutzt.

Aufgaben

Du prägst die KI‑Ausrichtung der DLG und leitest ein Team, das wirkungsvolle, geschäftsorientierte Lösungen liefert. Konkret bedeutet das:

- Du definierst und verantwortest die KI‑Roadmap sowie das Use‑Case‑Portfolio über alle Geschäftsbereiche hinweg.
- Du baust ein Team von KI‑Spezialist*innen auf, führst und entwickelst es weiter.
- Du übersetzt fachliche Anforderungen in skalierbare und wirkungsvolle KI‑Lösungen.
- Du steuerst das Solution Design – von der Idee über Architekturentscheidungen bis zur Implementierung.
- Du etablierst Standards für Daten, Integrationen, Sicherheit, Skalierbarkeit und Responsible AI.
- Du arbeitest eng mit technischen Teams, externen Partnern und Dienstleistern zusammen, um Fortschritt und Qualität sicherzustellen.
- Du unterstützt Build-or-Buy‑Entscheidungen und sorgst für die Abstimmung mit den Enterprise‑Plattformen.

Profil

Du bist eine erfahrene **Führungskraft (m/w/d)** mit einer starken technischen Basis und einer Leidenschaft dafür, sowohl Menschen als auch Lösungen weiterzuentwickeln. Du arbeitest strukturiert und pragmatisch und erzielst Ergebnisse sowohl durch dein Team als auch durch deine eigene Expertise. Du bewegst dich sicher zwischen Business und IT und weißt, wie man Richtung, Alignment und Momentum in einem komplexen Stakeholder‑Umfeld schafft.

Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, solltest du:

- nachweisliche Erfahrung in der Führung und Entwicklung von Teams im Bereich KI, Daten oder Advanced Analytics mitbringen
- ein tiefes Verständnis für Solution Architecture und komplexe IT‑Landschaften haben
- Erfahrung darin haben, KI‑ oder Dateninitiativen von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung zu treiben
- in der Lage sein, geschäftliche Prioritäten mit technologischen Möglichkeiten zu verbinden
- Erfahrung mit Governance, Priorisierung und funktionsübergreifenden Entscheidungen haben
- eine starke Führungspersönlichkeit sein, die motiviert, coacht und Engagement schafft
- strukturiert und ergebnisorientiert arbeiten
- klar kommunizieren und komplexe Themen verständlich machen
- sicher in Deutsch und Englisch kommunizieren

Unser Angebot

Bei DLG erwartet dich eine spannende und wirkungsvolle Rolle in einem Unternehmen, in dem KI und Digitalisierung ganz oben auf der Agenda stehen.

Du kannst dich freuen auf:

- eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Gestaltung der KI‑Ausrichtung eines internationalen Unternehmens
- die Möglichkeit, eine neue KI‑Funktion innerhalb der DLG aufzubauen und zu führen
- ein hohes Maß an Verantwortung und Einfluss
- ein starkes professionelles Umfeld in IT, Daten und Digitalisierung
- persönliche und fachliche Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten
- flexible Arbeitsbedingungen und eine gesunde Work‑Life‑Balance

Kontakt

Wir freuen uns über deine Bewerbung im PDF-Format über unser Bewerbungsportal unter Angabe deiner Gehaltsvorstellung und des frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins.

jobs.title: DX Head of Quality Management & Regulatory Affairs, EMEA (f/m/d) (Leiter/in - Qualitätsmanagement)
jobs.description:
Location: MAR EB
Department: SHS DX QT-LS
Mode of Employment: Permanent / Full-time
Job Grade: Germany - Non Senior Management - PL4 - Position Level 4

Do you want to help create the future of healthcare? Our name, Siemens Healthineers, was selected to honor our people who dedicate their energy and passion to this cause. It reflects their pioneering spirit combined with our long history of engineering in the ever-evolving healthcare industry.
We offer you a flexible and dynamic environment with opportunities to go beyond your comfort zone in order to grow personally and professionally. Sounds interesting?

Then come and join our team as DX Head of Quality Management & Regulatory Affairs, EMEA (f/m/d), to lead the Quality Management & Regulatory Affairs function across the EMEA region, ensuring compliance, product safety, and operational excellence across commercial operations and customer services.

You will drive and execute regional quality and regulatory strategies, translating requirements into practical business actions that enable market access, customer satisfaction, and sustainable growth.

You will serve as the Quality Representative for assigned legal entities and champion a pragmatic, risk-based approach that balances regulatory compliance with business objectives.

This position can be located at the following locations:

- Marburg (Germany)- Milan (Italy)- Madrid (Spain).

Your tasks and responsibilities:
Quality Management & Continuous Improvement

- Maintain and continuously improve the Quality Management System (QMS) to meet regulatory and business requirements.- Ensure effective execution of Quality Assurance and Quality Engineering processes (e.g., audits, training, documentation, CAPA, nonconformance management).- Identify and mitigate quality risks in commercial operations through structured risk management.- Drive process improvements that increase efficiency, product quality, and customer satisfaction.- Leverage digital tools and data insights to enhance quality performance, transparency, and decision-making.- Ensure inspection readiness across all markets in the region, manage external inspections and internal audits.

Regulatory Strategy & Compliance

- Define and execute the regional regulatory strategy that supports business growth objectives, ensuring timely submissions, approvals, and adherence to country-specific requirements.- Ensure full compliance with internal policies and external regulations, with a strong focus on product safety and market access. Translate regulatory requirements into clear business implications and actionable guidance for leadership teams.- Act as key interface to health authorities and external stakeholders, representing the organization with credibility and impact.

Commercial & Customer Quality

- Establish governance framework, ensuring Commercial teams, Customer Services teams and Business Partners operate in accordance with local requirements and corporate quality standards.- Ensure product integrity and compliance across commercial operations and customer services.- Ensure on time and accurate Post Market Surveillance & Reporting- Partner with customer-facing teams to resolve quality issues and improve the end-to-end customer experience.

Leadership & Stakeholder Management

jobs.description:
1 Senior Consultant (Mid-Level) - Focus Product Management (m/f/d) / Product Owner Tasks
As a Senior Consultant focused on product management at Trinsik, you own digital products end-to-end - from blank page to live, growing product. In our venture-building teams, you turn client and user needs into a clear product vision, validate fast, and lead cross-functional teams to ship.

What You'll Do
* Define the vision, strategy and roadmap for new digital products, aligned with client business goals and validated against real user needs
* Take products from scratch - frame the problem, shape the proposition, and validate before scaling; create new propositions, not just improve existing ones
* Lead product discovery with user research, analytics, benchmarking and hypothesis validation; size opportunities quantitatively
* Prioritize the backlog by customer value, business impact and technical feasibility, using clear frameworks
* Lead agile teams across engineering, UX/UI, data and QA, coordinating with marketing, sales and operations for launch
* Define success metrics, track them, and run an evidence-based cycle of experimentation, learning and iteration
* Use generative AI and agents to accelerate definition, validation and prototyping - AI as part of how you work
* Contribute to commercial outcomes - help ship revenue-generating propositions and deliver against targets

Requirements
* Hands-on experience across the full digital product lifecycle - discovery, definition, delivery and measurement
* Exposure to 0-to-1 work: you've helped create and validate new products or features, not only maintained existing roadmaps
* 3-5 years in product management / product ownership for digital products
* Commercially minded - you've worked to clear targets and are keen to own a number
* Data-literate: fluent with product analytics, A/B testing and funnel/CRO optimization; you use data as evidence
* A clear writer - your documents move discussions forward and help teams decide
* High agency and comfort with ambiguity: you set your own priorities and move without waiting for a perfect brief
* Strong stakeholder management with senior stakeholders and clients, written and verbal, in German and English
* A growth mindset: curious, self-driven, and comfortable being challenged

Nice to have
* Experience in venture building, startups, or innovation consulting
* Technical fluency to dialogue with engineering (APIs, web/mobile architectures)
* Product marketing or positioning background
* Solid command of agile methods (Scrum, Kanban) and prioritization frameworks (RICE, MoSCoW, ...)

Benefits
The Numbers: €60,000 - €70,000 gross annually (positioned according to your competencies)

Daily Perk: your choice: a public transport subsidy or a tax-free daily lunch allowance.

Permanent discounts with 600+ top brands via our Corporate Benefits platform.

Flexibility & Trust: Flexible hours and home office to balance life while keeping a vibrant team dynamic.

Change of Scenery: Work remotely from anywhere in the EU, up to 20 calendar days/year, or use sabbatical options.

Exciting Playground: Dive into different industries, apps and digital solutions with plenty of creative freedom.

Latest Software: We work with what's current. If you know something newer and better, let's test it.

International Team: An experienced crew in Austria, Germany, Hungary and Switzerland.

Flat Hierarchies: Your input finds open ears - from designs to business ideas or party plans.

Feedback Culture: open, and direct.

Cool Workplace: Collaboration happens right in the middle of Vienna.

Application process
We run a 3-stage process to understand who you are - and help you understand us. We position the role based on competencies, not titles.

jobs.title: IT-Engineer für Windows/Active Directory (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Die RAITEC GmbH als Teil der Raiffeisengruppe beschäftigt an den Standorten Linz, Graz, Innsbruck, Salzburg und Klagenfurt rund 650 Mitarbeiter_innen. Für unsere Kund_innen planen, entwickeln und betreiben wir einen vielschichtigen Applikationsbetrieb und IT-Infrastruktur. Dazu zählen neben einem modernen Rechenzentrum und einem komplexen Netzwerk auch über 37.000 Arbeitsplätzen sowie die Infrastruktur für den Betrieb von Business- und Bank-Applikationen. 1 IT-Engineer für Windows/Active Directory (m/w/d) Deine Aufgaben

Sorge für Stabilität und Effizienz in unserer Windows-Systemlandschaft.

* Du administrierst, kontrollierst und überwachst Serversysteme auf Basis von Windows sowie Authentifizierungsdienste wie Active Directory und LDAP.

* Du automatisierst Abläufe und wiederkehrende Tätigkeiten, um Prozesse effizienter und nachhaltiger zu gestalten.

* Du stellst den stabilen und sicheren Betrieb unserer Multi-Tier-Applikationslandschaft sicher und erkennst mögliche Systemengpässe frühzeitig.

* Du führst Release-, Patch- und Systemsoftware-Einsätze auf Serversystemen durch und optimierst deren Leistung durch gezielte Performance-Analysen.

* Du analysierst Störungen, behebst Fehler und unterstützt die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Systemlandschaft.

Dein Profil

Windows ist dein Ding.

* Du verfügst über praktische Erfahrung im Active Directory- oder Windows-Server-Umfeld. Eine abgeschlossene Informatikausbildung ist von Vorteil, für uns zählen aber vor allem deine Kenntnisse und deine praktische Erfahrung.

* Du bringst Erfahrung im Troubleshooting von Windows-Systemen mit und bist mit Release-, Patch- und Betriebsprozessen vertraut.

* Auch in herausfordernden Situationen arbeitest du strukturiert, behältst den Überblick und findest pragmatische Lösungen.

* Du kommunizierst klar und wertschätzend, arbeitest gerne mit unterschiedlichen Ansprechpartner:innen zusammen und scheust dich nicht, Themen aktiv anzusprechen.

* Der direkte Kontakt mit unseren Kund:innen macht dir Freude und gelegentliche Bereitschaftsdienste außerhalb der Betriebszeiten sind für dich kein Problem.

Unser Angebot

Eine spannende Aufgabe in einem dynamischen Umfeld.

* Aktuell arbeiten eine Frau und fünfzehn Männer an drei Standorten in unserem Team - eine bunte Gruppe von jung bis erfahren die vor Ort, als auch remote zusammenhält

* Eine Mentorin oder ein Mentor begleitet dich, bis du eigenständig agieren kannst.

* Obwohl du dir gerne selbstständig neues Wissen aneignest, sorgen wir dafür, dass du fachlich immer auf dem neuesten Stand bleibst

Für diese Position garantieren wir ein attraktives sowie marktadäquates Vergütungspaket, welches sich an deiner Qualifikation und Berufserfahrung orientiert. Das Mindestjahresgehalt für diese Position beträgt auf Vollzeitbasis EUR 45.800 brutto (inkl. Sonderzahlungen). jobs.description:
1 Expert, Science and Technology (F/M/D) Job ID: REQ-10085657

As an Expert in the Method Development Team in Process Analytical Sciences (PAS), you will be responsible for physicochemical method development, optimization, and robustness testing in late-phase pharmaceutical drug development. Using state-of-the-art technologies and scientific expertise, you will support Drug Substance (DS) and Drug Product (DP) process development within a multidisciplinary project team. We are seeking an experienced scientist with strong analytical expertise, proficiency in data and digital tools, and comprehensive knowledge of DS and DP process development.

The role combines experimental laboratory work with technical documentation. The ideal candidate should therefore be comfortable working both in and outside the laboratory.

This position is limited to an 18-month fixed term.

Standort: Österreich / Schaftenau

This role is based in Schaftenau, Austria. Novartis cannot offer relocation support; please apply only if the location is accessible to you.

About the Role

Key Responsibilities

· Plan, organize, perform, and document physicochemical method development, including HPLC and CE, in compliance with internal quality and HSE standards.
· Use chromatographic, statistical, and other software tools to increase efficiency.
· Support the implementation, handover, and transfer of analytical methods
· Collaborate with PAS laboratories, Analytical Experts, and cross-functional teams to ensure effective analytical workflows.
· Design and execute physicochemical analytical approaches for DS, DP, and process intermediates in accordance with Quality by Design principles.
· Interpret analytical results and apply data and digital solutions to improve efficiency.
· Author and review scientific reports, support regulatory submissions
· Manage multiple priorities, communicate challenges proactively, and resolve complex issues.
· Promote knowledge sharing, present results internally, and contribute to publications, presentations, and patents.
· Evaluate new analytical technologies, develop innovative methods using DoE principles, and ensure alignment with scientific standards.

What You Will Bring to the Role

· University degree in pharmaceutical technology, biotechnology, biochemistry, chemistry, chemical engineering, or another relevant natural science discipline.
· At least 2 years of experience with an MSc or 1 year with a PhD in the (bio)pharmaceutical industry.
· Knowledge of Analytical Development.
· Expertise in biologics DS and DP process development using QbD principles.
· Excellent collaboration skills, including communication, teamwork, and problem-solving.
· Proficiency in written and spoken English; German is beneficial.
· Strong proficiency in digital technologies.

Rewards

In addition to a market-competitive base salary, we offer an attractive incentive program, a modern company pension scheme, childcare facilities, learning and development opportunities, and worldwide career opportunities within the Novartis group.

Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion / EEO paragraph

Novartis is committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment with diverse teams representative of the patients and communities we serve.

Adjustments for Applicants with Disabilities

If you require an adjustment during the recruitment process because of a medical condition, physical disability, or neurodiverse condition, contact disabilities.austria@novartis.com with details of your request and your contact information.

jobs.title: DGKP / Wohnbereichsleitung (m/w/d) - Gerontopsychiatrie / psychiatrische Pflege
jobs.description:
1 DGKP / Wohnbereichsleitung (m/w/d) - Gerontopsychiatrie / psychiatrische Pflege Arbeitsort: Bezirk Völkermarkt

Gesucht wird eine erfahrene Pflegefachkraft, die neben hoher pflegerischer Kompetenz insbesondere Erfahrung in der psychiatrischen bzw. gerontopsychiatrischen Pflege mitbringt und Verantwortung für die Qualität und Organisation eines Wohnbereichs übernehmen möchte. Der Arbeitsort ist mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln gut erreichbar.

IHRE AUFGABEN

* Fachliche und organisatorische Leitung eines Wohnbereichs
* Sicherstellung einer qualitativ hochwertigen, individuellen und ganzheitlichen Pflege und Betreuung
* Verantwortung für eine korrekte und aktuelle Pflegedokumentation, Pflegeplanung, Anamnese und Assessments
* Sicherstellung und Weiterentwicklung der pflegerischen Qualitätsstandards
* Mitgestaltung und Umsetzung des Pflege- und Betreuungskonzeptes
* Fachliche Begleitung und Unterstützung der Mitarbeiter im Wohnbereich
* Sicherstellung professioneller Abläufe im Pflegeprozess
* Zusammenarbeit mit Pflegedienstleitung, Ärzt und weiteren Berufsgruppen
* Unterstützung und Anleitung von Mitarbeiter bei der Anwendung interner Programme, Dokumentationssysteme und Standards

IHR PROFIL

* Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Diplomierte Gesundheits- und Krankenpflegeperson (DGKP) bzw. eine in Österreich anerkannte gleichwertige Ausbildung
* Eintragung in das Gesundheitsberuferegister
* Fundierte Berufserfahrung in der psychiatrischen bzw. gerontopsychiatrischen Krankenpflege
* Sehr gute pflegefachliche Kenntnisse
* Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Pflegedokumentation, Pflegeplanung, Anamnese und Assessments
* Erfahrung in einer leitenden bzw. verantwortlichen Funktion von Vorteil
* Weiterbildung "Basales und mittleres Pflegemanagement" von Vorteil, aber nicht Voraussetzung
* Ausgeprägtes Verantwortungsbewusstsein und hohe Qualitätsorientierung
* Organisations- und Führungskompetenz
* Kommunikationsstärke, Teamfähigkeit und wertschätzender Umgang mit Bewohner und Mitarbeiter
* Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

WEITERBILDUNG WIRD FINANZIERT

Sollten Sie die Weiterbildung "Basales und mittleres Pflegemanagement" noch nicht absolviert haben, stellt dies kein Ausschlusskriterium dar.

Die erforderliche Weiterbildung wird vom Arbeitgeber finanziert und kann in der Dienstzeit absolviert werden.

Damit bietet sich die Position auch für sehr erfahrene DGKP mit psychiatrischem bzw. gerontopsychiatrischem Hintergrund an, die den nächsten Karriereschritt in eine Führungsfunktion machen möchten.

DAS WIRD IHNEN GEBOTEN

* Vollzeitanstellung mit 37 Wochenstunden
* Besonders attraktive und planbare Arbeitszeiten
* Montag bis Freitag
* Keine regulären Wochenenddienste
* Keine regulären Nachtdienste
* Drei zusätzliche freie Tage
* 27 Urlaubstage nach dem zweiten Urlaubsjahr sowie 30 Urlaubstage ab dem 43. Lebensjahr
* Vergünstigtes Mittagessen
* Kostenloser Parkplatz
* Individuelle Fort- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
* Drei Tage bezahlte Bildungsfreistellung pro Kalenderjahr
* Regelmäßige Teambesprechungen und Möglichkeit zur Supervision
* Langfristige Tätigkeit in einem professionellen und wertschätzenden Pflegeumfeld

ENTLOHNUNG

Die Entlohnung erfolgt nach dem Kollektivvertrag der karitativen Arbeitgeber und beträgt bei 37 Wochenstunden EUR 3.601,55 bis EUR 4.096,95 brutto monatlich, abhängig von der anrechenbaren Berufserfahrung.

Bei einer Beschäftigung im Ausmaß von 38 Wochenstunden erhöht sich das Gehalt um 2,7 %.

Arbeiten am Flughafen Wien - VIE nirgendwo anders. Wir sind das Tor zur Welt. Wir sind rund 5.000 Mitarbeiter:innen am Flughafen Wien und kommen aus 50 Nationen. jobs.title: People Operations Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
We grew from $1M to $10M ARR in under 12 months and now serve 10,000+ customers.

Fonio is Europe's market leader for AI phone agents for SMBs. Now were expanding globally and into new products.

We move fast, take ownership, give direct feedback, and avoid politics and unnecessary meetings.

Join one of Europe's fastest-growing companies. 1 People Operations Manager (m/f/d) Your Role

You own everything after a candidate signs, from contracts through offboarding, and automate as much of it as possible. We are looking for someone to build the structural backbone to enable rapid scaling.

* Contracts & onboarding: Manage employment contracts for all employees (direct and indirect employment), organize equipment, accounts, workspaces, and support relocation of international colleagues.

* HR tooling & automation: introduce and own an HRIS tool, automate workflows across systems.

* Payroll: Organize and own internal payroll processes, including variable compensation calculation of all sales teams.

* Compliance & people legal: Support international hiring (EU and non-EU), time-tracking, collective agreements, international taxation topics, etc.

* Compensation: Manage and monitor compensation bands across teams/countries.

* Events & culture: Organize internal and external events (hackathons, off-sites, etc.)

* Offboarding: Manage offboarding of employees.

* Later, people development: Design feedback cycles, L&D, career development (e.g. SDR academy).

What to Expect

* Solo, end-to-end ownership of everything people operations.

* Hands-on operational work to build the foundation for automation/scaling.

* Direct impact: your work has immediate influence on the culture of fonio.

* Flat hierarchies: close collaboration across departments.

What You Bring

* 3+ year of People Ops, HR, or Operations experience, ideally startup or scale-up.

* Knowledge about Austrian labor law, payroll, and collective agreements

* Structured, hands-on working style.

* AI and automation/workflow skills.

* People-first, low ego. You thrive under intensity.

* German native, strong English.

What We Offer

* €65,000 to €80,000

* Equity

* Relocation support

* Daily lunch and dinner

* Equipment of your choice

* Regular team off-sites

* On-site in Vienna, working directly with the core-team

Hiring Process

* 15 min intro call

* 30 min skill interview

* 20 min culture fit with the founders

              Kas ir Atbalsta personas pakalpojums lēmumu pieņemšanā?

Atbalsta personas pakalpojums lēmumu pieņemšanā ir personai ar garīga rakstura traucējumiem sniegts atbalsts lēmumu pieņemšanā, lai palīdzētu viņai vienlīdzīgi ar citiem sabiedrības locekļiem īstenot savu tiesībspēju un rīcībspēju. Atbalsts lēmumu pieņemšanā ļauj personai paust savu gribu, izvēli, plānot un pašai pieņemt lēmumus par savu dzīvi, veselības un sociālo aprūpi, finansēm un īpašumiem, kā arī palīdz personai paplašināt savu dabisko atbalsta loku, palīdz pilnveidot spējas pārstāvēt sevi un aizsargāt savas tiesības un intereses. Pakalpojuma ietvaros atbalsts tiek nodrošināts 6 dzīves jomās: tiesību un interešu aizstāvības jomā, finanšu jomā, ikdienas dzīves jomā, veselības aprūpes jomā, sociālā aprūpes jomā un atbalsta loka veidošanā.

Daugavpils Iespēju vidusskola aicina darbā pirmsskolas izglītības skolotāju.


Darba pienākumi:

1. Īstenot pirmsskolas izglītības programmu;

2. Nodrošināt kvalitatīvu pedagoģisko procesu, ņemot vērā katra bērna vecumu, veselības stāvokli, attīstību, individualitāti;

3. Dot iespēju paplašināt latvisku vidi grupās, pirmsskolas vidē un ārpusgrupu pasākumos;

4. Sniegt atbalstu bērniem, lai varētu pārvarēt sociāli emocionālās grūtības;

5. Palīdzēt attīstīt uzticības pilnas savstarpējās attiecības un veicināt valodas un kultūras apguvi pozitīvā vidē;

6. Atbalstīt pārējos pedagogus ikdienas darbā un tādējādi veidot sekmīgu pāreju uz vienotu pirmsskolu.

7. Līdzsvarot dažādas pirmsskolas izglītojamo vajadzības un intereses klasē, nodrošinot iekļaujošu izglītību un efektivizējot mācību procesu;

8. Pildīt izglītības iestādes direktora rīkojumus, vadītāja vietnieka, metodiķa un medicīniskā personāla norādījumus;

9. Veikt individuālo darbu ar pirmsskolas izglītojamajiem, lai veicinātu viņu vispusī

jobs.title: Systems Engineer – Aerospace & Optical Communications
jobs.description:
Full-time, primarily onsite position in Tallinn. We welcome applications from both strong junior and mid-level Systems Engineers. Starting date as soon as possible or by agreement.

Work tasks: The Systems Engineer will support the definition, coordination, integration, verification and delivery of Golbriak Space’s optical communication systems.
Main responsibilities: * Capture, analyse, define and maintain system and subsystem requirements * Translate product and mission objectives into clear technical requirements, actions and deliverables * Allocate requirements across subsystems and maintain traceability throughout the product-development lifecycle * Coordinate interfaces between mechanical, optical, electronic, software, thermal, manufacturing and testing activities * Identify technical dependencies, assumptions, constraints, conflicts and risks * Develop system-level verification and validation plans and define appropriate acceptance criteria * Support system integration, testing, troubleshooting and qualification activities * Review test results and verification evidence against defined requirements * Coordinate the resolution of technical issues involving multiple engineering disciplines * Track technical activities, dependencies, risks, decisions and milestones * Prepare and support technical and design reviews * Maintain requirements specifications, interface documentation, verification plans, technical reports and engineering decision records * Support configuration management and the controlled implementation of engineering changes * Collaborate closely with founders, engineering leads, technical teams, suppliers, partners and customers * Contribute to the improvement of systems-engineering processes, documentation and development workflows

We offer: * A central engineering role with direct impact on advanced optical communication systems
* Meaningful technical ownership across requirements management, system integration, verification and engineering coordination * The opportunity to work across mechanical, optical, electronic, software, manufacturing and testing disciplines * Close collaboration with an international and multidisciplinary engineering team * The opportunity to develop your expertise in systems engineering, optical communications, telecommunications and aerospace * The ability to contribute to technical decisions, engineering processes and ways of working as the company grows * A gross monthly salary of €2100–€3000, depending on experience, skills and expected level of responsibility * Relocation support to Estonia if required * Reasonable flexibility in working hours, consistent with operational and team needs

Other requirements: We are looking for a candidate with strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, technical curiosity and the ability to understand complex systems as a whole. The person should be able to identify dependencies, constraints and potential conflicts between different engineering disciplines.
The successful candidate will be organised, reliable and willing to take ownership. They should be able to coordinate multiple technical activities and priorities simultaneously. Strong communication and collaboration skills are required, together with the ability to explain complex technical information clearly. The company’s working language is English, so professional working proficiency in English is required. The candidate must be willing to work primarily onsite in Tallinn and be comfortable in a fast-moving environment where priorities and technical requirements may evolve.

Option to work from home: Yes

Juhtivkonsultandi ülesanne on juhtida ja arendada nõustajate meeskonda – planeerida nende tööd ning tagada osutatava teenuse kvaliteet. Sinu töö on oluline, sest Sa saad anda oma panuse Eesti tööturu arengusse.

Meeskonnas on 14 nõustajat, kes teevad oma tööd südamega. Väärtustame head koostööd, avatud suhtlust ja üksteisega arvestamist. Meie jaoks on oluline, et iga meeskonnaliige saaks oma töös vastutust võtta, areneda ja oma ideid julgelt jagada. Meil on ka omad väikesed traditsioonid, mis aitavad hoida meeskonnavaimu ja muudavad igapäevase töö mõnusamaks. Meie jaoks ei ole oluline ainult see, mida ära teeme, vaid ka see, kuidas me seda koos teeme – usaldus, abivalmidus ja hea huumor on meie meeskonnas vaieldamatu osa. Hoolime oma töötajatest, arvestame nende tagasisidega, pakume võimalusi enesetäiendamiseks ning paindlikku töökorraldust. Hüvitame igas kvartalis 100€ ulatuses spordi- ja massaažikulu ning pakume Sulle 35 päeva puhkust. Vaimset tervist aitab toetada supervisioon ja Vaimse tervise pesa.

* Sul on esimese astme kõrgharidus (sotsiaalteaduste õppesuunal, majandusteaduste, psühholoogia, kasvatusteaduse, sotsiaaltöö või nõustamise õppekavarühmades); * Sul on vähemalt kolmeaastane inimeste juhtimise kogemus tööturu- või sotsiaalvaldkonnas või teenuste sihtrühmadega; * Sul on eesti keele oskus C1 ja inglise või vene keele oskus B2 tasemel ametialase sõnavara valdamisega; * Sul on MS Windows töökeskkonna ja teiste tööks vajalike arvutiprogrammide ning andmebaaside kasutamise oskus; * oled tulemustele orienteeritud ja lahenduskeskne; * Sul on oskus ennast ja oma meeskonda juhtida, planeerida tööd ja määratleda prioriteete; * Sul on algatus-, organiseerimis- ja otsustusvõime, iseseisvus, õppimisvõime ja täpsus.

Chez Thales, nous sommes fiers de travailler ensemble pour imaginer des solutions innovantes qui contribuent à construire un avenir plus sûr, plus vert et plus inclusif. Un avenir de confiance. Mais ces technologies ne viennent pas de nulle part. L'intelligence humaine est le moteur derrière la technologie qui fait la renommée de Thales. Les projets que nous conduisons sont complexes et nos clients exigeants. Pour répondre aux besoins actuels et futurs de nos clients, nous maîtrisons plus d'une centaine de disciplines, de l'optique à la physique quantique, du traitement du signal à la connectivité et à l'intelligence artificielle. Rejoindre Thales, c'est repousser les limites de la technologie et la mettre au service du progrès et du développement durable de nos sociétés. C'est donc être au cœur d'une formidable aventure technique. Une attention portée à l'équilibre des collaborateurs au service de leur réussite. C'est pourquoi, notamment, nous nous efforçons de créer un environnement de travail accueillant et d'accorder la flexibilité nécessaire à l'équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie personnelle. Nous savons que cet équilibre est essentiel à votre épanouissement et à la réussite des projets que nous vous confierons. Des parcours professionnels riches. Chez Thales, nous jouons collectif. Ce qui signifie travailler en équipe, côtoyer des experts et donc apprendre et développer ses compétences en permanence tout en faisant bénéficier le Groupe de son savoir-faire. C'est aussi la possibilité d'évoluer, de changer de fonction ou d'activité, voire de pays.

    Lieu : Carquefou, France

jobs.title: Team Support
jobs.description:
Help shape the everyday experience of Supercell’s growing London office. This is a hands-on role for someone who loves making things happen, supporting great teams, and taking real ownership in an environment where no two days look quite the same.

Supercell is looking for a Team Support professional to join our London office. As Team Support, you’ll take ownership of the day-to-day support of the office, from travel and team events to the countless practical details that keep things running smoothly.

You’ll be the only Team Support based in London, so this is a role with plenty of independence and responsibility. But you won’t be doing it alone. You’ll be part of an experienced, caring Team Support team across Supercell, with colleagues to learn from and collaborate with. You’ll have the freedom to shape how support works locally, while staying closely connected with your colleagues in Helsinki and collaborating also with other people working with London operations.

At Supercell, independent teams and trust are at the heart of how we work. The same applies to Team Support: you’ll have real ownership of your area and the freedom to decide how best to support the people around you. Most importantly, you’ll have the opportunity to make a visible difference to the experience of everyone working in our London office.

If you enjoy helping people and figuring things out without needing a playbook for everything, you’ll probably feel at home here. Send your CV as well as your application / motivational letter before the application deadline (Thursday, September 17th 2026 9:00 pm BST).

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own the day-to-day administrative support for our London office.

  • Coordinate travel arrangements, including flights, accommodation, ground transportation, and the details in between.

  • Plan and organise team days, offsites, internal events, and other moments that bring people together.

  • Help colleagues navigate everyday practical questions, from benefits to general team support.

  • Work closely with Team Support colleagues in Helsinki and with teams operating across London and Helsinki, including our live game teams Clash of Clans and Hay Day.

  • Be a trusted local point of contact for colleagues, leads, and other stakeholders in London.

  • Spot opportunities to improve how things work and take ownership of putting better solutions in place.

What You Have

  • Strong experience (minimum of 5 years) in team support, workplace or office coordination, travel arrangements, and/or event production.

  • A service-minded approach and genuine enjoyment of helping others succeed.

  • Excellent organisational skills and close attention to detail. When you take something on, people can trust that it will get done.

  • The ability to manage several priorities at once and make good calls about what needs attention first.

  • Confidence working independently and taking responsibility, including in situations where there isn’t an existing process or obvious answer.

  • Strong communication skills in English and the ability to build trusted relationships with people across teams, disciplines, and locations.

  • A collaborative and humble way of working, with a willingness to ask for input, share context, and step in where you can help.

  • Enthusiasm and preferably also previous experience for working in an international environment with colleagues across multiple countries or offices.

  • You're actively using AI tools in your day-to-day work, and excited about experimenting with new ways AI can improve how we work.

Would Be Nice if You Also Have

  • Experience supporting a growing office or building support practices in an environment that is still evolving.

  • Experience coordinating complex international travel.

Where You'll Be

This role is based in our London studio and is a full-time, permanent position.

Because this role is all about supporting the people and everyday life in the office, we expect you to spend most of your working time onsite in our London office. You’ll also work closely with our Helsinki-based Team Support colleagues and teams whose members are split across London and Helsinki, so expect some travel also between our offices.

–––

That's it about the role! Below, we've gathered some things we feel are important for you to know. Totally optional, but a highly recommended read.

Once you're ready to apply, just send us your application through the form on the bottom of the page.

–––

About Supercell

Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. You might know us as the makers of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, and Brawl Stars. Our mission is to create great games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever.

So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings, and killing lots of projects.

Hey, You Might Love It Here!

Independent cells and trust are at the core of our culture. But it takes more than that to make great games. We take good care of our people, providing them with the compensation, work environment, and resources they need to succeed while having fun along the way.

You Are Not Your Job Title ™

Here, you won’t need to focus on chasing titles or climbing ladders. Internally, our job titles don’t include prefixes like Senior, Junior, Principal, or Director. Recognition isn’t tied to your title, as it doesn't define the impact you can have around here.

Benefits and Compensation

Luring you in with glitter, glamour, and gems isn't what we're about. We want you to enjoy your time here fully, so we structure our compensation and benefits with that in mind. It starts with perceiving you as a human being, not a resource.

Not Sure if You Should Apply?

Many candidates with great skills and experience second-guess themselves. The bar is high, but if this role excites you, apply! We’re here to help you succeed. Also, we're happy to learn about any specific accommodations you may need to fully engage in our recruitment process.

Wishing you all the best,
The Supercell Recruitment team

Senior Customer Success Manager - Financial Services

WHO WE ARE

At Trustly, we're building a smarter, faster, and more secure financial future by revolutionizing the world of payments. As a global leader in Open Banking Payments, we are establishing Pay by Bank as the new standard at checkout, providing unparalleled freedom, speed, and ease to millions of consumers and merchants worldwide.

Our Ambition: To build the world’s most disruptive payment network and redefine what the payment experience should feel like.

Trustly is a global team of innovators, collaborators, and doers. If you are driven by a strong sense of purpose and thrive in a dynamic, entrepreneurial, and high-growth environment, join us and be part of a team that’s transforming the way the world pays.


About the team

The Customer Success Team helps merchants get the most value out of Trustly, driving adoption of our products among their end users. We take a proactive, consultative approach, understanding each merchant's technology and strategy in order to drive mutual success.


About the role
The Senior Customer Success Manager will own a portfolio of Trustly's most strategic financial services merchants, with a strong focus on continuously optimising how these merchants use Trustly's products to maximize performance and value.

Financial services merchants operate in a demanding environment: high transaction volumes, tight margins, complex regulatory requirements, and end users who expect seamless, reliable payment experiences. This role is about going beyond maintaining the relationship, proactively identifying where performance can be improved, benchmarking merchants against peers and potential, and driving the changes needed to unlock that value.

The role demands a strong combination of technical and commercial skills, and close collaboration with Sales, Account Management, and Product.

This role is based in either our London or Stockholm office.


What you’ll do

  • Owning end-to-end optimization of a portfolio of strategic financial services merchants, continuously identifying opportunities to improve their performance on Trustly

  • Conducting rigorous, ongoing data analysis to benchmark merchant performance against peers, historical trends, and potential, and pinpointing where value is being left on the table

  • Translating analysis into clear, prioritised recommendations — and owning implementation through to measurable improvement, not just reporting the findings

  • Engaging with new and existing merchants to fully understand their needs and constraints, and designing tailored solutions that reflect the regulatory and operational realities of financial services

  • Leading technical onboarding for new merchants end to end, including complex, high-value implementations and ramping beyond go-live

  • Acting as a point of escalation and technical/commercial authority for complex merchant issues within the financial services vertical

  • Partnering closely with Sales, Account Management, and Product to feed merchant and performance insights back into the roadmap

 

Who you are

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in the online payments industry, with strong preference for direct experience in financial services, or at a PSP

  • Demonstrated track record of driving measurable performance improvements for merchants or clients through data-led optimisation

  • Strong understanding of the commercial and regulatory dynamics specific to remittance, FX, and banking payment flows

  • Ability to articulate complex technical information and present confidently to senior merchant and partner stakeholders

  • A data-driven approach, with the ability to independently interrogate data to identify and prioritize opportunities

  • Strong ability to navigate internally across functions — Commercial, Product, Finance, Legal/Compliance

  • Can-do attitude with the ability to find solutions to the most difficult problems

  • Proactive, diligent, and able to work autonomously with limited oversight

  • SQL, JIRA and Confluence experience preferred

  • Comfortable with regular travel within Europe

  • Based in London or Stockholm

jobs.title: Assurance Manager EU/UK
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

At Trustly, we're building a smarter, faster, and more secure financial future by revolutionizing the world of payments. As a global leader in Open Banking Payments, we are establishing Pay by Bank as the new standard at checkout, providing unparalleled freedom, speed, and ease to millions of consumers and merchants worldwide.

 

Our Ambition: To build the world’s most disruptive payment network and redefine what the payment experience should feel like.

 

Trustly is a global team of innovators, collaborators, and doers. If you are driven by a strong sense of purpose and thrive in a dynamic, entrepreneurial, and high-growth environment, join us and be part of a team that’s transforming the way the world pays.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are establishing a dedicated Compliance Assurance function in the Second Line of Defence, and we are seeking an experienced Entity Assurance Manager to own a single, defensible view of the second-line control environment across Trustly's EU and UK licensed entities.

This role will be part of a community of assurance managers, some of them focussed on specific compliance domains (such as Financial Crimes Prevention, Safeguarding, Consumer Protection, and ICT and Resilience) and some focussed on other Trustly regulated entities. As the Entity Assurance Manager, you own managing the assurance function at an entity level including understanding local requirements, what local regulators expect to see, how findings reach the entity Board and local management team, and what the entity Chief Compliance Officer (CCO) can credibly attest to.

You will confirm the local applicability of domain testing scope and technique, agree the reports that reach the entity Board, and serve as a primary point of contact for assurance matters toward the relevant EU and UK regulators/supervisors. You will work alongside domain assurance managers, Enterprise Risk Management (ERM), and Internal Audit, ensuring that assurance over Trustly's compliance controls is evidenced consistently.

This role is suited to a seasoned assurance, compliance, or second-line risk professional with experience in regulated financial institutions and a firm grasp of the independence boundaries that keep assurance credible.

What you'll do

  • Own a single, defensible view of the second-line control environment across Trustly's EU and UK licensed entities, ensuring that assurance results are comparable, aggregated consistently, and mapped to the ERM risk taxonomy.

  • Confirm the local regulatory applicability of domain testing scope and methodology, agreeing which requirements bite in each EU and UK entity and how findings are rated and reported locally.

  • Own the entity assurance opinion and the reporting of findings to the entity Board and local management team, and support what the entity CCO attests to.

  • Contribute to the annual assurance plan and the single master testing plan through the assurance forum, jointly reviewing and signing off scope with the relevant domain assurance managers before testing commences, to prevent duplicate or gapped coverage.

  • Serve as a primary point of contact toward the relevant EU and UK regulators/supervisors on assurance matters, representing the function credibly and building productive relationships with regulatory authorities.

  • Maintain a disciplined independence boundary by providing independent oversight only.

  • Track findings within the single, unified approach, using the shared issue taxonomy and closure criteria that align with Internal Audit standards.

  • Support Internal Audit's reliance assessment by maintaining a transparent, evidenced audit trail per test, and document any risk-accepted changes to testing cadence.

  • Contribute to standardized reporting, including Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) tracking control health, issue aging, and remediation progress across the entity axis.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Demonstrable experience in compliance assurance, second-line risk, or a related control function within a FinTech, payments, or adjacent regulated financial services environment, with experience in the payments sector preferred.

  • Experience engaging with EU and/or UK financial supervisory authorities, with the ability to represent an assurance or compliance function credibly toward regulators and build productive relationships with them.

  • Sound understanding of the EU and UK regulatory landscape relevant to payment and e-money institutions, including areas such as financial crime, safeguarding, consumer protection, and operational resilience.

  • Proven ability to lead end-to-end assurance reviews, from planning and scoping through to reporting and issue validation.

  • A firm grasp of the three-lines model and the independence boundary between second and third line, with the judgement to keep assurance independent and out of first-line operational activity.

  • Advanced knowledge of control testing methodologies, sampling, issue rating, and evidence standards, and the ability to connect control failures to the firm's risk taxonomy and appetite.

  • Experience working with GRC platforms and unified issue registers, with high attention to detail in the preparation of control findings and management-level documentation.

  • Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to build effective relationships across business teams, and to advise and collaborate with stakeholders at various levels, including senior management and Board members.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain complex concepts to non-specialist stakeholders and present to senior leadership, Boards, and regulators.

  • Willingness to work flexibly to collaborate with team members across different time zones.

WHAT WE OFFER

At Trustly, you will have the chance to solve meaningful challenges alongside some of the brightest minds in FinTech. Together, we are shaping the future of payments in an environment that celebrates curiosity, collaboration, and innovation. You will be challenged and empowered to grow, making a real impact every step of the way.

Our team is as diverse as the global footprint we serve. At Trustly, we foster a workplace where everyone feels they belong—a place where teamwork thrives, ideas flourish, and we never forget to have fun along the way. We are proud and committed to being an Equal Opportunity Employer and believe an open and inclusive environment enables people to do their best work.

PLUS additional benefits designed to enhance your work-life experience!

Shape Your Role and Make an Impact

jobs.title: Senior Analyst - MENA focus
jobs.description:
About ExTrac

ExTrac is a decision intelligence company used by governments, defence organisations, financial institutions, and corporates operating in complex, fast-moving environments. Our capabilities fuse curated data sources, domain-specific AI, and deep human expertise to transform information overload into clear, actionable foresight.

The Middle East and North Africa (MENA) is a core region for ExTrac's intelligence coverage, spanning the political and security dynamics, actors, movements, and online ecosystems that shape risk across the region and beyond it. We are the analytical backbone for decision-making when geopolitical uncertainty becomes an opportunity or a strategic risk. More at extrac.ai.

The Role

As a Senior Analyst covering the MENA region, you will help ExTrac understand and anticipate political and security developments across the region, including the activities of state and non-state actors, violent extremist organisations (VEOs), and the online ecosystems in which they operate. Working in Arabic every day, across standard and dialectal material, you will turn what you find into timely reporting that feeds ExTrac's intelligence products and data platform.

What the job involves

Intelligence collection and analysis

  • Monitor and assess political, security, and socio-economic developments across MENA, including regional diplomacy, state and non-state actors, and geopolitical risk, with the ability to contribute to wider global coverage when required.

  • Conduct daily monitoring of Arabic- and English-language media, including news outlets, social media platforms, official statements, and other open-source information environments.

  • Track VEO and non-state armed group activity, including organisational developments, propaganda and communications activity, governance dynamics, operational activity, and regional linkages.

  • Identify new narratives, actors, platforms, and threats appearing across online ecosystems.

  • Apply structured analytical techniques to assess complex information and identify patterns and relationships.

Intelligence production

  • Lead and contribute to daily, weekly, monthly, flash, and deep-dive analytical reporting, with a particular focus on MENA and VEOs.

  • Translate and assess Arabic-language documents and other source material.

  • Contribute to client-facing discussions, briefings, and ad hoc research requests as required.

  • Develop and maintain subject-matter expertise across designated countries, actors, organisations, and thematic areas.

Data curation

  • Lead and contribute to source coverage for the region, identifying and proposing new actors, entities, channels, and outlets for inclusion in ExTrac's research ecosystem.

  • Verify and assess sources in the original language prior to inclusion.

  • Maintain coverage against intelligence requirements, identifying where it should expand or deepen.

  • Contribute to the taxonomy and tagging decisions that structure MENA and violent extremism data.

  • Work with the wider research and data teams to translate analytical judgement into structured data that others can rely on without further verification.

Leadership and collaboration

  • Support the Team Lead with the reviewing, and quality assurance of analytical outputs.

  • Mentor junior analysts on research methodology, analytical standards, and source validation.

  • Support other teams across ExTrac on projects and deliverables when required.

Innovation and capability development

  • Help develop research methodologies, monitoring frameworks, and analytical processes to improve team efficiency and product quality.

  • Integrate AI systems and AI-assisted workflows into analytical practice where they create genuine improvements.

You should apply if

  • MENA is the region you already follow closely, across its politics, security dynamics, and the violent extremist movements and online ecosystems operating within it. This is the region you want to go deeper on rather than a rotation on the way to something else.

  • You work in Arabic, not just alongside it. You read Modern Standard Arabic and dialect comfortably, you notice when slang is doing something new, and you can tell the difference between a shift in language and a shift in intent.

  • Writing is one of your strengths. You can turn a fast-moving, ambiguous picture into a concise, evidence-based assessment under deadline, and you take pride in doing it well.

  • You care about the quality of the underlying data as much as the quality of the analysis built on it, and you hold both to the same standard.

  • You want to keep producing analysis at volume and take on more alongside it. Reviewing others' work, helping set priorities for a small team, and mentoring junior analysts appeal to you as additions to the writing, not a step away from it.

  • You thrive on operational tempo. Daily and flash reporting alongside longer deep dives suits how you like to work, and the pace energises rather than drains you.

  • You are already using AI in your workflow and are interested in what it changes about analytical craft.

Where this role can take you

  • Build recognised subject-matter expertise across your assigned countries, actors, and thematic areas, and take on broader analytical scope as it deepens.

  • Build leadership experience through mentoring junior analysts, quality-assuring their work, and supporting prioritisation across a small team.

  • Support the development of the monitoring frameworks and analytical methodologies used across the team.

  • Shape how AI changes intelligence work itself, championing new tools and methodologies across the Research & Analysis team and influencing how the whole function operates.

Requirements

  • At least five years of professional experience in intelligence analysis, geopolitical risk, disinformation analysis, strategic communications, international security, international relations, or a related field.

  • Strong subject-matter knowledge of the MENA region, including its key political and security actors and regional dynamics.

  • A working understanding of VEOs, their online ecosystems, communications strategies, narratives, and operational activity, built through direct analytical experience.

  • Fluency in written Arabic, across both Modern Standard Arabic and local dialects, including knowledge of slang, with the ability to monitor, analyse, and translate Arabic-language content from a range of sources.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Payments
jobs.description:
About ThriveCart:

ThriveCart is a powerful platform used by over 50,000 people worldwide to generate over $5B in sales. Included within the ThriveCart platform is a learning management system (LMS), affiliate management, cart and checkout functionality, making it a top solution for creators, coaches, consultants, and other businesses.

We integrate with everything you use and have a simple, clean UI with numerous features that allow customers to build income from existing traffic and we are the highest-converting cart for online businesses. Our business is growing, profitable, and backed by LTV SaaS Growth Funds, and we are looking to expand our footprint amongst online businesses.

Location:

Remote (Europe)

Job Overview:

We’re looking for a strategic and execution-focused Product Manager – Payments to lead the development, optimization, and scale of our global payments infrastructure. In this role, you’ll be responsible for driving core payment functionality, expanding payment method options, improving checkout experiences, and ensuring reliability, security, and compliance across the payments stack.

You’ll work cross-functionally with engineering, design, compliance, operations, and customer success to ensure our merchants have a seamless and trusted payment experience—whether they’re selling digital products, subscriptions, or services.

Tasks

What Your Work Will Entail:

  • Own and execute the end-to-end product strategy and roadmap for ThriveCart’s payments ecosystem (e.g., checkout, payment gateways, transaction routing, fraud, refunds, treasury, and reconciliation).
  • Define, prioritize, and deliver features that improve conversion rates, reduce friction, and support global scalability.
  • Partner with engineering and design to deliver high-quality user experiences and robust back-end systems.
  • Integrate and maintain third-party payment providers (e.g., Stripe, PayPal, Authorize. net) and explore new options (e.g., local payment methods, wallets, and bank debits).
  • Ensure all payment solutions meet regulatory requirements (PCI, PSD2, SCA, etc.).
  • Monitor performance, adoption, and reliability of payment systems using data and user feedback.
  • Collaborate with customer success and support to identify and resolve user pain points related to payments.
  • Stay informed about global payment trends, technologies, and fintech regulations, and bring ideas forward that align with ThriveCart’s growth.

Requirements

What You Bring To This Role:

  • Proven track record of building and scaling payments systems in a SaaS, fintech, or eCommerce environment.
  • Deep understanding of payment infrastructure, including gateway integrations, card networks, fraud prevention, settlements, and chargebacks.
  • Strong technical fluency—comfortable working closely with engineers and interpreting API documentation.
  • Excellent communication, prioritization, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong data-driven mindset—you understand what to track, how to measure it, and how to use insights to iterate quickly.
  • 3–5+ years of experience as a Product Manager, ideally with direct ownership over payment products or platforms.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Business, Finance, Economics, or related discipline) preferred but not required.
  • Equivalent practical experience in product management, payments, or fintech may substitute for formal education.
  • Certifications in product management (e.g., Pragmatic, AIPMM, or CSPO) or fintech/payments (e.g., ETA CPP) are a plus but not mandatory.
  • Experience working in agile, cross-functional teams with a focus on delivering customer-centric solutions.
  • Experience with global payment methods, subscriptions, recurring billing, or tax compliance tools.
  • Experience with payments orchestration systems and/or treasury systems is considered a plus.
  • Experience of using AI Agents and implementing and building AI tools and Agents

Learn More About ThriveCart:

Our Values are:

  • Commit to Excellence
  • Find a Way
  • Help Each Other
  • Keep Growing
  • Data First

Our team and product are growing rapidly- we achieved YoY growth of 64% from 2022-2023, and we’re just getting started. We believe in open communication, clear goal setting, and that people do best when they have a growth mindset and want to get things done. Our team comes from diverse backgrounds and companies like Shopify, Salesforce, and BigCommerce, and we are running like an independent SaaS company within a PE fund.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About ThriveCart:

ThriveCart is a powerful platform used by over 50,000 people worldwide to generate over $5B in sales. Included within the ThriveCart platform is a learning management system (LMS), affiliate management, cart and checkout functionality, making it a top solution for creators, coaches, consultants, and other businesses.

We integrate with everything you use and have a simple, clean UI with numerous features that allow customers to build income from existing traffic and we are the highest-converting cart for online businesses. Our business is growing, profitable, and backed by LTV SaaS Growth Funds, and we are looking to expand our footprint amongst online businesses.

Location:

Remote (Europe / LATAM)

Job Overview:

Full-ownership software engineer responsible for building a new system in TypeScript that will replace our existing PHP system, while maintaining the current PHP system throughout the transition. This is not a hand-off role — you take a problem from requirement to production and own it there. You'll work across both stacks, make technical decisions, and be accountable for what you ship.

We expect you to use AI coding tools as a core part of how you work. Not occasionally — daily. Your velocity, code quality, and problem-solving should reflect effective AI tool use. What we care about is judgment: understanding what you ship, making the right decisions, and knowing when to push back on AI output.

This description applies across experience levels (L1–L4). Interview depth and expectations are calibrated to your level.

Tasks

What You'll Own:

  • Features from requirements to production: you break them down, build them, ship them, monitor them
  • Technical decisions within your scope, with clear trade-off reasoning
  • Quality of your code and the areas you touch
  • Responding to incidents and dev-escalations in your domain
  • Building the new TypeScript system that will replace the legacy PHP platform
  • Maintaining and supporting the existing PHP system throughout the transition

What Your Work Will Entail:

1. Feature Development

  • Take feature requests, break them into tasks, estimate, and deliver independently
  • Build the new TypeScript-based system designed to replace our existing PHP platform
  • Maintain and support the current PHP system in parallel, until the new system is fully migrated
  • Write clean, tested, production-ready code that meets team standards
  • Make technical decisions for features and explain trade-offs clearly
  • Monitor your features in production — logs, metrics, alerts
  • Leave the codebase better than you found it (refactor, document, reduce debt)

2. Production Ownership & Incident Response

  • Respond to dev-escalations with urgency — investigate issues, communicate findings, contribute to resolution
  • Participate in incident response: at all levels, you are expected to show up, help investigate, and support resolution
  • L4+: Drive incident response for your domain — coordinate investigation, delegate tasks, communicate status to stakeholders, and ensure post-mortems happen
  • Write runbooks and keep documentation current as you build
  • Share on-call rotation after ramp-up period

3. Code Quality & Testing

  • Write unit and integration tests as part of feature work, not as an afterthought
  • Participate actively in code reviews — give thoughtful feedback, act on feedback you receive
  • Identify edge cases and risks during planning, not after deployment

4. AI-Augmented Development (Expected, Not Optional)

  • Use AI coding tools daily: code generation, debugging, test writing, exploring unfamiliar parts of the codebase, code review acceleration
  • Your output should be measurably faster because of AI tools
  • You understand everything you ship — AI is an accelerator, not a replacement for judgment
  • L3+: Help teammates develop effective AI workflows; contribute to team standards for AI tool use
  • L4+: Set team standards for AI tool usage — evaluate what delivers real value, ensure quality isn't sacrificed for speed

5. Collaboration

  • Work closely with Product, Design, QA, and other engineers
  • Contribute meaningfully to sprint planning and technical discussions
  • L3+: Mentor L1/L2 engineers through code reviews, pairing, and sharing knowledge

Requirements

What You Bring To This Role:

Technical Environment

  • Primary stack: TypeScript/Node.js for the new system you'll build, and PHP 7.4/8+ with Laravel for the existing system you'll maintain during the transition.
  • Infrastructure: MariaDB, Redis, AWS (EC2, RDS, CloudWatch, SQS, S3), Docker, GitHub Actions CI/CD

This role requires active, hands-on TypeScript experience and past professional experience with PHP. Hands-on experience integrating payment platforms such as Stripe and PayPal is required.

Expectations by Level:

  • L1: Works on well-scoped tickets with guidance. Learning the codebase and practices. Uses AI tools to learn faster and ship more.
  • L2: Independently owns features. Minimal guidance needed on implementation. Noticeably faster because of AI tool usage.
  • L3: Leads small projects. Mentors L1/L2. Improves the codebase proactively. Teaches effective AI workflows.
  • L4: Technical authority for a domain. Drives cross-team projects. Sets team AI standards. Drives incident response.

Success Metrics:

Early on, you'll ship your first feature to production, understand the core architecture, and get your local development environment set up. From there, you'll be independently shipping features end-to-end and contributing to code reviews. As you grow further, you'll contribute meaningfully to technical discussions and handle dev-escalations in your area.

On-Call:

Shared rotation (~1 week/month after ramp-up). Critical: 15 min. High: 1 hour.

Our Values are:

  • Commit to Excellence
  • Find a Way
  • Help Each Other

Our team and product are growing rapidly- we achieved YoY growth of 64% from 2022-2023, and we’re just getting started. We believe in open communication, clear goal setting, and that people do best when they have a growth mindset and want to get things done. Our team comes from diverse backgrounds and companies like Shopify, Salesforce, and BigCommerce, and we are running like an independent SaaS company within a PE fund.

jobs.title: Restaurant Supervisor
jobs.description:
Join the Villa Valentina Team!

About Villa Valentina

Inspired by the warmth of a Spanish farmhouse, Villa Valentina brings people together through Mediterranean flavours, heartfelt hospitality and dishes made for sharing. Relaxed, vibrant and full of character, it is a place where guests feel like old friends — and our team brings that feeling to life every day.

Part of Urban Italian Group

Urban Italian Group is one of Europe's fastest-growing hospitality groups, bringing together distinctive restaurant brands, passionate people and memorable guest experiences. As we continue to grow, so do the opportunities for those who want to build their careers with us.

The Role

As Supervisor at Villa Valentina you will support the management team in running smooth, energetic and guest-focused services. You will be hands-on on the floor, helping the team stay organised, supporting guests, and making sure our standards are delivered with warmth and consistency as part of UIG standards.

What you'll be doing

    

Supporting the daily restaurant service and helping the floor run smoothly.

    

Leading by example and supporting the team during busy shifts.

    

Creating a warm, confident and memorable guest experience.

    

Helping with table flow, guest communication and service standards.

    

Supporting training, feedback and daily team motivation.

    

Working closely with managers and the kitchen to keep service connected and organised.

You'll thrive in this role if you

    

Experienced in a busy restaurant or hospitality environment.

    

Confident on the floor and comfortable supporting a team.

    

Warm, positive and guest-focused.

    

Organised, reliable and calm under pressure.

    

A strong communicator who enjoys working with people.

    

Ready to learn, grow and take ownership.

Our culture and values

We believe we work with people, not food. Guided by our values of Trust, Inclusion, Passion and Entrepreneurship, we’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels welcome, valued and empowered to grow.

What do we offer?

    

Be part of one of Europe’s fastest-growing hospitality groups.

    

Build your career across multiple brands and countries.

    

Work alongside talented people who genuinely love hospitality.

    

International career opportunities.

    

Referral bonus scheme.

    

Shared accommodation (where applicable).

    

Friends for life.

Sound like your kind of place?

If you are excited by joining us, we would love to hear from you. Bring your energy, personality and passion for hospitality to Villa Valentina.

Urban Italian Group is committed to fair and inclusive recruitment. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. If you need a reasonable adjustment at any stage of the selection process, please tell our Talent Acquisition Team.

  • Technische interventies uitvoeren en storingen doelgericht oplossen op locatie.

  • Je beschikt over een sterk technisch en mechanisch inzicht.
  • Je hebt kennis van of ervaring met leidingsystemen, flenzen, kleppen, dichtingen en boutverbindingen.
  • Je bent een praktische probleemoplosser met een hands-on en klantgerichte mentaliteit.
  • Je werkt zelfstandig, neemt verantwoordelijkheid en blijft rustig bij technische uitdagingen.
