jobs.title: Product Lead - SeaQ Communications
jobs.description:
Join our team as Product Lead, SeaQ® Communications.
At VARD Electro, we are passionate about developing innovative solutions that enhance communication and operational efficiency at sea.
 
Our SeaQ® Communications portfolio plays a vital role in connecting systems, vessels, crews, and onshore operations through reliable, integrated solutions that keep the maritime industry moving forward.
 
As we continue to strengthen our position in the global maritime market, we are looking for a skilled and motivated Product Lead to join our SeaQ® Communications team. In this role, you will be a key contributor within our product development team, helping shape the future of our communication solutions. You will play a central role in developing products that respond to evolving customer needs, regulatory requirements, and market trends in an increasingly connected maritime landscape. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams across product development, delivery and projects, retrofit and service, sales, and customers worldwide. Your ability to combine technical understanding with customer insight and strategic thinking will be essential in driving innovation, performance, and growth.
 
At VARD, we believe in empowering people and embracing diverse strengths. We offer an environment where you can grow, take ownership, and make a real impact. Join us and be part of a team shaping the future of shipbuilding and maritime technology.

So – what are your skills? 


Duties and responsibilities
  • Own the technical scope for key system areas, including ICT infrastructure, networking, voice communication, and infotainment solutions
  • Lead the development, improvement, and lifecycle management of products and supporting delivery tools
  • Act as a subject matter expert within your areas of responsibility
  • Drive or contribute to task groups, product initiatives, and project deliveries
  • Lead hands-on testing, validation, and development activities
  • Contribute to knowledge sharing and competence development across the organization
  • Some travel should be expected, both domestically and internationally
Qualifications
  • Degree from College/University or Vocational School within IT, Telecom, or related fields
  • Relevant experience may compensate for formal education
  • Strong English skills, both spoken and written, as a minimum
  • Preferably 5+ years of experience within development and/or delivery of ICT and/or security systems and solutions
  • Experience from the maritime industry is an advantage

VARD works systematically for inclusion and diversity and encourage everyone to apply, even if your competence does not match 100% the above. 

This employment may require a background check, or security clearance by the Norwegian National Security Authority.

Personal qualities
  • Self-driven, proactive, and solution-oriented
  • Comfortable working both independently and as part of international, cross-functional teams
  • Curious and adaptable, with the ability to learn quickly and apply new knowledge effectively
  • Thrives in a dynamic and sometimes fast-paced environment
  • Identify yourself with the VARD values Craftmanship, Salesmanship and Fellowship.
Our commitment to you 
  • A good working environment with exciting and important tasks in an international environment 
  • Competitive pension scheme and insurance package 
  • Subsidized lunch in the office canteen 
  • Subsidized membership at the gym 
  • Occupational health service 
  • Flexible work from home policy 
  • Free mobile phone usage 
  • Central office location and free parking
  • We understand the importance of continuous learning and we strive to give you the chance to gain new skills and further develop your career

 

VARD recognizes the importance of having fun at work, this is why with VARD Social you will have the chance to bond with colleagues through new experiences and shared interests. The social offer varies throughout the year and includes activities like 'walk and talk' during lunch hours, fjord cruises, cooking lessons, go karting, football practices and wine tasting, just to name a few. 

With the right blend of fun, expertise and hard work, we are creating ships for the future. Join us!

Ole Marius Lid Asbjørnsen, Product Manager, SeaQ Communications, 48 15 30 20

6264 Tennfjord

Vard Electro is a globally recognized and trusted provider and advisor of marine electrical systems. Established in Norway in 1997, Vard Electro has today approx. 900 employees based in Norway, Romania, Brazil, Singapore, India, Italy, UK, Canada, USA and Vietnam, and operating worldwide.

In close cooperation with the customer, Vard Electro offers ­effective and environmentally friendly solutions with a focus on optimization of the operational performance. jobs.title: General Manager
jobs.description:
Join the Villa Valentina Team!

About Villa Valentina

Inspired by the warmth of a Spanish farmhouse, Villa Valentina brings people together through Mediterranean flavours, heartfelt hospitality and dishes made for sharing. Relaxed, vibrant and full of character, it is a place where guests feel like old friends — and our team brings that feeling to life every day.

Part of Urban Italian Group

Urban Italian Group is one of Europe's fastest-growing hospitality groups, bringing together distinctive restaurant brands, passionate people and memorable guest experiences. As we continue to grow, so do the opportunities for those who want to build their careers with us.

The Role

As a General Manager, you will lead the restaurant with energy, ownership and care. You will be responsible for the daily performance of the business, the guest experience, and the development of a strong, motivated team.

This role is for someone who enjoys being present on the floor, setting standards, supporting people and building a culture where the team takes pride in what they do every day.

What you'll be doing

    

Leading the daily restaurant operation and ensuring a smooth, high-quality service.

    

Creating a warm, memorable guest experience in line with Villa Valentina standards.

    

Coaching, supporting and developing the management and front-of-house team.

    

Driving sales, profitability, labour control and operational performance.

    

Working closely with the kitchen team to ensure strong communication and service flow.

    

Maintaining high standards in cleanliness, compliance, presentation and team behaviour.

    

Building a positive team culture based on trust, passion, inclusion and ownership.

You'll thrive in this role if you

    

Previous experience as a General Manager, Restaurant Manager or strong Assistant General Manager.

    

Experience leading busy, guest-focused restaurant operations.

    

Strong people leadership skills and the ability to develop others.

    

Good commercial understanding of sales, costs, labour and profitability.

    

Confidence managing standards, performance and daily priorities.

    

A hands-on leadership style and strong presence on the floor.

    

Passion for hospitality, team culture and delivering great guest experiences.

Our culture and values

We believe we work with people, not food. Guided by our values of Trust, Inclusion, Passion and Entrepreneurship, we’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels welcome, valued and empowered to grow.

What do we offer?

    

Be part of one of Europe’s fastest-growing hospitality groups.

    

Build your career across multiple brands and countries.

    

Work alongside talented people who genuinely love hospitality.

    

International career opportunities.

    

Referral bonus scheme.

    

Shared accommodation (where applicable).

    

Friends for life.

Sound like your kind of place?

If you are excited by joining us, we would love to hear from you. Bring your energy, personality and passion for hospitality to Villa Valentina.

Urban Italian Group is committed to fair and inclusive recruitment. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. If you need a reasonable adjustment at any stage of the selection process, please tell our Talent Acquisition Team.

jobs.title: Liikuntapäiväkoti Pilke Pupuna
jobs.description:
Pilke ohjaa lapsia lempeästi opintielle. Meillä varhaiskasvatukseen kuuluu leikin kautta oppiminen ja lempeä vuorovaikutus. Me näemme ja tunnistamme jokaisen lapsen ainutlaatuiset kyvyt ja tuemme hänen vahvuuksiaan. Pilkkeen tavoitteena on olla Suomessa varhaiskasvatuksen toimialan paras. Tämä tavoite saavutetaan työskentelemällä yhdessä.

Etsimme Varhaiskasvatuksen lastenhoitajaa Pilke päiväkoti Pupunaan Espooseen.

Tehtävä sopii sinulle, jos haluat hyödyntää osaamistasi, kehittää ja ideoida uutta sekä jättää oman persoonallisen jälkesi hyvän päivän syntymiseksi lapsille ja työkavereillesi. Työ alkaa 1.10.2026 tai sopimuksen mukaan.

Pilke Pupuna on pieni liikuntapainotteinen päiväkoti, jonka tavoitteena on liikunnan riemun ja liikunnallisen elämäntavan löytäminen. Pupunassa kaikki lapset ja aikuiset tuntevat toisensa ja sisarukset saavat olla lähellä toisiaan. Järjestämme säännöllisesti koko talon yhteisiä tilaisuuksia. Meille on tärkeää, että jokainen lapsi saa olla oma itsensä. Tuemme hänen kasvuaan ja kehitystään yhdessä vanhempien kanssa.

Toivomme sinulta vahvaa pedagogista työotetta, myönteistä ja aktiivista asennetta, hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja sekä kykyä kohdata lapset aidosti. Työtapamme on ratkaisukeskeinen ja kannustamme kokeilemaan uutta. Pilkkeen päiväkodeissa työt on jaettu lasten kanssa toimivien aikuisten kesken niin, että kaikilla on aikaa keskittyä omaan työhönsä ja tehdä se niin hyvin kuin mahdollista.

Tästä olemme tarkkoja

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on tehtävään soveltuva sosiaali- ja terveysalan perustutkinto (lastenohjaaja tai lähihoitaja sisältäen lasten ja nuorten hoidon ja kasvatuksen koulutusohjelman) tai muu vastaava tutkinto, esim. lastenhoitaja ja päivähoitaja. Tehtävään valitun tulee esittää nähtäväksi rikosrekisterilain (770/1993) 6 §:n 2 mom. mukainen lasten kanssa työskenteleviltä vaadittava rekisteriote.

Me haluamme tarjota sinulle

- Kuukausipalkan 2510,82-2716,03€ /kk kokemuksesi mukaan

- Innostavan, ketterän ja lempeän toimintakulttuurin, jossa aidosti arvostetaan varhaiskasvatuksen ammattitaitoa,

- Työyhteisön, jossa ollaan sitoutuneita toimimaan lapsen parhaaksi,

- Mahdollisuuden työskennellä painotteisessa varhaiskasvatuksessa

- Monipuolisia työsuhde-etuja, kuten hyvät työterveyspalvelut, ulkoilutakki, polkupyörä-, hieronta- sekä virike-etu. Katso lisää [täältä](https://www.pilkepaivakodit.fi/pilkelaisten-tyosuhde-edut/).

Jos luit juuri itsestäsi, pistä hakemus tulemaan - olisi ilo saada sinut hyvän päivän tekijöiden joukkoomme!

Haluaisitko tietää lisää Pilkkeestä ja tavastamme toimia?

Lempeyden voima ei ole vain Pilke-päiväkotien slogan – se kertoo meidän tavastamme tehdä töitä ja kohdata lapsia ja aikuisia. [Lue lisää siitä, mitä lempeyden voima meille pilkeläisille tarkoittaa.](https://pilkepaivakodit.fi/lempeys/)





- [Pilke yrityksenä](https://www.pilkepaivakodit.fi/tietoa-yrityksesta/)

- [Pilke työnantajana](https://www.pilkepaivakodit.fi/pilke-tyonantajana/)

- [Pilkeläisen uratarina](https://www.pilkepaivakodit.fi/tule-toihin-paivakotiin/)

- [Pilkkeen varhaiskasvatus](https://pilkepaivakodit.fi/tag/varhaiskasvatus/)

Odotamme hakijalta seuraavia asioita:

- Tehtävään vaadittava kelpoisuus

- Vahvaa pedagogista osaamista

- Erinomainen suomen kielen taito

- Myönteinen ja aktiivinen asenne


Pilke Pupuna liikuntapäiväkoti

Pilkkeellä lasten oppimista ja kasvua tuetaan ja luodaan aktiivisuudella, ammatillisuudella, pedagogisella osaamisella, lapsen osallisuudesta huolehtimisella, muokkautuvilla oppimisympäristöillä sekä kannustavalla ja motivoivalla ilmapiirillä. Me olemme Suomen suurin yksityinen päiväkotiketju, ja päiväkodeissamme, esikouluissamme ja iltapäiväkerhoissamme työskentelee yli 2 500 pilkeläistä ammattilaista ympäri Suomea.

Puhelin: 0404571787 Sähköposti: camilla.kuivalainen@pilkepaivakodit.fi Sijainti: Kirvuntie 45, 02140 Espoo

jobs.title: Restaurant Host
jobs.description:
Join the Villa Valentina Team!

About Villa Valentina

Inspired by the warmth of a Spanish farmhouse, Villa Valentina brings people together through Mediterranean flavours, heartfelt hospitality and dishes made for sharing. Relaxed, vibrant and full of character, it is a place where guests feel like old friends — and our team brings that feeling to life every day.

Part of Urban Italian Group

Urban Italian Group is one of Europe's fastest-growing hospitality groups, bringing together distinctive restaurant brands, passionate people and memorable guest experiences. As we continue to grow, so do the opportunities for those who want to build their careers with us.

The Role

As Host / Hostess, you will be the first person our guests meet and the last impression they take with them. You will help create a smooth and welcoming arrival experience, manage reservations, support the flow of the restaurant and bring warmth to every guest interaction.

What you'll be doing

    

Welcoming guests warmly and creating a strong first impression.

    

Managing reservations, guest arrivals and seating plans.

    

Supporting the team with smooth table flow during service.

    

Communicating clearly with managers, waiters and the kitchen when needed.

    

Handling guest questions with confidence, care and professionalism.

    

Keeping the entrance and host area organised, presentable and ready for service.

You'll thrive in this role if you

    

Warm, positive and confident when speaking with guests.

    

Organised and calm in a busy restaurant environment.

    

A strong communicator who enjoys working with a team - Swedish speaker is a plus.

    

Professional, reliable and well-presented.

    

Able to multitask and keep an eye on the details.

    

Passionate about creating great guest experiences.

Our culture and values

We believe we work with people, not food. Guided by our values of Trust, Inclusion, Passion and Entrepreneurship, we’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels welcome, valued and empowered to grow.

What do we offer?

    

Be part of one of Europe’s fastest-growing hospitality groups.

    

Build your career across multiple brands and countries.

    

Work alongside talented people who genuinely love hospitality.

    

International career opportunities.

    

Referral bonus scheme.

    

Shared accommodation (where applicable).

    

Friends for life.

Sound like your kind of place?

If you are excited by joining us, we would love to hear from you. Bring your energy, personality and passion for hospitality to Villa Valentina.

Urban Italian Group is committed to fair and inclusive recruitment. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. If you need a reasonable adjustment at any stage of the selection process, please tell our Talent Acquisition Team.

Tiimipäällikkönä huolehdit siitä, että moniammatillisen tiimisi työ tukee opiskeluterveydenhuollon palveluja parhaalla mahdollisella tavalla. Vastaat toimipaikkasi arjen sujuvuudesta ja hoitotakuun toteutumisesta, laadun varmistamisesta sekä tiimityön organisoinnista ja kehittämisestä, ja viet käytäntöön valtakunnallisia toimintaohjeita. Esihenkilönäsi toimii palvelutuotantopäällikkö ja teet tiivistä yhteistyötä myös muiden tiimipäälliköiden kanssa. Tehtävää on mahdollista hoitaa osittain etänä (enintään 2 pvä/vko) ja tehtävään voi sisältyä ajoittaista matkustamista.

Toimit esihenkilönä tiimisi opiskeluterveydenhuollon ammattilaisille: terveyden- ja sairaanhoitajille, psykologeille, psykiatreille, psykiatrisille sairaanhoitajille, yleislääkäreille, fysioterapeuteille ja palvelusihteereille.

Esihenkilönä tehtäviisi kuuluvat myös:

- Tiimisi yhteistyön, työhyvinvoinnin ja osaamisen vahvistaminen

- Tiimin resursoinnista huolehtiminen sekä uusien ammattilaisten rekrytointi ja perehdytys

- Työharjoittelujen ja alueellisen opiskeluyhteisötyön koordinointi sekä

- työvuorosuunnittelu ja sijaisjärjestelyt


Odotamme sinulta:

- Soveltuvaa terveydenhuollon korkeakoulututkintoa

- Kokemusta esihenkilötyöstä sekä tiimityön johtamisesta ja kehittämisestä

- Kokemusta päivittäistyön ja prosessien koordinoimisesta ja kehittämisestä

- Hyviä organisointitaitoja ja ratkaisukeskeistä työotetta

- Asiakaskeskeistä ajattelua ja kiinnostusta tiedolla johtamiseen

- Hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja ja tietoteknisiä valmiuksia


Katsomme eduksi esihenkilötyöhön tai johtamiseen liittyvän lisäkoulutuksen sekä suomen kielen taidon lisäksi riittävän englannin ja ruotsin kielten taidon.

Miksi töihin meille?

- Tarjoamme monipuolisen ja mielenkiintoisen tehtävän opiskeluterveydenhuollossa

- Meillä on asiantuntevat moniammatilliset tiimit, joiden jäsenet kokevat merkityksellisenä työskentelyn hoidostaan motivoituneiden ja siihen sitoutuneiden opiskelijoiden hyväksi

- Käytössämme on vuosityöaika, joka tuo joustoa työn ja vapaa-ajan yhteensovittamiseen

- Järjestämme säännöllistä koulutusta osaamisesi ylläpitämiseksi ja kehittämiseksi

- Tarjoamme työhyvinvointia tukevia etuja, kuten ePassi-virike-etuuden ja palvelupisteillä järjestettäviä hyvinvointitapahtumia

- Työterveyspalvelumme ovat kattavat


Työehtojen ja palkkauksen suhteen noudatamme YTHS työehtosopimusta (YTHS TES) ja siltä osin kuin siinä ei ole kirjattu, Terveyspalvelualan työehtosopimusta (TPTES). Tiimipäällikön tehtävä sijoittuu palkkaluokkaan VR5b. Lisäksi maksetaan erityistekijälisää johdettavien lukumäärän mukaan sekä henkilökohtaista palkanosaa. Viikkotyöaika tehtävässä on 38 h 35min.

jobs.title: Koulun ruokapalveluvastaava rakentamaan kouluruokailua Suomeen
jobs.description:
Haluatko olla mukana rakentamassa jotain täysin uutta?

Nordrest avaa uuden liiketoiminta-alueen Suomessa, kun helsinkiläinen yhteiskoulu muuttaa Helsingin Huopalahdenkadulle syksyllä 2026. Etsimme nyt ruokapalveluvastaavaa vastaamaan kouluruokalan päivittäisestä toiminnasta ja kehittämään yhdessä ravintola Huudin tiimin kanssa uudenlaista kouluruokailua. Työ alkaa 5.10.2026.

Tehtävästä

Ruokapalveluvastaavana vastaat kouluruokalan sujuvasta arjesta ja toimit tärkeänä linkkinä koulun sekä ravintola Huudin välillä. Työskentelet päivittäin yhteistyössä Huudin keittiötiimin kanssa varmistaen laadukkaan ja sujuvan ruokapalvelun koulun oppilaille ja henkilöstölle.

Tehtävässäsi osallistut ruokalistasuunnitteluun yhdessä asiantuntijoidemme kanssa sekä varmistat ruoan laadun, erityisruokavalioiden toteutumisen ja omavalvonnan.

Tässä tehtävässä pääset vaikuttamaan siihen, millaiseksi Nordrestin kouluruokailukonsepti Suomessa rakentuu.

Toivomme sinulta

- kokemusta suurkeittiö-, ammattikeittiö- tai laitosruokailusta
- osaamista suurten annosmäärien tuotannosta ja suunnittelusta
- elintarvikehygienian ja omavalvonnan tuntemusta
- kokemusta erityisruokavalioiden huomioimisesta
- hyviä yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja
- sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa
Arvostamme erityisesti kykyä kohdata lapset ja nuoret aidosti, kannustavasti ja positiivisella asenteella.

Menestyt tehtävässä, jos

- innostut uuden rakentamisesta ja kehittämisestä
- työskentelet oma-aloitteisesti ja ratkaisukeskeisesti
- toimit rauhallisesti myös kiireessä
- kannat vastuuta ja teet päätöksiä rohkeasti

Tarjoamme

Ainutlaatuisen mahdollisuuden olla mukana käynnistämässä Nordrestin kouluruokailua Suomessa sekä kehittämässä toimintaa ravintola Huudin osaavan tiimin kanssa. Saat tueksesi ammattitaitoisen työyhteisön ja vastuullisen tehtävän, jossa pääset vaikuttamaan koulun arkeen joka päivä.

Työsuhde

Määräaikainen työsuhde: 5.10.2026 - 5.6.2027 (mahdollisuus työskennellä kesällä Nordrestin toisessa yksikössä tilanteen mukaan)

Työpaikan sijainti: Huopalahdenkatu 24, Helsinki

Palkka: 2 500–2 800 €/kk

Lähetä hakemuksesi ja CV:si mahdollisimman pian, sillä käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana.

Nordrestillä uskomme, että hyvä ateria on enemmän kuin ruokaa lautasella. Se on makua, laatua ja huolenpitoa vieraistamme, työntekijöistämme ja planeetastamme.

jobs.title: Laatuinsinööri
jobs.description:
CMS Construction Management Solutions Oy etsii laatuinsinööriä asiakkaamme rakennushankkeeseen Kymenlaaksoon.

Tehtävässä työskentelet osana pääurakoitsijan projektiorganisaatiota ja olet mukana varmistamassa, että hankkeen laadunvarmistukseen liittyvä dokumentaatio on asianmukaisesti koottu, seurattu ja hallittu.

Työn pääpaino on dokumentoinnissa, ja tehtävä sopii hyvin myös uransa alkuvaiheessa olevalle rakennusalan osaajalle. Sinun ei tarvitse olla valmis laadunhallinnan asiantuntija – tärkeintä on, että ymmärrät rakentamisen perusteita ja siihen liittyvästä dokumentoinnista, työskentelet järjestelmällisesti ja olet valmis oppimaan uusia toimintatapoja ja järjestelmiä.

**Tehtäviisi kuuluu muun muassa**

- työvaiheiden tarkastus- ja laatudokumenttien kokoaminen ja hallinta

- tarkastus- ja katselmuspöytäkirjojen läpikäynti

- mittaus- ja testauspöytäkirjojen seuranta

- materiaalien hyväksyntä- ja kelpoisuusasiakirjojen tarkastaminen

- aliurakoitsijoilta tulevan dokumentaation kerääminen ja seuranta

- poikkeamien ja puutteiden dokumentointi sekä korjausten seuranta

- valokuva- ja muun laatuaineiston hallinta

- luovutusvaiheen dokumentaation kokoaminen


Työskentelet yhteistyössä työmaan työnjohdon, projektijohdon, aliurakoitsijoiden ja muiden hankkeen osapuolten kanssa. Tehtävä tarjoaa hyvän mahdollisuuden saada kokonaiskuvaa siitä, miten rakennushankkeen laadunvarmistus ja dokumentointi toimivat käytännössä.

**Toivomme sinulta**

- rakennusalan koulutusta, esimerkiksi rakennusinsinöörin tai rakennusmestarin tutkintoa

- ymmärrystä rakentamisesta ja siihen liittyvästä dokumentoinnista

- tarkkaa ja järjestelmällistä työotetta

- hyviä tietoteknisiä valmiuksia sekä kykyä omaksua uusia järjestelmiä

- kykyä hallita useita asioita samanaikaisesti

- sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa.


Aikaisempi kokemus työmaalta, laadunhallinnasta tai dokumentoinnista katsotaan eduksi, mutta se ei ole tehtävän ehdoton edellytys. Myös Excelin ja erilaisten dokumentinhallintajärjestelmien tuntemuksesta on hyötyä.

**Tarjoamme**

Tehtävässä pääset mukaan rakennushankkeen käytännön toimintaan ja kehittämään osaamistasi laadunhallinnan ja projektidokumentoinnin parissa. Rooli tarjoaa hyvän mahdollisuuden kasvattaa vastuuta ja osaamista projektin edetessä.

jobs.title: Senior Solutions Engineer (EMEA)
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Solutions Engineer to join our Sales Engineering team. You will partner with Account Executives to qualify, progress, and close revenue opportunities with Fortune 500 prospects — guiding them through demos, architecture discussions, and proofs-of-concept that prove Coder’s value for both human developers and the AI coding agents working alongside them.

This is not a scripted-demo-only role. You are equally comfortable running a deep technical proof-of-concept and stepping back to translate a technical win into a business case an economic buyer will act on. You are energized by ambiguity, motivated by winning deals the right way, and capable of bringing the voice of the prospect back into how Coder builds and sells.

 

What you will be doing:

  • Own the technical relationship with prospects through pre-sales, and efficiently manage towards a technical win

  • Demo the Coder platform from the developer, administrator, and AI agent workflow perspectives

  • Install Coder on cloud and on-prem Kubernetes or VM infrastructure

  • Run proofs-of-concept that prove Coder’s value including for agentic and LLM-powered development workflows and accelerate deals

  • Evolve into a subject-matter expert on Cloud Development Environments, agentic AI development, and their business impact

  • Serve as the prospect’s and customer’s voice, routing insights to Engineering and Product

  • Track and report product issues and feature requests using Linear

  • Troubleshoot Coder deployments, networking, and Kubernetes components during evaluation

  • Contribute pull requests to Coder’s documentation

     

What you bring:

  • Minimum 5 years of experience as a Solutions Engineer selling infrastructure or developer tooling

  • Strong customer-facing skills that win trust with technical stakeholders

  • Ability to translate technical hurdles into business value in real time

  • Understand agentic AI software development use cases and advocate passionately where appropriate

  • Comfortable leading architecture demos and deep-dive troubleshooting sessions

  • Deep Linux fundamentals and comfort at the command line

  • 3+ years hands-on with Docker and Kubernetes

  • Experience with AWS, Google Cloud, or Microsoft Azure

  • 3+ years with Terraform or comparable infrastructure-as-code tooling

  • Solid grasp of networking: ingress controllers, proxies, load balancers

  • Experience with AI tooling at both the user level and infrastructure level (e.g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) as well as LLM infrastructure such as model proxies and LLM routing layers (e.g. LiteLLM) and the ability to speak credibly to how enterprises evaluate and adopt them

  • Startup-speed execution, ownership mindset, and a player-coach attitude

 

Bonus tacos if you have

  • (Tacos? If you need an ice-breaker, ask how we say thanks by giving tacos!)

  • Success at both high-growth startups and larger software vendors

  • Direct experience deploying or supporting AI coding agents in customer environments (e.g. Claude Code, Devin, or similar autonomous/semi-autonomous dev tools)

  • Background in CI/CD, DevOps, or developer-platform products

  • Experience in platform engineering or developer platform teams

  • Kubernetes, AWS, or related certifications

About Coder

Coder is the leading platform for AI development Infrastructure, enabling enterprises to securely run human and AI-driven development workflows in consistent, governed environments. Coder provides self-hosted, agent-ready workspaces that unify developer productivity and platform governance. With Coder, enterprises can confidently evolve from human-only development to AI-assisted and autonomous workflows, without sacrificing security, compliance, or performance. Learn more at coder.com.

Interview process 

We believe that the interview process should be transparent, consistent, and enjoyable. We value your time and hope to complete the interview process in two to four weeks, if schedules allow. Through your interviews, you will meet a mix of individual contributors, managers, and senior leaders.

AI use during the interview process

As an AI company, Coder embraces the use of AI tools, and we want to be transparent about our expectations as you navigate our interview process.

Not permitted: Using AI assistance during conversational interviews.

Permitted: Using AI tooling for take-home assessments. Please flag where and to what extent it was used in your take-home. Your submission will not be penalized for using AI as long as it is done honestly.

Our use of AI in hiring

We use AI tools to help manage our recruitment process efficiently and fairly. Specifically:

  • Ashby helps us review inbound applications by surfacing candidates who best match the role requirements we've defined. This tool does not make hiring decisions; it helps our team prioritize which applications to review first.

  • Granola takes notes during our interview calls so our team can focus on the conversation with you.

All hiring decisions are made by humans. Our team reviews applications, conducts interviews, and makes final selections. AI tools assist us but never replace human judgment, and these practices are conducted in compliance with applicable data protection, AI governance, and labor laws. Your data is not used to train AI models.

In accordance with New York City Local Law 144, an independent bias audit has been conducted on "Automated Employment Decision Tools"; results are available for Ashby.

jobs.title: AI Product Owner - Leeds
jobs.description:
About Legal 500

Legal 500 is a global legal market research, data and intelligence business. Our research helps corporate clients make informed decisions about legal representation and gives law firms insight into their market position, performance, and clients.

Beyond research, we’re building a growing data, benchmarking, market-intelligence and subscription service offering. We bring the legal market together through a global programme of events - awards ceremonies, conferences and roundtables that convene leading law firms, in-house teams and their advisers. And through Legal Business, our journalistic title, we deliver independent news, analysis and commentary on the business of law and the strategy, performance and leadership of the world’s leading law firms.

We are a growing, multi-site organisation, with colleagues working across research, data, technology, product, journalism, commercial and events in London, Leeds and Bristol.

About the Role:

Our new AI Product Owner will provide central product ownership for AI capabilities developed and used across Legal 500, spanning multiple business units, functions and AI products.

We see the primary premise of this role is to ensure that investment in AI is prioritised against Legal 500’s business objectives, that products solve clearly defined business problems, and that appropriate quality, governance, human oversight and accountability are built into their lifecycle.

What you'll do:

You will have the opportunity to operate as centrally within Legal 500, sitting within the 'Project' unit within our People & Business Operations function. You'll work across business-unit leaders, users, Technology, Data, Governance and relevant technology partners or suppliers.

You'll be accountable for maintaining an enterprise AI product portfolio and roadmap and have responsibility for translating business needs into prioritised product requirements. This role is also about overseeing adoption and value realisation and ensuring AI products continue to improve as Legal 500’s operating models evolve. There is a possibility we may grow this team out to support on AI-specific engineering tasks.

What we're looking for:

Essential

  • Strong product ownership background, ideally managing a portfolio of products or initiatives across multiple functions in an AI, data, digital or knowledge-intensive environment in a business change context

  • Good understanding of how generative AI and related technologies can be applied to business processes (this role is not about having deep engineering expertise)

  • Ability to quickly understand different business functions and complex processes, and translate them into clear product requirements, priorities and measurable outcomes

  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to challenge AI outputs and understand issues such as hallucination, bias, confidence and evidence quality

  • Experience working across multiple business units and technology teams, balancing competing priorities and communicating effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Curious and comfortable challenging established ways of working with a commercial and outcome-focused approach rather than technology-led

  • Comfortable working in an evolving environment where AI capabilities and operating practices will continue to change.

Desirable

  • An understanding of professional services, publishing, legal markets, research or other knowledge-intensive environments would be advantageous.

Role information:

  • Hybrid workplace - 3 days a week in office, 2 days remote

  • This role can be based in either London or Leeds

  • Occasional travel to the other offices may be required (Bristol, London and Leeds)

jobs.title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja Riihimäelle
jobs.description:
**Tule mukaan luomaan elämäsi tarinaa Avustajasi Validia Oy:lle! Haemme nyt henkilökohtaisia avustajia Riihimäelle.**

Miltä kuulostaisi merkityksellinen ja arvokas työ sinulle sopivilla työajoilla? Haluaisitko saada työkokemusta hoitoalasta näköalapaikalta, tai kaipaatko tekemistä eläkepäivien ratoksi rauhallisissa olosuhteissa yksi asiakas kerrallaan? Tule mukaan! Henkilökohtaisena avustajana meillä pääset osaksi asiakkaidemme arvokkaita tarinoita.

Validialla henkilökohtaisen avun asiakkaat ovat vammaispalvelujen piiriin kuuluvia henkilöitä. Henkilökohtainen apu on kotona tai kodin ulkopuolella tapahtuvaa avustamista niissä asioissa, joihin henkilö ei itse kykene sairauden tai vamman vuoksi. Avustaminen voi olla harrastuksissa tai opiskelussa tukemista, kodinhoidollisia askareita tai vapaa-ajan tapahtumien mahdollistamista. Toisinaan avustajan tärkeimpänä tehtävänä on olla juttukaverina ja seurana: olla se kiireetön ihminen ihmiselle. Henkilökohtaisen avustajan rooli asiakkaan arjessa on merkittävä, sillä pyrkimyksenä on tukea ja mahdollistaa kotona asuminen mahdollisimman pitkään, sekä tarjota mahdollisuus aktiiviseen ja mielekkääseen arkeen toteuttaen asiakkaan itsemääräämisoikeutta.

jobs.title: Senior Construction Project Manager
jobs.description:
Elgin Values

Core behavioural responsibilities for all employees
 
Agility We Lead with Agility  Integrity We Act with IntegrityExcellence We Empower ExcellenceCareWe Value Care


Job Description

Are you an experienced construction project leader with the commercial acumen to deliver complex infrastructure projects while managing the expectations of lenders, investors and key stakeholders?

We are looking for an experienced Senior Construction Project Manager to fulfil the Client / Employer’s Representative role across Elgin’s utility-scale solar PV, BESS and co-located PV/BESS projects. The role is focused on leading multidisciplinary project teams within a single Elgin delivery framework, ensuring that finance, legal, engineering, procurement, construction, operations, route-to-market and external adviser inputs are coordinated into one clear project position from late stage development / FID through construction, commissioning, commercial operations and handover to Asset Management. Particular emphasis will be placed on lender, investor, SPV governance and internal delivery interfaces.
 
This role requires significant project and contract management experience, including direct involvement in project finance processes, lender due diligence, conditions precedent, drawdown evidence, lender reporting, waivers / consents and coordination with lender technical advisers. The successful candidate will need specific experience with FIDIC based Construction Contracts, strong commercial judgement, disciplined contract administration capability and the ability to translate project delivery status into clear funding, governance and decision-making outputs.
 
To be successful in the role, you will have experience representing a client, employer, sponsor or SPV in the delivery of complex infrastructure or renewable energy projects. You will be commercially astute, highly organised, confident leading multidisciplinary project teams through a common governance and delivery framework, and capable of engaging credibly with lenders, investors, advisers, contractors, shareholder forums and senior internal stakeholders.

What you will be do:

  • Fulfil the Client / Employer’s Representative role for allocated projects, ensuring Elgin’s SPV, governance, commercial and contractual obligations are actively managed from FID through COD and handover.
  • Lead project and contract management on project-financed assets, coordinating lender processes including conditions precedent, drawdown evidence, lender technical adviser queries, lender reporting, waivers / consents and funding milestone submissions.
  • Administer and manage high-value EPC, ICP and related project contracts, including notices, variations, claims, payment applications, completion milestones, liquidated damages, defects and close-out obligations.
  • Maintain disciplined project controls across programme, budget, cash flow, risk, actions, decisions and change, ensuring transparent reporting to senior management, SPV governance bodies, lenders and investors.
  • Act as the primary project coordination point between Elgin’s internal project team, finance, legal, procurement, engineering, construction, operations, route-to-market and external advisers, ensuring that all workstreams operate from one integrated delivery plan, one risk position and one set of decision requirements.
  • Lead and manage multidisciplinary internal project teams within Elgin’s agreed delivery framework by setting priorities, clarifying accountabilities, managing dependencies, aligning workstreams to project milestones and escalating decisions in a timely and structured manner.
  • Manage the relationship and reporting cadence with project finance lenders, equity investors, shareholder representatives, lender technical advisers and other key finance-facing stakeholders, including preparing and presenting clear, decision-ready updates for shareholder forums and related governance meetings.
  • Oversee contractor, owner’s engineer and technical adviser interfaces to ensure delivery evidence, technical outputs and contractual positions support Elgin’s funding, governance and employer obligations.
  • Proactively identify commercial, contractual, programme and financing risks, develop mitigation plans and ensure issues are escalated with clear options, recommendations and decision requirements.
  • Support tendering, contract negotiation and commercial strategy by ensuring delivery arrangements are bankable, financeable, contractually robust and aligned with lender / investor expectations.


Your profile

What you will need: 

  • Degree in project management, construction management, engineering, or similar.
  • Extensive experience in infrastructure, renewables, power, energy storage or comparable capital projects, with significant project and contract management responsibility.
  • Direct experience working on project-financed projects, including lender due diligence, , funding drawdowns, lender technical adviser processes and ongoing lender / investor reporting.
  • Strong understanding of the Client / Employer’s Representative role and experience representing an owner, SPV, sponsor or employer in the delivery of complex contracted projects.
  • Extensive experience administering FIDIC, EPC, ICP and construction management contracts, including notices, variations, claims, payment mechanisms, completion tests, liquidated damages and contractual close-out.
  • Demonstrable ability to lead multidisciplinary internal teams and align finance, legal, engineering, procurement, construction, operations and external adviser inputs around delivery milestones within a standardised delivery framework.
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, with the ability to assess risk versus reward, protect the employer’s position and communicate implications clearly to senior stakeholders.
  • Experience preparing and presenting concise, decision-ready reports for senior management, investment committees, SPV boards, lenders, investors, shareholder forums and other governance forums, with the ability to translate complex programme, commercial, technical and financing issues into clear options and recommendations.
  • Working knowledge of utility-scale solar PV, BESS, grid connection and route-to-market interfaces, with sufficient technical understanding to challenge contractors and advisers effectively.

Meillä työntekijät ovat tyytyväisiä moniammatilliseen yhteistyöhön, hoitotyön resursseihin ja ammatillisen kasvun mahdollisuuksiin.

jobs.title: Agentic AI Architect-Anthropic
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Agentic AI Architect-Anthropic based in United Kingdom.

As an Agentic AI Architect, you will shape and deliver enterprise-grade AI solutions that combine generative AI, machine learning, data, cloud technologies, and intelligent automation. You will design scalable architectures that connect Claude and other AI technologies with enterprise knowledge, applications, APIs, workflows, and mission-critical systems. The role offers significant technical ownership, from discovery and architecture through deployment, evaluation, governance, and optimization. You will work closely with client stakeholders, consultants, data engineers, AI/ML specialists, and platform teams to turn complex business needs into practical solutions. A strong focus will be placed on agentic workflows, RAG, tool use, structured outputs, responsible AI, and human oversight. This is an opportunity to work at the forefront of enterprise AI while helping organizations adopt powerful technologies securely and responsibly. Travel to clients and conferences may be required as needed.


Accountabilities
  • Architect, develop, deploy, and maintain scalable AI, machine learning, generative AI, and agentic AI solutions for enterprise use cases.
  • Define end-to-end architectures covering data ingestion and preparation, model selection, orchestration, APIs, integrations, user experiences, monitoring, security, and governance.
  • Partner with business and technical stakeholders to identify high-value AI opportunities, translate requirements into technical designs, and establish delivery roadmaps.
  • Lead technical discovery sessions, architecture workshops, design reviews, proof-of-concepts, demonstrations, and solution delivery activities.
  • Design and implement LLM-powered applications using Claude, Anthropic APIs, and other appropriate LLM platforms.
  • Apply prompt and context engineering techniques, including instruction design, few-shot examples, structured inputs and outputs, response constraints, and long-context management.
  • Architect secure RAG solutions using enterprise documents, knowledge bases, databases, and other approved information sources, including ingestion, chunking, embeddings, retrieval, reranking, citations, and response generation.
  • Build agentic systems capable of reasoning over enterprise context, using authorized tools, executing multi-step tasks, and coordinating workflows across enterprise applications.
  • Define agent roles, task boundaries, permissions, memory and context strategies, approval gates, fallback mechanisms, and escalation paths.
  • Integrate AI agents and workflows with ServiceNow, enterprise APIs, cloud services, databases, collaboration platforms, and operational systems.
  • Implement human-in-the-loop controls and safeguards for sensitive, high-impact, low-confidence, or exception-based actions.
  • Develop machine learning and NLP solutions for predictive analytics, classification, clustering, forecasting, anomaly detection, recommendation, document intelligence, summarization, and intelligent automation.
  • Build data-processing, feature-engineering, ETL/ELT, and model pipelines that support reliable training, deployment, monitoring, and data quality.
  • Design and implement AI solutions across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and/or Google Cloud, using services such as SageMaker, Lambda, S3, and Vertex AI where appropriate.
  • Develop supporting APIs, microservices, automation components, and integrations required to operationalize AI solutions.
  • Work with technologies such as Apache Spark, Snowflake, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and comparable data platforms.
  • Establish AI evaluation frameworks, test suites, representative datasets, regression testing, observability, monitoring, tracing, alerting, and feedback loops.
  • Measure and optimize AI solutions across accuracy, relevance, groundedness, safety, task completion, latency, cost, reliability, and user experience.
  • Implement responsible AI and security controls covering data privacy, access permissions, authentication, authorization, encryption, secrets management, auditability, prompt-injection defenses, output validation, and human review.
  • Document architecture decisions, system behavior, limitations, risk controls, operating procedures, and support requirements.
  • Design AI-enabled experiences and workflow automations for areas such as employee support, customer service, IT operations, knowledge management, chatbots, virtual agents, and workflow automation.
  • Create reusable implementation patterns, agent designs, integration components, evaluation assets, and accelerators to support enterprise AI delivery.
  • Develop dashboards and executive-ready reporting using tools such as Tableau and Power BI to demonstrate adoption, business value, operational performance, and model quality.
  • Travel to clients and conferences as required.

    • Requirements:

    • 10+ years of professional experience applying AI, machine learning, data science, software engineering, or intelligent automation technologies to practical enterprise use cases.
    • Strong hands-on programming skills in Python and SQL, with experience using TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, or comparable machine learning frameworks.
    • Proven experience architecting or delivering AI/ML, LLM, RAG, conversational AI, agentic AI, or AI-powered automation solutions.
    • Strong understanding of software architecture, algorithms, object-oriented programming, functional design principles, APIs, and integration patterns.
    • Practical knowledge of LLM application development, including prompt engineering, context management, tokens, embeddings, vector search, RAG, tool use, structured outputs, and model evaluation.
    • Experience with data-science libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, and Seaborn.
    • Hands-on experience with one or more major cloud platforms, particularly AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud.
    • Experience with big-data technologies and cloud data platforms, including Apache Spark and Snowflake.

You will take ownership of day-to-day product execution across our on-chain and off-chain workstreams, helping turn business and technical requirements into clearly defined, prioritised, and executable work.

Working closely with the Principal Product Manager, Engineering, Operations, Compliance, Finance, Treasury, and commercial teams, you will support initiatives including liquidity-provider integrations, asset availability, routing and best-execution capabilities, custody and wallet infrastructure, and the broader on-chain services required to operate reliably at scale.

Your work will help the team move faster, improve the efficiency and resilience of our liquidity infrastructure, and enable MoonPay to support significantly more products and transaction volume as the business grows.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, wants to deepen their understanding of crypto and financial infrastructure, and is excited to develop their product craft in a fast-moving, high-impact environment.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Fellow in Robotics and Computer Vision
jobs.description:
The European Spallation Source (ESS) is one of the largest science and technology infrastructure projects being built today. ESS will soon be the world’s most powerful source of neutrons, providing researchers with unique opportunities to explore the structure of materials at the atomic level. Neutron scattering at ESS will address critical questions in physics, chemistry, geology, materials science and life science.

ESS is now inviting applications for a Postdoctoral Fellow or Research Engineer in robotics and computer vision to work within the ASTRIND project to conduct research on, develop, and integrate an automated sample alignment system based on robotics and computer vision for the BEER instrument at ESS.

About the ASTRIND project:

Funded by the Röntgen-Ångström Cluster, this German-Swedish collaboration aims to enhance strain and texture measurements at ESS’s BEER diffractometer by transferring and extending robotic, vision, and simulation technologies developed at STRESS-SPEC (MLZ Munich). The project will improve alignment, motion planning, and sample exchange through multi-view camera tracking, integrated robot and hexapod control, and a BEER digital twin for calibration, collision-aware trajectory planning, and workflow validation. Additional tools for 3D-based measurement-point selection and in-situ digital image correlation will support advanced experiments. Cross-facility demonstrations between BEER and STRESS-SPEC will establish reproducible, standardized, and higher-throughput engineering diffraction workflows with improved data quality and industrial relevance.

About the role:

This position combines robotics, computer vision, software development, and moderate amount of experimental work with neutron diffraction technique to support the development and deployment of advanced sample alignment systems for the BEER instrument.

Your key responsibilities will include:

    Designing the system architecture (robot, cameras, auxiliary equipment) and propose hardware specifications, balancing performance requirements against the ASTRIND budget.
    Leading the integration of the sample robot, cameras, and auxiliary systems with the site-wide integrated control system (EPICS) and the neutron scattering control system (NICOS).
    Defining the data handling and user interfaces required for routine use of automated alignment during experiments.
    Planning and carrying out testing, commissioning, and validation of the system.
    Writing technical documentation

Depending on who we appoint into this position, you may also be:

    Conducting research and supervising master’s students on robotics and computer vision methods for automated sample alignment in neutron scattering applications.
    Publishing these research results in peer-reviewed journals and at conferences to strengthen the scientific output of the project.

This is a grant funded, fixed-term position for a period of three years. The role also requires the flexibility for occasional travel, including visits to project partners in Munich.

About you:

To succeed in this role, you need a strong background in robotics, mechatronics, automatic control, computer vision, or a very closely related field. This must be supported by either a PhD or an engineering degree together with relevant professional experience. You are motivated by the opportunity to work at the intersection of advanced instrumentation, software integration, and experimental science within a large-scale international research facility.

You bring solid hands-on experience in robotics and computer vision, including system integration, motion control, sensor or camera systems, and software development for automated or semi-automated platforms. You are comfortable working across both hardware and software layers and enjoy turning complex technical requirements into reliable operational systems.

You have strong programming and software engineering skills, particularly in Python and C/C++, and are confident working in Linux environments, using version control systems such as Git, and developing within frameworks such as ROS. Experience with CAD software and mechanical system design is also expected.

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be an advantage:

    Integration of robotic systems with scientific or industrial control systems.
    Machine vision, calibration, or multi-camera tracking systems.
    Motion planning, simulation, or digital twin environments.
    Experimental automation in research or large-scale infrastructure environments.
    EPICS, NICOS, neutron or synchrotron instrumentation, or similar scientific facilities.

For candidates applying at the postdoctoral level, experience of publishing research results and contributing to scientific projects is highly valued. Experience supervising students or mentoring junior colleagues would also be beneficial.

As a person, you are collaborative, proactive, and curious, with a strong interest in learning and developing new skills. You communicate clearly and work effectively with engineers, scientists, software developers, and technical staff from different disciplines and cultural backgrounds. You are comfortable working both independently and as part of an international team, and you have excellent written and spoken English skills.

To apply:

A career at ESS gives you the opportunity to contribute to the future discoveries within neutron science at a stunning, brand-new workplace filled with innovative minds and brilliant people from across the globe. We offer individualised compensation which is differentiated according to role, responsibilities, individual skills, abilities and achievements as well as monthly pension contributions on top of your salary.

If you see yourself in what we’re looking for, please provide your CV and motivation letter in English by clicking on “apply” and following the instructions. Please be aware that we can only accept direct applications made via the ESS website.

This role might require enhanced security screening processes, which will be performed during the recruitment process if needed.

For further information about the project please contact Gergely Németh, mailto:gergely.nemeth@ess.eu or Karin Rathsman, mailto:karin.rathsman@ess.eu.

For trade union information, please contact Unionen representative Nerusha Naicker on mailto:erusha.Naicker@ess.eu or SACO/Swedish Association of Graduate Engineers representative Marc Kickulies at mailto:marc.kickulies@ess.eu

jobs.title: Research Engineer in Robotics and Computer Vision
jobs.description:
The European Spallation Source (ESS) is one of the largest science and technology infrastructure projects being built today. ESS will soon be the world’s most powerful source of neutrons, providing researchers with unique opportunities to explore the structure of materials at the atomic level. Neutron scattering at ESS will address critical questions in physics, chemistry, geology, materials science and life science.

ESS is now inviting applications for a Postdoctoral Fellow or Research Engineer in robotics and computer vision to work within the ASTRIND project to conduct research on, develop, and integrate an automated sample alignment system based on robotics and computer vision for the BEER instrument at ESS.

About the ASTRIND project:

Funded by the Röntgen-Ångström Cluster, this German-Swedish collaboration aims to enhance strain and texture measurements at ESS’s BEER diffractometer by transferring and extending robotic, vision, and simulation technologies developed at STRESS-SPEC (MLZ Munich). The project will improve alignment, motion planning, and sample exchange through multi-view camera tracking, integrated robot and hexapod control, and a BEER digital twin for calibration, collision-aware trajectory planning, and workflow validation. Additional tools for 3D-based measurement-point selection and in-situ digital image correlation will support advanced experiments. Cross-facility demonstrations between BEER and STRESS-SPEC will establish reproducible, standardized, and higher-throughput engineering diffraction workflows with improved data quality and industrial relevance.

About the role:

This position combines robotics, computer vision, software development, and moderate amount of experimental work with neutron diffraction technique to support the development and deployment of advanced sample alignment systems for the BEER instrument.

Your key responsibilities will include:

    Designing the system architecture (robot, cameras, auxiliary equipment) and propose hardware specifications, balancing performance requirements against the ASTRIND budget.
    Leading the integration of the sample robot, cameras, and auxiliary systems with the site-wide integrated control system (EPICS) and the neutron scattering control system (NICOS).
    Defining the data handling and user interfaces required for routine use of automated alignment during experiments.
    Planning and carrying out testing, commissioning, and validation of the system.
    Writing technical documentation

Depending on who we appoint into this position, you may also be:

    Conducting research and supervising master’s students on robotics and computer vision methods for automated sample alignment in neutron scattering applications.
    Publishing these research results in peer-reviewed journals and at conferences to strengthen the scientific output of the project.

The role also requires the flexibility for occasional travel, including visits to project partners in Munich.

About you:

To succeed in this role, you need a strong background in robotics, mechatronics, automatic control, computer vision, or a very closely related field. This must be supported by either a PhD or an engineering degree together with relevant professional experience. You are motivated by the opportunity to work at the intersection of advanced instrumentation, software integration, and experimental science within a large-scale international research facility.

You bring solid hands-on experience in robotics and computer vision, including system integration, motion control, sensor or camera systems, and software development for automated or semi-automated platforms. You are comfortable working across both hardware and software layers and enjoy turning complex technical requirements into reliable operational systems.

You have strong programming and software engineering skills, particularly in Python and C/C++, and are confident working in Linux environments, using version control systems such as Git, and developing within frameworks such as ROS. Experience with CAD software and mechanical system design is also expected.

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be an advantage:

    Integration of robotic systems with scientific or industrial control systems.
    Machine vision, calibration, or multi-camera tracking systems.
    Motion planning, simulation, or digital twin environments.
    Experimental automation in research or large-scale infrastructure environments.
    EPICS, NICOS, neutron or synchrotron instrumentation, or similar scientific facilities.

For candidates applying at the postdoctoral level, experience of publishing research results and contributing to scientific projects is highly valued. Experience supervising students or mentoring junior colleagues would also be beneficial.

As a person, you are collaborative, proactive, and curious, with a strong interest in learning and developing new skills. You communicate clearly and work effectively with engineers, scientists, software developers, and technical staff from different disciplines and cultural backgrounds. You are comfortable working both independently and as part of an international team, and you have excellent written and spoken English skills.

To apply:

A career at ESS gives you the opportunity to contribute to the future discoveries within neutron science at a stunning, brand-new workplace filled with innovative minds and brilliant people from across the globe. We offer individualised compensation which is differentiated according to role, responsibilities, individual skills, abilities and achievements as well as monthly pension contributions on top of your salary.

If you see yourself in what we’re looking for, please provide your CV and motivation letter in English by clicking on “apply” and following the instructions. Please be aware that we can only accept direct applications made via the ESS website.

This role might require enhanced security screening processes, which will be performed during the recruitment process if needed.

For further information about the project please contact Gergely Németh, gergely.nemeth@ess.eu or Karin Rathsman, karin.rathsman@ess.eu.

For trade union information, please contact Unionen representative Nerusha Naicker on Nerusha.Naicker@ess.eu or SACO/Swedish Association of Graduate Engineers representative Marc Kickulies at marc.kickulies@ess.eu

jobs.title: Occupational Health & Safety Coordinator - Fitness Centre
jobs.description:
Position purpose

The Occupational Health & Safety Coordinator is responsible for maintaining a safe, healthy, clean and well-organised environment for customers, employees and visitors of the fitness centre. The role combines occupational health and safety coordination, facility cleanliness and hygiene, safety administration, and customer support. The position also has particular responsibility for welcoming, advising and guiding international and non-Finnish-speaking customers.

Key responsibilities

Coordinate the fitness centre's occupational health and safety activities and support compliance with applicable workplace health and safety requirements.

Conduct regular workplace and facility inspections, hazard identification and risk assessments, identify potential safety risks, and coordinate corrective and preventive actions.

Maintain safety documentation, including risk assessments, inspection records, incident reports, safety instructions, training records and other relevant OHS documentation.

Support incident investigation and follow-up, report safety concerns, and help implement measures to prevent recurrence.

Coordinate and maintain practical emergency preparedness, first-aid and fire-safety arrangements and provide safety guidance to employees when required.

Monitor the cleanliness, hygiene and general condition of the fitness centre, including training areas, changing rooms, sanitary facilities, reception and other customer areas.

Perform and coordinate routine cleaning duties and ensure that cleaning materials, hygiene products, first-aid supplies and other essential facility supplies are adequately maintained.

Identify safety, cleanliness, hygiene or facility deficiencies and ensure that they are reported and addressed promptly.

Welcome and assist international and non-Finnish-speaking customers, provide orientation to the fitness centre and explain facilities, access procedures, safety practices, rules and appropriate use of the premises.

Support reception and front-of-house operations when required, including customer check-in, visitor management, answering enquiries, telephone communication and general administrative record keeping.

Promote a proactive safety culture and contribute to a professional, welcoming and well-organised customer environment.

Requirements

NEBOSH certificate completed within 5 years (or alternatively, NEBOSH course active with graduation before the commencement of the work).

Professional OHS certifications: Hazard Identification & Risk Assessment (HIRA), Basic Fire Fighting, Basic First Aid, Incident Investigation and Legal Liability.

Excellent command of English, both spoken and written, enabling professional customer service, safety communication, guidance and documentation in an international environment.

Relevant occupational health and safety competence and the ability to conduct workplace inspections, identify hazards and maintain safety documentation.

Strong customer-service, communication, organisational and administrative skills.

Relevant competence

The role utilises competence in occupational health and safety, SHE representation, workplace inspections, hazard identification and risk assessment, safety documentation, incident investigation, first aid, fire safety, administration and front-desk customer service.

jobs.title: Quality Manager
jobs.description:
At VARD, we create innovative and sustainable solutions for the global maritime industry. Through strong engineering expertise, cutting-edge technology, and close collaboration, we design and build some of the world’s most advanced vessels.

At the same time, we believe our people are our greatest strength. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment where talent can grow, ideas are valued, and individuals are empowered to make a difference.

VARD Electro is a leading supplier of maritime electrical systems, automation, integration, and energy solutions for vessels operating worldwide. With a strong focus on innovation, digitalization, and sustainability, we develop advanced technologies that help our customers improve efficiency, safety, and environmental performance. As part of the VARD Group, we work closely with shipowners, designers, and shipyards to shape the future of the maritime industry.

We are currently looking for a Quality Manager to join our team. In this role, you will have the opportunity to apply your expertise, collaborate with skilled colleagues, and contribute to exciting projects across the VARD value chain.

Ready to make an impact at VARD?


Duties and responsibilities
  • Lead the development and continuous improvement of the Vard Electro Management System.
  • Drive a strong quality culture and promote quality awareness across the organization.
  • Advise management on quality management principles, requirements, and best practices.
  • Ensure compliance with ISO 9001 and support certification activities.
  • Promote risk-based thinking, risk management, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Monitor quality performance through KPIs and report results to management.
  • Lead internal audit programs, conduct audits, and develop auditor competence.
  • Support process owners and subsidiaries in improving and aligning management systems.
  • Coordinate management reviews, improvement projects, and organizational learning activities.
  • Provide training related to quality management, audits and Synergi life.
Qualifications
  • Relevant experience 
  • Knowledge and experience with the ISO 9001 standard (or similar).

VARD works systematically for inclusion and diversity and encourage everyone to apply, even if your competence does not match 100% the above. 

This employment may require a background check, or security clearance by the Norwegian National Security Authority.

Personal qualities
  • Good knowledge of Norwegian and English, both orally and written
  • Good cooperation and communications skills
  • Structured and solution oriented.
  • Identify yourself with the VARD values Craftmanship, Salesmanship and Fellowship.
Our commitment to you 
  • A good working environment with exciting and important tasks in an international environment 
  • Competitive pension scheme and insurance package 
  • Subsidized lunch in the office canteen 
  • Subsidized membership at the gym 
  • Occupational health service 
  • Flexible work from home policy 
  • Free mobile phone usage 
  • Central office location and free parking
  • We understand the importance of continuous learning and we strive to give you the chance to gain new skills and further develop your career

 

VARD recognizes the importance of having fun at work, this is why with Social by VARD you will have the chance to bond with colleagues through new experiences and shared interests. The social offer varies throughout the year and includes activities like 'walk and talk' during lunch hours, fjord cruises, cooking lessons, go karting, football practices and wine tasting, just to name a few. 

With the right blend of fun, expertise and hard work, we are creating ships for the future. Join us!

Vard Electro is a globally recognized and trusted provider and advisor of marine electrical systems. Established in Norway in 1997, Vard Electro has today approx. 900 employees based in Norway, Romania, Brazil, Singapore, India, Italy, UK, Canada, USA and Vietnam, and operating worldwide.

jobs.title: We are looking for a new Marketing Performance Analyst
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about turning data into decisions and insights into growth? Do you enjoy uncovering what drives marketing performance and using analytics to optimize results across channels and markets? If so, you might be the Marketing Performance Analyst we are looking for.

We are seeking a curious, analytical, and commercially minded professional who thrives at the intersection of marketing, technology, and data. You are naturally driven by numbers, but you also understand the business stories behind them. You enjoy creating meaningful reports, and helping teams make smarter decisions based on facts rather than assumptions.

In this role, you will become a key contributor to our international marketing team, helping us improve campaign performance, strengthen our digital presence, and maximize the return on our marketing investments. You will work closely with colleagues across marketing and sales with transforming complex data into clear insights that create real business value.

  • Campaign and communication optimization: Monitor, testing and optimizing daily performance metrics across all marketing channels (organic and paid search, social media, newsletters and other relevant channels)

  • Segmentation: Develop target audiences and personalization of customer communications

  • Strong understanding of digital marketing

  • Proven ability to build dashboards in Looker Studio, or BI-system.
  • Strong understanding of core metrics like ROAS, CPA, CTR, conversions etc.
  • Experience with advanced data modeling, setting up multi-touch attribution frameworks.
  • Certifications in Google Analytics and major ad platforms (Google Ads, Meta).

What can we offer?

  • Position in a growing international company, headquartered in Norway.

jobs.title: Assistant Workplace lead
jobs.description:
CBRE Global Workplace Solutions is a leading global provider of integrated facilities and corporate real estate management. We are recruiting for an Assistant Workplace Lead to join our team in Stockholm. This is a great opportunity for an experienced and enthusiastic candidate to join a global account team.

As Assistant Workplace Lead you will deputize to the Workplace Operations Lead, providing strategic support and operational leadership across campus. This role drives operational excellence, leads improvement projects, and supports governance and reporting activities to ensure high-quality service delivery and customer satisfaction.

Acting as a trusted partner to the Workplace Operations Lead, this role ensures continuity of leadership, drives operational initiatives, and maintains strong relationships with stakeholders and service partners. The Assistant Lead plays a critical role in translating strategic vision into operational execution, supporting the team to deliver consistent, efficient, and customer-focused facilities services across all sites within the geographical scope.

What You'll Do:

Client relationship and stakeholder engagement


    Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders across campus and act a senior point of contact

    Represent CBRE interests and teams while aligning with the client's needs and expectations

    Support in client engagement activities and service review meetings with senior stakeholders

    Communicate operational updates, changes, and improvements to stakeholders in both English and Swedish

    Foster collaborative relationships with service providers and suppliers


Finance, governance and reporting


    Be well-versed in CBRE's contractual commitments, including financial, commercial and performance models and ensure operational compliance with contractual obligations

    Collate, prepare and analyse performance and governance reports to enable client sign off

    Collaborate with Workplace operations- lead, managers and Finance teams to prepare accurate forecasts, financial performance reviews and budget drafts

    Develop and maintain operational reports, dashboards, and performance metrics to help the team and client to better understand the operational output

    Prepare analysis and presentations on operational performance, key performance indicators, customer satisfaction and trends and make recommendations for improvements and service adjustments


Leadership and team support


    Support the Workplace Operations Lead in team leadership and management

    Provide guidance, coaching, and support to Workplace Operations Managers

    Foster a culture focused on service excellence, proactiveness and continuous improvement

    Support performance management activities, succession planning and team development initiatives

    Drive the one team and service first mindset across campus alongside the client

    Review and sign off on annual leave and other resource planning activities


Operational leadership and site management


    Support the Workplace Operations Lead in overseeing facilities operations and service delivery

    Good understanding of CBRE's contractual commitments, including statement of work, matrix of responsibility and service level agreements in order to translate these into effective deliverables for the teams in collaboration with the Workplace operations lead

    Act as deputy to the Workplace Operations Lead, providing leadership continuity in their absence

    Monitor service delivery performance and identify areas requiring attention or improvement and coordinate with Workplace operations managers to resolve challenges and implement improvements

    Working closely with QHSE- and operational teams to ensure sites are fully compliant with the client's and CBRE's QHSE standards

    Ensure health and safety policies and observations are logged to minimize risk exposure and enable a safe workplace environment

    Review and sign off all campus applicable risk assessments together with the Workplace Operations Manager


Improvement projects and strategic initiatives


    Lead and manage improvement projects to enhance operational efficiency and service quality

    Identify opportunities for process improvements and implement solutions

    Drive continuous improvement initiatives across campus operations

    Be an active participant in our vendor care program, working closely with strategically important service partners across the contract

    Support implementation of transformational change programs, including the Evolve program

    Analyse operational data and trends to inform strategic decision-making

    Program manage key projects, acting as a conduit between the client and CBRE's operational and project teams


Working hours and location

This position is based at the client's premises in Kista, Stockholm. This role requires onsite presence Monday to Friday, 08:00 to 17:00, depending on business needs. Occasional travel to other locations may be required.

Växa är ett ledande kunskapsföretag för lantbrukare med mjölk-, köttproduktion och växtodling. Genom den rådgivning och service vi säljer bidrar vi med ökad konkurrenskraft för svenskt lantbruk. Vår omsättning är drygt 560 miljoner kronor och vi har cirka 500 medarbetare fördelade på 27 driftsplatser över hela landet. Hållbarhet är centralt för oss, och våra kunder och Växa står för klimatsmart produktion och god djurhälsa.

About the Workplace

Växa is a leading knowledge-based company serving farmers within dairy, meat production, and crop cultivation. Through the advisory services and support we provide, we contribute to strengthening the competitiveness of Swedish agriculture. Our annual turnover exceeds SEK 560 million, and we employ approximately 500 people across 27 operational locations throughout the country. Sustainability is central to our mission, and together with our customers, Växa promotes climate‑smart production and high standards of animal health.

At Växa, you will find opportunities for development, attractive benefits, and dedicated colleagues. Together, we make a meaningful difference for our customers and members — and it truly shows.

Du har ett lokalt team att luta dig mot men vi förväntar oss att du tar egna initiativ, har ett sinne för ordning och reda och kan arbeta självständigt.

Vi säljer VikingGenetics avelsmaterial och rådgivning till våra kunder. Blir du en av oss kommer du att vara en del i att utveckla framtidens hållbara kor och arbeta för att utveckla svensk animalieproduktion i nära samarbete med lantbrukare och våra andra rådgivare.

    Har B-körkort och gillar att köra bil

jobs.title: Juniora revisionskonsulter | Assurance | Halmstad

    Goda språkkunskaper i svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift
