jobs.title: PhD Fellow in Distributed Acoustic Sensing for Arctic Railway Infrastructure Monitoring
jobs.employer: UNIVERSITETET I TROMSØ - NORGES ARKTISKE UNIVERSITET UIT CAMPUS NARVIK
jobs.description:
The position

A PhD position is available at the Department of Electrical Engineering (IET), Faculty of Engineering Sciences and Technology, UiT The Arctic University of Norway. The position is within the field of distributed fibre-optic sensing for railway infrastructure monitoring, with particular emphasis on the use of Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) for monitoring railway infrastructure and natural hazards along the Ofoten Line.

The position is for a period of four years. The nominal length of the PhD programme is three years. The fourth year is distributed as 25 % each year and will consist of teaching and other duties. The objective of the position is to complete research training to the level of a doctoral degree. Admission to the PhD programme is a prerequisite for employment, and the programme period starts on commencement of the position.

The workplace is at UiT in Narvik. You must be able to start in the position within a reasonable time after receiving the offer.


The position’s field of research

The position is associated with a new research initiative at UiT on intelligent monitoring and resilience of railway and transport infrastructure in Arctic environments that aims to address how distributed sensing, fibre-optic monitoring, environmental observations, drone- and satellite-based data, operational infrastructure datasets, and/or machine learning can be used to support real-time monitoring, predictive maintenance, geohazard detection, and safer railway operations. The initiative is a collaboration between the Department of Electrical Engineering, the Department of Computer Science and Computational Engineering, and the Department of Geosciences.
Research infrastructure is provided via existing data, sensor networks, and established field sites along the Ofoten Line and new initiatives associated with the Arctic Test Arena project.

Railway infrastructure in Arctic and Nordic regions is increasingly exposed to harsh weather, heavy traffic loads, climate-related hazards, and growing operational demands. Current railway monitoring systems still rely largely on manual inspections and periodic measurements. This makes it challenging to detect early signs of infrastructure degradation, vibration-related damage, geohazards, snow avalanches, rockfalls, landslides, track irregularities, wheel defects, bearing faults, and people and animals on the track.

The PhD project will investigate how existing fibre-optic cable infrastructure along the Ofoten line railway, one of Norway’s most strategically important and climate-exposed railways, can be used as a distributed sensor network for continuous infrastructure monitoring. Standard optical fibres will be used as dense arrays of vibration sensors, making it possible to measure dynamic strain and acoustic disturbances along many kilometres of fibre with down to metre-scale spatial resolution – a technique coined Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS). The long-term ambition is to enable high-resolution, real-time warning and decision support for railway operations and maintenance.

The successful candidate will work on developing, testing, modelling, and validating methods for DAS-based monitoring of railway infrastructure and surrounding terrain. The work can include physics-based modelling of e.g., various events and wave propagation through different media, signal processing, large-scale data analysis, algorithm development and potentially also field work.

The applicants must present a description outlining the academic basis of the PhD project. The project description shall not exceed 2 pages, including reference lists/figures/tables if relevant. It must include a description of the topic, research question(s) and a reasoning of the choices. It should also indicate the methodologies to be used. The final project description will be developed in cooperation with the supervisor.


Qualifications

This position requires a master’s degree or equivalent in applied mathematics, signal processing, physics, geophysics, civil engineering (electrical, geotechnical, structural, environmental, transportation, construction, computer etc.), data/computer science or similar. If you are near completion of your master’s degree, you may still apply.

Applicants must document good English skills and be able to work in an international environment. Nordic applicants can document their English capabilities by attaching their high school diploma.

The candidate should have expertise in data analysis and be able to implement data analysis tools in a suitable programming language. It is also advantageous with knowledge and/or capabilities in one or more of the following topics:

  • Signal processing
  • Physical/geophysical modelling
  • Computer science
  • Geohazards
  • Waves and fields
  • Material science

In the assessment, the emphasis is on the applicant's potential to complete a research education based on the master's thesis or equivalent, and any other scientific work. Evaluation of the candidate is not only based on the candidates track record in education, but other experiences that can be relevant for the PhD work. This includes teaching, practical experience with e.g., railway infrastructure and/or other relevant work or activities. The project description will also be considered. In addition, professional experience and other experience of significance for the completion of the doctoral programme will be taken into consideration.

We will also emphasize motivation and personal suitability for the position. We are looking for candidates who:

  • Have good communication and interaction with colleagues and students
  • Can contribute to a positive and productive working environment
  • Are able to work both independently and in groups on defined research topics
  • Have good work ethics

As many people as possible should have the opportunity to undertake organized research training. If you already hold a PhD or have equivalent competence, we will not appoint you to this position.


Admission to the PhD programme 

For employment in the PhD position, you must be qualified for admission to the PhD programme at the Faculty of Engineering Science and Technology and participate in organized doctoral studies within the employment period.

Admission normally requires:  

  • A bachelor's degree of 180 ECTS and a master's degree of 120 ECTS, or an integrated master's degree of 300 ECTS. 
  • A master's thesis with a scope corresponding to at least 30 ECTS for a master's degree of 120 ECTS. 
  • A master's thesis with a scope corresponding to at least 20 ECTS for an integrated master's degree of 300 ECTS. 

 

In order to gain admission to the programme, applicants with a background from a Norwegian institution should have a minimum grade of C on their master thesis and a weighted grade average of 3.0 for the last two years of their master programme. A more detailed description of admission requirements can be found here. 

If you are employed in the position, you will be provisionally admitted to the PhD programme. Application for final admission must be submitted no later than two months after taking up the position. 

Applicants with a foreign education will be subjected to an evaluation of whether the educational background is equal to Norwegian higher education, following national guidelines from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills. Depending on which country the education is from, one or two additional years of university education may be required to fulfil admission requirements, e.g. a 4-year bachelor's degree and a 2-year master's degree. UiT normally accepts higher education from countries that are part of the Lisbon Recognition Convention.


Inclusion and diversity

UiT The Arctic University of Norway is working actively to promote equality, gender balance and diversity among employees and students, and to create an inclusive and safe working environment. We believe that inclusion and diversity are a strength, and we want employees with different competencies, professional experience, life experience and perspectives.

If you have a disability, a gap in your CV or immigrant background, we encourage you to tick the box for this in your application. If there are qualified applicants, we invite at least one in each group for an interview. If you get the job, we will adapt the working conditions if you need it. Apart from selecting the right candidates, we will only use the information for anonymous statistics.


We offer
  • A dynamic and expanding research environment 
  • Good career opportunities 
  • A supportive academic community with committed colleagues
  • Flexible working hours and a state collective pay agreement  
  • Pension scheme through the state pension fund 
  • PhD Fellows are normally given a salary of 580 000 NOK/year with a 3% yearly increase

Norwegian health policy aims to ensure that everyone, irrespective of their personal finances and where they live, has access to good health and care services of equal standard. As an employee you will become member of the National Insurance Scheme which also include health care services.

More practical information about working and living in Norway can be found here: https://uit.no/staffmobility


Application 

Please note that the application will only be assessed based on the information submitted by the application deadline via Jobbnorge. It is therefore important that you include all necessary documents demonstrating your qualifications for the position.

Your application must include: 

  • Cover letter explaining your motivation and research interests (max 1 page)
  • CV
  • Official diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degree in the original language 
  • Official transcripts of grades/academic record for Bachelor's and Master's degree in the original language
  • Official translation of diplomas and transcripts of records (ToR) to English or a Scandinavian language, if applicable
  • Explanation of the grading system for foreign education (Diploma Supplement if available)
  • Documentation of English proficiency
  • 2-3 references with contact information
  • Master’s thesis, and any other academic works
  • Project description  (max 2 pages references included)

Qualification with a master’s degree is required before commencement in the position. If you are near completion of your master’s degree, you may still apply and submit a draft version of the thesis and a statement from your supervisor or institution indicating when the degree will be obtained. You must still submit your transcript of grades for the master’s degree with your application.

All documentation to be considered must be in a Scandinavian language or English. If your diplomas and transcripts are written in a different language, you must upload both an English/Scandinavian translation and the originals. If English proficiency is not documented in the application, it must be documented before starting in the position. Applications and supporting documentation are only accepted via Jobbnorge and must be submitted within the application deadline.


Assessment 

The applicants will be assessed by an expert committee. The committee's mandate is to undertake an assessment of the applicants' qualifications based on the written material presented by the applicants, and the detailed description draw up for the position. A copy of the assessment report will be sent to all applicants. 

The applicants who are assessed as best qualified will be called to an interview. The interview should among other things, aim to clarify the applicant’s motivation and personal suitability for the position. 


General information 

The appointment is made in accordance with State regulations and guidelines at UiT. At our website, you will find more information for applicants. 

The engagement is to be made in accordance with the acts relating to Control of the Export of Strategic Goods, Services and Technology. Candidates who by assessment of the application and attachment are seen to conflict with the criteria in the latter law will be prohibited from recruitment. After the appointment you must assume that there may be changes in the area of work.

Remuneration for the position of PhD Fellow is in accordance with the State salary scale code 1017. A compulsory contribution of 2 % to the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund will be deducted. You will become a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund, which gives you many benefits in addition to a lifelong pension: You may be entitled to financial support if you become ill or disabled, your family may be entitled to financial support when you die, you become insured against occupational injury or occupational disease, and you can get good terms on a mortgage. Read more about your employee benefits at: spk.no.

A shorter period of appointment may be decided when the PhD Fellow has already completed parts of their research training programme or when the appointment is based on a previous qualifying position PhD Fellow, research assistant, or the like in such a way that the total time used for research training amounts to three years. 

We process personal data given in an application or CV in accordance with the Personal Data Act (Offentleglova). According to the Personal Data Act information about the applicant may be included in the public applicant list, also in cases where the applicant has requested non-disclosure. You will receive advance notification in the event of such publication, if you have requested non-disclosure. 


Om arbeidsgiveren:

UiT The Arctic University of Norway is an internationally leading broad-based university. Our vision is to be a driving force in the North. The Northern Sami term eallju, which means diligence, sets the tone for UiT's drive. Together with students, staff, and society at large, we will utilize our location in Northern Norway and Sápmi, our academic breadth, and interdisciplinary advantages to shape the future.

UiT has approximately 18,000 students, more than 4,000 employees, and is established across four main campuses and seven additional study locations in Northern Norway and on Svalbard. Our largest campuses are Tromsø, Alta, Narvik, and Harstad. UiT has seven faculties, 40 departments and centers, and leading research environments in various fields. The university offers 269 study programs and focuses on educational quality.

Academic freedom, scientific principles, and research ethics form the foundation of all UiT's activities. Participation, co-determination, transparency, and sound processes will provide the basis for making wise and forward-looking decisions. Our students and staff will have the opportunity to develop their abilities and potential. Rooted in scientific integrity, we aim to be bold, engaged, and generous - closely connected to academia, people, and contemporary developments.

Read more about UiT's strategy towards 2030.

jobs.title: Workshop Mechanic - Gadbjerg, near Vejle, Denmark
jobs.description:
About us

We run a workshop about 15 km from Vejle in East Jutland, Denmark, in close partnership between GMT and Nordic Rebar ApS. You will be employed by Nordic Rebar ApS, which is based at the workshop.
GMT trades in used machinery for the rebar industry and is a well-known player in the industry across most of the world.
Together, we hold a large stock of used machines that continuously need to be inspected and refurbished, and we are therefore looking for a mechanic who will make the workshop his or her permanent base.

About the job

As a workshop mechanic, you will be responsible for keeping the workshop running and the machines in good order. Your tasks will include:

·         Repair and preparation of used machines for the rebar industry
·         Loading and unloading machines and accessories using a forklift truck (a valid forklift/truck licence is required)
·         General maintenance and tidiness in the workshop

The workshop has an office attached to it, so you will have good colleagues around you, and we have lunch together.

The workshop has modern facilities, including a laser cleaner for removing rust and dirt, and we place great emphasis on the work being carried out safely and properly.

In the workshop itself you will typically be the only mechanic on a daily basis, so you must be able to plan and carry out your tasks independently.
 
We expect you to

·         Have a technical/trade background, e.g. as a car or truck mechanic, industrial electrician, or mechatronics technician, with good mechanical aptitude
·         Have at least 10 years of relevant work experience
·         Hold a valid forklift/truck licence
·         Be responsible and have a can-do attitude
·         Be able to work independently and organise your own working day
·         Not be afraid of getting dirty
·         Understand and speak English
·         Be an EU citizen
 
Terms of employment

This is a permanent position with Nordic Rebar ApS, on the terms and under the rules and legislation applicable in Denmark.
·         Starting salary: EUR 25 per hour, paid monthly
·         Weekly working hours: 37 hours - overtime may occur and can possibly be compensated with time off, among other things to allow for more frequent trips home, if needed
·         Start date: as soon as possible
·         Workplace: Gadbjerg, approx. 15 km from Vejle
·         Accommodation (a smaller apartment/room) can be arranged locally - expected rent approx. DKK 4,000-5,000 per month max
 
Application

Applications should be sent by e-mail to ud@gmtaps.com.

Questions are welcome and can be directed to Ulrich Deichmann, GMT, tel. +45 20 98 94 44, or Arne Hansen, Nordic Rebar ApS, tel. +45 51 46 20 50.

“You will be part of a team of fantastic and competent colleagues who prioritise teamwork and a ‘winning as a team’ mentality. Our team values a flexible work atmosphere with an emphasis on balancing work and personal life, as well as opportunities for professional growth. In this role, you will have great opportunities to bring your own ideas to the table and play a key role in shaping our projects and services.”                                                              – Christian Poulsen, Head of MV & HV Service

Your tasks & responsibilities 

As a Senior Service Engineer, you will be responsible for managing and executing MV & HV Service projects from a technical perspective in collaboration with cross-functional teams, external partners, and customers. Moreover, you will apply your expertise hands-on by using your specialist knowledge to execute the service. You will be responsible from the initiation and tendering of the project through to delivering a solution and finally executing it offshore. This will involve collaborating with various teams across the organisation and externally.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to:
  • You will have end-to-end technical responsibility for specific projects in the MV & HV Service team, from tendering, clarification, and planning to execution.
  • Provide technical assistance and calculations to support projects across the organisation.
  • Perform hands-on offshore special technical testing and troubleshooting.
  • Coordinate and plan work packages for execution, both on- and offshore.

Your profile & qualifications

As a person, you enjoy having a lot of responsibility and thrive in an environment where you communicate daily with many stakeholders. You are driven by completing tasks to the best of your ability and remain in control, even in fast-paced situations. You have a safety-focused mindset and never compromise when it comes to safety on the job. Additionally, you are service-minded and greatly enjoy collaborating with your colleagues.

To succeed in this position, we imagine that you have:

  • An engineering degree or similar qualification within electrical systems.
  • Broad know-how of MV and HV systems and technologies from the offshore wind industry.
  • In-depth knowledge of electrical systems.
  • A proven track record of servicing protection systems for both low voltage and high voltage.
  • Broad knowledge of electrical systems: high, medium, and low voltage.
  • Desire and willingness to travel and perform hands-on onsite work.
  • Fluency in English, written and verbal.

Welcome to Semco Maritime 
At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. 

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. 

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. 
So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   

Care to join the movement? 

Change. With us. 

We conduct our interviews on an ongoing basis, so if you are interested, you must submit your application as soon as possible via the link on the page.
If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Christian Poulsen, Head of MV & HV Service at +45 2294 4199.

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

jobs.title: Myyntitiimin Päällikkö
jobs.description:
Haemme nyt vastuullista ja motivoitunutta myyntipäällikköä rakentamaan oma kymmenen henkilön myynti/asiakaspalvelu ryhmä.
Monipuolisessa tehtävänkuvassa työskentelet itse rekrytoijana, valmentajana, esimiehenä ja myynnin kehittäjänä. Osallistut myös uusien projektien myynnin lanseeraukseen ja yhteistyön kehittämiseen.
Pääset siis aitiopaikalle vaikuttamaan alusta saakka oman tiimisi menestykseen ja saat yhtiöltämme kaikki mahdolliset välineet sekä tuen tehtävässä menestymistä varten.
Työ alkaa kuukauden mittaisella trainee-jaksolla jossa tutustut yhtiömme toimintatapoihin sekä asiakkaidemme tuotteiden myyntiin ja siihen liittyviin prosesseihin. Tehtävä alkaa heti trainee-jakson jälkeen.

Hakemamme henkilö on joko jo kannuksensa tuloksekkaasta myynti tai valmennustyöstä hankkinut urallaan eteenpäin haluava ammattilainen tai sellaiseksi haluava.
Arvostamme tulevaisuuteen katsovaa määrätietoista otetta ja sitoutumista liiketoimintamme kokonaisvaltaiseen kehittämiseen. Tärkeintä on, että lähdet tehtävään oikealla asenteella ja olet valmis sitoutumaan projektiin.

Paikallistuntemus katsotaan myös eduksi. Työ on kovaa, mutta erittäin palkitsevaa!
Ansaintamahdollisuudet ovat erinomaiset.
Ansiosi kasvavat tiimisi myynnin mukana ja tähän ei ole lasikattoa. Jos olet valmis ottamaan vastuuta ja haluat että työsi tulokset näkyvät hyvinä ansioina, niin voit hyvinkin olla etsimämme henkilö!


Ota nopeasti yhteyttä sillä paikka täytetään heti oikean henkilön löydyttyä. Lähetä vapaamuotoinen hakemuksesi yhteystietoineen osoitteeseen; timo.soikkeli@doony.fi niin olen sinuun yhteydessä.

jobs.title: EUROSPAR Ålesund Storsenter søker tilkallingsvikar
jobs.description:
EUROSPAR Ålesund Storsenter søker tilkallingsvikar

Har du lyst på en variert jobb i butikk, liker å møte mennesker og trives når det er litt tempo? Da kan det være deg vi ser etter!

EUROSPAR Ålesund Storsenter søker en tilkallingsvikar over 18 år som kan stille opp ved behov og bli en del av laget vårt.

Hva betyr det å være tilkallingsvikar?

Som tilkallingsvikar har du ikke nødvendigvis faste vakter hver uke, men blir spurt om å jobbe når vi har behov for ekstra hjelp. Det kan for eksempel være ved sykdom, ferie, travle perioder eller når det dukker opp ledige vakter.

Vi ser derfor etter deg som er fleksibel og har mulighet til å stille opp på kort varsel. Arbeidstid kan være både dag, kveld og helg.

Arbeidsoppgavene vil blant annet være:

  • Kundebehandling og service

  • Kassearbeid

  • Varepåfylling og vareplassering

  • Holde butikken ryddig, ren og innbydende

  • Forefallende butikkarbeid

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi tror du vil trives hos oss dersom du er positiv, serviceinnstilt og liker å ta i et tak. Du jobber godt sammen med andre, men er også trygg på å jobbe selvstendig.

Det viktigste for oss er at du har lyst til å jobbe, møter opp når du skal og bidrar til et godt arbeidsmiljø. Erfaring fra butikk er en fordel, men ikke et krav – riktig innstilling og vilje til å lære betyr mye.

Du må være fylt 18 år.

Vi tilbyr:

  • En variert og aktiv arbeidshverdag

  • Et hyggelig og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø

  • God opplæring

  • Verdifull erfaring fra dagligvare og kundeservice

Høres dette ut som noe for deg? Send oss en søknad og fortell litt om hvem du er, hvorfor du ønsker å jobbe hos oss og når du har mulighet til å jobbe.

Vi gleder oss til å høre fra deg!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

SPAR og EUROSPAR-kjeden er NorgesGruppens profilkjede for lokale supermarkeder. Kjeden består av ca. 300 lokale supermarkeder spredt over hele Norge. Merkevaren SPAR forvaltes og driftes av Kjøpmannshuset Norge AS, NorgesGruppens profilhus for kjøpmannseide butikker. I SPAR legger vi vekt på å gi kunden den beste lokale handleopplevelsen og gode tilbud hver uke.

In this role, you will play a key part in creating an engaging, functional, and welcoming workplace environment that enables employees to do their best work. You will coordinate workplace experience initiatives, support space and workplace planning activities, drive employee engagement campaigns, and help maintain high workplace standards across the office environment.

Working closely with client stakeholders, Building Ambassador, and workplace service team, you will contribute to the continuous development of the workplace by supporting sustainability initiatives, workplace projects, employee experience programs, and office environment enhancements.

jobs.title: Operations Manager of a mountain outdoor base in Norway.
jobs.description:
Starting in September 2026, we are looking for a long-term employee for the position of Operations Manager of a mountain outdoor base in Norway.

BRIEF DESCRIPTION OF THE COMPANY

During the summer season, we operate an outdoor activity base offering rafting, canyoning and mountain carts. In summer 2026, we welcomed 3,621 guests. The summer season runs from mid-May to mid-September.

During the winter season, we operate a small ski centre with the longest toboggan run in Norway and a ski rental service. In winter 2026, we welcomed 4,774 guests. The winter season runs from mid-December to mid-April.

During both seasons, guests can stay in our apartment or lavvo camp (maximum capacity of 49 people), and enjoy the facilities (sauna, hot tub, party lavvo and gas grill).

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Management of the employee team:

    • Summer season: reception, booking, service (cleaning, café, shopping), guide team for rafting, canyoning and mountain carts, head guide (responsible for the operation of activities), drivers and maintenance -- approximately 15 people in total

    • Winter season: reception, booking, service (cleaning, café, shopping), ski lift operators, snow groomer and maintenance -- approximately 5 people in total

  • Manual and administrative management, development and maintenance of the base

  • Practical day-to-day operation of the base and its activities

  • Administration and preparation of materials for accounting

  • Management of company assets (buildings, vehicles and activity equipment)

  • Cooperation with the Finance Director, Booking and Marketing departments

EMPLOYMENT DETAILS

Start: September 2026

Location: Dagali Fjellpark, Perstulvegen 100, 3588 Dagali, Norway

Working hours & remuneration

  • Number of working days during the winter season (mid-December -- mid-April): approximately 101

  • Number of working days during the summer season (mid-May -- mid-September): approximately 107

  • To be adjusted according to the candidate's abilities and mutual agreement.

Compensation: approximately NOK 220/hour, or alternatively a fixed salary based on the expected number of working hours, subject to agreement.

In the case of a long-term cooperation (after the trial period and with the agreement of both parties), we can discuss a fixed salary and performance-based bonus.

POSITION REQUIREMENTS

  • Management skills

  • Assertive attitude and advanced communication skills

  • Experience working in tourism

  • Positive attitude towards outdoor activities

  • Good knowledge of English

  • Willingness to stay in Dagali (Geilo) long-term and continuously from mid-December to mid-April and from mid-May to mid-September

  • Good computer skills and ability to handle administrative tasks

  • Ability to work outdoors in all weather conditions when necessary (snow, frost, wind, rain)

  • Responsibility, independence and attention to detail

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Long-term cooperation

  • Varied and interesting work

  • Working in the mountains and in a natural environment

  • Opportunity to participate in the development of the company

  • Benefits:

    • Free accommodation at the workplace during the first season; accommodation for future seasons by agreement.

    • Assistance with obtaining an ID number and tax card

    • Free rental of winter equipment for personal leisure activities

    • Free participation in our activities, subject to availability.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

Dagali Fjellpark is a professional outdoor center that offers summer activities (rafting, canyoning, mountain carts) and winter activities (ski center, toboggan run). The place has accommodation for about 40 people, and a small cafe.

jobs.title: Toma søger Servicemedarbejder til kunde i Aalborg Øst
jobs.description:
Er du serviceminded, fleksibel og god til at arbejde selvstændigt? Så er det måske dig, vi søger.

Vi søger en servicemedarbejder til en alsidig stilling hos en af vores kunder i Aalborg Øst, hvor du får en kombination af faste rengøringsopgaver og forskellige service- og ad hoc-opgaver på tværs af kundens bygninger.

Om jobbet

Du arbejder 5 timer dagligt, mandag til fredag, kl. 06.00–11.00, svarende til 25 timer om ugen.

Din arbejdsdag består af:

  • 3 timers fast rengøring i et område, som du får ansvaret for

  • 2 timer til service- og ad hoc-opgaver på tværs af kundens bygninger

Ad hoc-opgaverne kan blandt andet være ekstra rengøringsopgaver, udbedring af mangler og andre praktiske opgaver, der opstår i løbet af dagen.

Du skal derfor trives med en arbejdsdag, hvor nogle opgaver er faste, mens andre opstår løbende og kræver, at du er fleksibel og kan omstille dig.

Du får stillet en mobiltelefon til rådighed, så du kan modtage de løbende opgaver.

Vi søger dig, der

  • Er fleksibel og trives med forskellige typer opgaver

  • kan arbejde selvstændigt og struktureret

  • tager ansvar for de opgaver, du får tildelt

  • har øje for kvalitet og den gode service

Erfaring med rengøring eller facility service er en fordel, men det vigtigste er, at du har den rette indstilling og tager ansvar for dit arbejde.

Vi tilbyder

En alsidig arbejdsdag med en god kombination af faste opgaver og variation. Du får frihed under ansvar og bliver en vigtig del af den daglige service hos vores kunde.

  • Grundig oplæring

  • Gode og ordnede arbejdsforhold

  • Løn i henhold til overenskomst

  • Sundheds- og pensionsordning

Arbejdstid: Mandag–fredag kl. 06.00–11.00
Ugentligt timetal: 25 timer
Arbejdssted: Tomas kunde i Aalborg Øst
Tiltrædelse: 1. oktober 2026

Har du spørgsmål?
Kontakt Serviceleder Nina Bindner på mail: nina.breitner@toma-as.dk

Send din ansøgning med billede og CV hurtigst muligt, da vi løbende inviterer kvalificerede ansøgere til samtale.

Ansøgning sendes til: job@toma-as.dk

Toma er landsdækkende i Danmark, og vi har 750 dygtige medarbejdere.

Vi stiller krav til kvalitet, bæredygtighed, uddannelse, og arbejder seriøst med miljø og arbejdsmiljø.

Vi er medlem af Servicenormen, er ISO 9001, 14001 og 45001 certificeret, samt har certifikat på Svanemærket rengøring.

Vi investerer i vores medarbejdere både socialt og udviklingsmæssigt, og tilbyder spændende karrieremuligheder for de rette kandidater.

Vi lever for vores serviceløfte om at skabe gode service-oplevelser og give folk en bedre arbejdsdag.

jobs.title: Operatiivinen päällikkö Uhanda Oy
jobs.employer: Uhanda Oy I HR Satama Finland Oy
jobs.description:
_UHANDA Oy on vuonna 2020 perustettu kotimainen majoitusalan pioneeri. Ei vain puheissa, vaan aidosti käytännössä ja arjen toimissa._

_Keväällä 2026 UHANDA täytti kuusi vuotta. Tänään matkaa jatketaan kuuden hotellin ja yli 800 kalustetun asunnon voimin 15 eri paikkakunnalla. Toimintansa alusta lähtien UHANDA on avannut alalla eniten uusia hotelleja Suomeen ja kasvattanut kalustettujen asuntojen liiketoimintaansa alan ripeintä tahtia._

**UHANDA ETSII OPERATIIVISTA PÄÄLLIKKÖÄ.**

**(Asiakas- & myyntipalvelu + siivous- ja laatuyhteistyö, 6 hotellin hotellipäällikkö)**

**Rooli lyhyesti**

**Titteli:** Operatiivinen päällikkö

**Vastuualue:** UHANDA:n hotelliportfolio: asiakas- & myyntipalvelu, kohteiden palvelullinen toimivuus ja ylläpito sekä siivous- ja laatuyhteistyö

**Onnistumisen mitta:** vieraiden ja asiakkaiden tyytyväisyys koko portfoliossa

**Tiimi:** 5 hengen asiakas- & myyntipalvelutiimi

**Raportoit:** Toimitusjohtajalle osana tulevaa johtoryhmää

**Sijainti:** Pääkonttori Tampere. Työ vaatii n. 2–3 reissupäivää kuukaudessa, ja ne ovat tyypillisesti yhdessä putkessa.

**TYÖ**

**Tiimin johtaminen**

Sinulla on täysi vastuu viiden hengen asiakas- ja myyntipalvelutiimistä: sen arjesta, ihmisistä, osaamisesta ja kehittymisestä. Resursointi, työvuorosuunnittelu, perehdytys, valmentaminen ja palvelutason varmistaminen ovat sinun käsissäsi. Onnistumista mitataan sillä, miten tiimi onnistuu, ei sillä, miten paljon itse ehdit tehdä.

**Asiakas- ja myyntipalvelun arki**

Vastaat siitä, että vieraiden ja asiakkaiden yhteydenotot hoidetaan nopeasti, laadukkaasti ja kaupallisesti järkevästi vuorokauden ja viikon jokaisessa kohdassa. Tähän kuuluvat palvelutaso ja vasteajat, tarjous- ja varauspyynnöt, poikkeustilanteet sekä palautteiden käsittely niin, että niistä myös opitaan.

Hands-on-tyylimme tarkoittaa, että iso osa työstä, arjen päällä olosta ja kehityksen suunnittelusta tapahtuu käytännön ohessa. Tarkoittaen, että kehittävää ja edistävää työtä tehdään myös asiakaspalveluvuoroissa.

**Siivous- ja laatuyhteistyö**

Vastaat siivous- ja laatuyhteistyöstä kumppaniverkostomme kanssa: yhteisistä standardeista, niiden seurannasta ja siitä, että laatu on tasalaatuista jokaisessa kohteessa. Käytännössä tämä on kumppanisuhteiden johtamista, laadun mittaamista ja poikkeamiin tarttumista siten, että ne ovat huomioituna ja ratkottuna ennen kuin nämä välittyvät vieraille.

**Systemaattinen kehittäminen**

Hyödynnämme vahvasti nykyaikaisia työkaluja ja niiden mahdollistamia toimintamalleja, ja implementoimme järjestelmäkehitystä uusien ominaisuuksien kautta arkeen systemaattisesti. Se tarkoittaa, että muutos ja kehitys ovat meillä vakio.

Tässä roolissa olet oman vastuualueesi prosessien omistaja: tunnistat kehityskohdat, määrittelet tarpeet yhdessä tiimin kanssa, jalkautat uudet ominaisuudet arkeen ja koulutat tiimin niiden käyttöön. Ylläpito ja kehitys eivät ole toistensa vastakohtia, vaan molemmat kuuluvat samaan ruutuun, josta vastaat yhdessä tiimisi kanssa.

**Odotamme sinulta**

Kokemusta ihmisten ja arjen johtamisesta ja halua kehittyä siinä edelleen

Operatiivista otetta dynaamisessa ympäristössä, ja kykyä nauttia jatkuvasti elävästä arjesta ja sen rytmistä

Kaupallista ja liiketoiminnallista ajattelutapaa. Asiakaskokemukset ovat aina keskiössä ja toimivat linkkinä jokaiseen liiketoiminnan osa-alueeseen

Aitoa kiinnostusta ohjata arkea ja päätöksiä datan kautta, johon yhdistyy inhimillinen ihmisten ymmärrys

Rohkeutta tarttua asioihin, joita kukaan ei ole vielä pyytänyt sinua tarttumaan

Emme edellytä tiettyä koulutusta tai vuosimäärää alalta. Olemme rekrytoineet monesta eri profiilista ja taustasta, ja ensisijaisen kriittistä meille on asenne ja draivi. On paljon asioita, joissa voimme tukea ja sparrata, mutta uskomme, että kaikki lähtee aina ensin yksilön omasta motivaatiosta ja tahtotilasta onnistua asiakkaidemme puolesta.

**Tarjoamme**

Tarjoamme toimenkuvan ja työpaikan, jossa pääset johtamaan valmiiksi rakennettuja, toimivaksi todettuja malleja ja kehittämään niitä eteenpäin siten, että pääset konkreettisesti näkemään oman kädenjälkesi. Sinulla on tukena organisaatio, jossa on prosesseja, toimintoja ja rooleja, jotka tarkoittavat, ettei kaikkea tarvitse itse tehdä.

Tämä on työympäristö, jossa vastuu on kaksisuuntainen ja se mahdollistaa sen, että tunnet ja näet oman työsi arvon ja olet päättämässä ja vaikuttamassa, miltä UHANDA:n seuraavat kasvuvaiheet näyttävät.

**UHANDA lukuina – vuoden 2026 näkymä**

Hotelleja: 6

Kalustettuja asuntoja: yli 800

Asiakasarviot: 8,6 / 10

Liikevaihto: n. 18 miljoonaa euroa

Kasvu: n. 90 %

**Toimitusjohtajalta**

_"Loistavan porukan ja työyhteisön lisäksi yksi arvokkaimmista asioista, joita tunnistan meidän voivan tarjota, on eväitä tulevaisuuden työelämään ja arkeen. Arjen ohjaaminen ja liiketoiminnan johtaminen ovat suuren murroksen äärellä, ja olen henkilökohtaisesti innoissani siitä, että tapa, jolla lähestymme asioita ja haastamme omaa tekemistämme, kasvattaa samalla jokaista meistä ammattilaisena._

_Jos uteliaisuus heräsi ja mietit, että vitsit kuinka mielenkiintoinen paikka voisi olla, mutta kun just nyt on kaikki kivasti. Niin muista, että joskus pitää olla valmis luopumaan hyvästä, jotta voi saavuttaa jotain loistavaa. Toivottavasti tämä voisi olla sinulle jotain loistavaa. "_

jobs.title: Machine Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Join Our Team as a Machine Automation Engineer!

We're currently seeking a talented Machine Automation Engineer to join our Semiconductor ALD Business Unit. In this role, you'll design the software and automation that brings our atomic layer deposition (ALD) equipment to life - building control solutions for fully automated system clusters used in semiconductor manufacturing around the world.

Your Role and Responsibilities:

As a Machine Automation Engineer you will design, develop and maintain the automation software for Beneq ALD equipment. Alongside project deliveries, your work will drive the continuous development and maintenance of our existing automation systems — from the first line of code in our development laboratory all the way to commissioning at customer sites.

Key Responsibilities include:

* Design, develop and maintain software solutions that meet high safety and reliability standards for controlling machines in a fully automated system cluster

* Design and improve HMI applications and user interfaces for machine operations

* Conduct and participate in code reviews to ensure code quality and adherence to best practices

* Collaborate with stakeholders to gather and analyse requirements, translating them into technical specifications

* Create and maintain technical documentation for the software systems

* Conduct testing activities during tool delivery, including simulation testing in our development laboratory

* Commission equipment at customer premises

* Support our Software Application Support Engineers with questions coming from the field



What We're Looking For:

To excel in this role, you should have:

* A strong engineering background with 4+ years of experience, typically a BSc or MSc degree in automation engineering.

* Experience with automation instrumentation and electrical drawings.

* Experience with structured text coding (IEC 61131-3) in a PLC environment.

* Proficiency in SQL and NoSQL databases (Postgres, MSSQL).

* Familiarity with UML and other modelling methods.

* Familiarity with DevOps practices and CI/CD tools.

* Knowledge of HTML5 and JS-based HMI design tools.

* A solid understanding of software development methodologies and software quality assurance principles.

* Solid problem-solving skills, a self-guided and customer-oriented mindset, and a can-do attitude.

* A technical mindset with great attention to detail, a structured way of working and strong documentation skills.

* Excellent communication skills in English.

* Willingness to travel approximately 50–60 days per year to customer premises worldwide.

Bonus Skills (Not Required but Nice to Have):

* Knowledge of Beckhoff TwinCAT 3 or Codesys environments.

* Experience with C#.

* Experience from the semiconductor industry or other high-tech equipment manufacturing.

What We Offer:

At Beneq, you'll have the unique chance to work in a global high-tech environment that blends the dynamic energy of a fast-growing company with the stability and resources of a larger enterprise. You'll work on our own product development, with global operations and services in Japan, Taiwan, China, the USA and the EU - so your work reaches customers on nearly every continent.

We value diversity and support personal and professional development, offering a collaborative workspace where you can thrive alongside colleagues from over 20 different nationalities. The role is mainly office-based in Espoo, with remote work possible up to 40% when work activities allow it, and occasional clean room activities to support testing or to upgrade and troubleshoot our equipment.

Working at Beneq means being part of a supportive team that values curiosity and innovation. You'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact while advancing your career in a truly global industry.

Interested? Here's What to Do Next:

If you're excited about joining our team in Espoo, we'd love to hear from you! Please submit your application, including your CV and cover letter, via the apply link to our recruitment portal by 30 September. We encourage you to apply early - we may start the interview process during the application period.

For more information about the role, please contact Joonas Taipalus, Lead Automation Software Development Engineer, at +358 50 491 6424. He will be available for inquiries during the application period on Mondays and Wednesdays between 12.30 - 15.00 EET. Please note that applications are only accepted through our recruitment portal.




Beneq is the home of atomic layer deposition. Our mission is to be dedicated to the success of the More-than-Moore device makers by delivering best in class, innovative, and flexible ALD equipment and service solutions. In 1984, we established the worlds first industrial production using ALD. Today, we lead the market with products for semiconductor device fabrication, R&D, and varied ALD solutions. We operate globally and employ 170+ people on three continents. We are a unique employer that combines the hands-on, dynamic mindset of a fast-growth startup with the solid funding and resources of a larger enterprise. Beneqs team of engineers and experts are committed to delivering world class ALD solutions and enabling technology mega trends through advanced solutions. Beneq is headquartered in Finland with legal entities in the USA and Japan.

To perform regular maintenance checks on plant machinery, including mixers, conveyors, pumps, crushers, and batching systems. - To conduct preventative maintenance tasks to extend the life of equipment and minimize breakdowns. - To lubricate machinery, replace worn parts, and ensure all components are in good working condition. - To identify mechanical, electrical, and hydraulic issues in plant equipment and diagnose problems accurately. - To repair or replace faulty parts, ensuring that all machinery is returned to full operational capacity in a timely manner. - To perform both scheduled and emergency repairs to minimize downtime. - To ensure all work is conducted in compliance with health, safety, and environmental regulations. - To maintain accurate records of maintenance, repairs, and inspections performed on plant equipment. - Essential knowledge includes mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic systems, as well as the ability to diagnose and fix issues promptly to ensure smooth plant operations - Essential knowledge includes strong mechanical, electrical, and hydraulic knowledge, ability to read technical drawings, schematics, and manuals, and excellent trouble-shooting and problem solving skills - Essential skills include application of relevant health & safety and environmental legislation, performance of system checks and adjustments on machinery, and monitoring of inventory supply for required equipment - Candidates must be competent to assist in the installation and commissioning of new equipment or upgrades - Candidates must be competent to monitor stock levels of spare parts, tools, and equipment needed for maintenance and order parts and supplies as needed - A mechanic qualification or certificate is a bonus but is not mandatory 2-3 years’ of proven relevant experience as a Plant Mechanic is required. jobs.title: Directeur(trice) d'Hôtel 5* (H/F)
jobs.description:
Vous souhaitez relever un nouveau défi dans un établissement haut de gamme ?
Dans le cadre de son développement, notre client reconnu pour la qualité de son exigence et matière de service recherche son/sa futur(e) Directeur(trice) d'Hôtel pour son établissement situé au cœur du Piémont des Vosges, dans le Bas-Rhin (67).
Véritable ambassadeur(rice) de l'établissement, vous serez responsable de la gestion globale de l'hôtel, en collaboration étroite avec la direction, et veillerez à garantir une expérience client d'exception, tout en accompagnant les équipes dans une dynamique de performance, d'engagement et d'excellence opérationnelle.
Vos missions :
Management et encadrement des équipes
- Encadrer, fédérer et accompagner les équipes opérationnelles et supports (hébergement, réception, restauration, technique, administratif).
- Développer une culture d'excellence, de service et de cohésion.
- Assurer le recrutement, l'intégration, la formation et l'évolution des talents.
- Mettre en place un management de proximité favorisant la performance et l'implication des collaborateurs.
Pilotage et gestion de l'établissement
- Assurer la gestion globale de l'hôtel (exploitation, budget, rentabilité et qualité de service).
- Suivre et analyser les indicateurs de performance (chiffre d'affaires, taux d'occupation, coûts, satisfaction client).
- Élaborer les budgets annuels et définir les plans d'actions nécessaires.
- Garantir le respect des standards 5 étoiles ainsi que des procédures internes.
Gestion de l'information et reporting
- Structurer et analyser les données d'exploitation afin d'accompagner la prise de décision.
- Assurer un reporting régulier auprès de la direction générale ou du groupe.
- Déployer des outils de suivi et de pilotage fiables et performants.
Expérience client et qualité de service
- Garantir une expérience client personnalisée et irréprochable à chaque étape du séjour.
- Superviser la qualité des prestations et le respect des standards d'un établissement haut de gamme.
Développement et performance de l'établissement
- Définir et déployer la stratégie de développement commercial et opérationnel .
- Optimiser la rentabilité tout en maintenant un haut niveau d'exigence.
- Identifier les axes d'amélioration et piloter les projets d'évolution.
Profil recherché:
- Formation supérieure en hôtellerie, tourisme ou management hôtelier.
- Expérience confirmée de 7 à 10 ans en direction ou exploitation hôtelière haut de gamme, au sein d'un établissement 4 ou 5 étoiles.
- Parcours professionnel démontrant une capacité à s'inscrire durablement dans les fonctions occupées et à accompagner le développement d'un établissement sur le moyen/long terme.
- Solide expérience en management d'équipes et gestion opérationnelle, avec un leadership fédérateur, une forte présence sur le terrain et une réelle capacité d'adaptation.
- Forte culture du résultat et du pilotage économique : maîtrise du budget, reporting et des principaux indicateurs de performance hôtelière (RevPAR, taux d'occupation, chiffre d'affaires, coûts d'exploitation et rentabilité).
- Excellente maîtrise des code de l'hôtellerie haut de gamme, avec un sens aigu du détail, de la qualité de service et de l'expérience client.
- Anglais courant indispensable, à l'écrit comme à l'oral, afin d'évoluer auprès d'une clientèle internationale.
- La maîtrise d'une troisième langue constitue un véritable atout.
Vous souhaitez mettre votre expertise au service d'un établissement d'exception et contribuer activement à son développement ? N'attendez plus, adressez-nous votre candidature.

jobs.title: Haemme useita myyjiä Eepeen Ruokatoreille, S-market Kivistöön ja Seinäjoen Prismaan
jobs.description:
Primary location:
SEINÄJOKI

Haemme useita myyjiä Eepeen Ruokatoreille, S-market Kivistöön ja Seinäjoen Prismaan
Etsimme nyt Ruokatorin myyjiä määräaikaisiin ja vakituisiin työsuhteisiin, joissa työtunteja on 20-35h/vko. Ruokatorimme tekevät tiivistä yhteistyötä keskenään, joten työvuoroja voidaan tehdä joustavasti sekä S-market Kivistön että Prisman Ruokatorilla. Aiempi kokemus asiakaspalvelusta, ruokatuotteiden käsittelystä, valmistuksesta tai myynnistä sekä alan koulutus katsotaan eduksi, mutta tärkeintä on halu oppia ja kehittää omaa osaamista ruokatorin monipuolisissa tehtävissä.


Millaista työ ruokatorilla on?
Ruokatorin työssä yhdistyvät vaihtelevat ruokatorin tehtävät sekä marketin myyjän työ. Päivän aikana palvelet asiakkaita, suosittelet tuotteita ja autat löytämään sopivia ratkaisuja niin arkeen kuin juhlaan sekä pidät huolta tuotteiden houkuttelevasta esillepanosta. Lisäksi työhön kuuluu myös salaattien, valmisruokien ja muiden herkkujen valmistamista, tilausten tekemistä sekä hävikin hallintaa sekä myyjän yleisiä tehtäviä. Työ tarjoaa mahdollisuuden hyödyntää osaamistasi laajasti ja oppia jatkuvasti uutta ruoan, asiakaspalvelun ja kaupan alan tehtävien parissa.


Odotamme sinulta

Edellytämme halua työskennellä vuorotyössä kaupan aukioloaikoina.

Myyjän työssä tarvitaan aitoa halua tehdä asiakaspalvelu- ja myyntityötä sekä reipasta oma-aloitteisuutta.

Työ kaupassa on tänä päivänä yhä digitaalisempaa, ja siksi odotamme sinulta myös halua oppia käyttämään erilaisia järjestelmiä ja myymälän teknisiä työvälineitä.

Teemme työtä tiiminä, joten arvostamme hyvää työkaveruutta, yhteistyötaitoja ja halua työskennellä markettien erilaisissa työtehtävissä.

Ruokatorin tehtävissä menestyy parhaiten henkilö, jolla on aito kiinnostus ruokaan. Tuotteiden suosittelu ja ruoanlaitosta keskustelu on osa työtehtäviä.

Täysi-ikäisyyttä.



Me Eepeellä sanomme olevamme Ihan tavallisissatöissä. Työtä kuvaillaan usein erilaisin korulausein, jotka toivottavasti ovat myös totta, mutta meidän mielestämme ihan tavallinen työ on mahtavaa. Meillä on myös poikkeuksellisen kivoja työkavereita, erinomaisia henkilöstöetuja ja harvinaisen paljon erilaisia työmahdollisuuksia.


Tarjoamme sinulle:
Miltä kuulostaisi -25 % alennus S-ryhmän ravintoloista? Tai henksuhintainen hotellihuone viikonlopuksi? Suomen parhaimmiksikin kutsutuista S-ryhmän ja Eepeen henkilöstöeduista voit lukea esimakuatäältä.

Koko henkilöstöämme koskevatulospalkkiojärjestelmä

Kattavat työterveyspalvelut sekä liikunnan, kulttuurin ja hyvinvoinninEpassi-edut

Poikkeuksellisen paljon mahdollisuuksia! Voit vaihtaa ammattia, toimialaa tai ottaa lisätyötä oman osaamisesi ja toiveidesi mukaan


Haku on avoinna 20.9.2026 saakka - käsittelemme hakemuksia ja teemme valintoja jo hakuaikana, joten laita hakemusta reippaasti tulemaan.
Työt alkaa sopimuksen mukaan syksyn aikana. Mainitse hakemuksellasi haetko ensisijaisesti S-market Kivistöön vai Prismaan.

Lisätietoja: Olli Isoniemi, Eepeen ruokatorien projektipäällikkösp. olli.isoniemi@sok.fi / p. 010 7646296

******************************************************************
Etelä-Pohjanmaan Osuuskauppa on monipuolinen työpaikka!
Eepee on osuuskauppa,jonka omistavat sen yli 95 000 asiakasomistajaa. Tarjoamme toimialueellamme työpaikan 1300 palvelualan ammattilaiselle 71 toimipaikassamme.
Eepeellä teemme ihan tavallisia töitä. Tavallisuus on voima, joka erottaa meidät muista. Meillä työ ei ole vain peruspesti, mutta samalla se on juuri sitä. Tavallinen työ on sitä, mitä pitääkin olla – tehokasta, arvokasta ja tärkeää. Ihan tavallisen työn lisäksi, meillä on epätavallisen hyvät edut ja poikkeuksellisen mahtavat työkaverit. Tutustu meihin paremmin ja kurkkaa, mitä tulevat työkaverisi kertovat työstään – ehkä seuraava tarina on sinun.

jobs.title: Directeur d'hôtel (F/H)
jobs.description:
RESPONSABILITÉS :

Vos missions :
Rattaché(e) à la Responsable des Opérations France, vous assurez la gestion globale de l'établissement, avec un focus sur la qualité, satisfaction clients, le développement commercial et la réalisation des objectifs financiers.


Vos responsabilités :


1. Gestion opérationnelle
- Garantir le bon fonctionnement quotidien de l'établissement
- Être présent(e) sur le terrain, au contact des équipes et des clients.
- Veiller au respect des procédures et standards de l'enseigne.
- Assurer le suivi des normes HACCP et la qualité des prestations.
- Superviser l'entretien des équipements en lien avec la direction technique.


2. Management
- Superviser, animer et coordonner une équipe d'environ 10 collaborateurs.
- Participer au recrutement et au développement des équipes selon les procédures RH.
- Former les équipes aux standards et procédures internes.
- Organiser les plannings et gérer l'organisation du travail (réception, étages, petit déjeuner).
- Évaluer et accompagner les collaborateurs dans leur évolution professionnelle.


3. Développement commercial
- Collaborer avec l'équipe siège pour optimiser le taux d'occupation (réservations, tarification, offres promotionnelles).
- Suivre la concurrence et adapter l'offre commerciale.
- Développer la clientèle sur la zone primaire des hôtels.
- Gérer activement la relation client.



4. Satisfaction clients :
- Garantir une expérience client fluide, qualitative et conforme aux standards de l'enseigne
- Gérer les réclamations avec réactivité et professionnalisme
- Mettre en œuvre les actions correctives et d'amélioration continue
- Suivre les indicateurs de satisfaction et de qualité de service

4. Suivi financier :
- Assurer le suivi des budgets et comptes d'exploitation.
- Analyser les indicateurs clés de gestion (PM, CA, TO, ratios).
- Veiller à la rentabilité de l'établissement
- Participer à l'optimisation des coûts et à la maîtrise des dépenses


Conditions du poste :
-  Salaire fixe annuel : 48K€ brut annuel
-  Prime sur objectifs : 10 % de la rémunération brute annuelle.
-  Statut  : Cadre (Forfait 218 jours)


Processus de recrutement :
- 1 Premier échange téléphonique avec notre Chargée des Ressources Humaines
Puis
- 1 entretien avec notre Responsable des Opérations France
- 1 entretien avec notre Responsable des Ressources Humaines

PROFIL RECHERCHÉ :

Profil recherché :
- Vous êtes diplômé en Gestion et Management hôtelier, avec une expérience confirmée en tant que Directeur(trice) de 3-5 ans minimum
- Vous maîtrisez l'anglais ;
- Vous êtes autonome, extrêmement rigoureux, réactif, disposez d'excellentes qualités relationnelles et de leadership ;
- Vous faites preuve d'un sens commercial aigu dans le but d'optimiser la rentabilité des établissements hôtelier

jobs.description:
About Four Seasons

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

Since opening in 1962, The Ocean Club, A Four Seasons Resort, Bahamas has been a playground for celebrities and discerning travellers set along an 8-kilometre (5-mile) stretch of natural, white-sand beach on Paradise Island. Connect with Bahamian beauty in an enclave of remarkable seclusion, where intimate low-rise buildings are immersed in 14 hectares (35 acres) of Versailles-inspired lawns and gardens. Wake up to breakfast on your private balcony, then indulge in a restorative treatment in one of our Balinese-style spa villas or head out for a round of golf at Ocean Club Golf Course. However you spend your day, be sure to join us back at Martini Bar and Lounge for a nightcap.

When Legends Come To Life

Since opening in 1962, The Ocean Club has welcomed the worldâs most discerning guests to our five-mile stretch of natural white sand beach â framed by 35 acres of Versailles inspired lawns and gardens.

Discover the legendary chic of The Ocean Club, combining elevated Four Seasons service with laid-back Bahamian style â creating one of the most sought-after resort experiences in the Caribbean.

On a stretch of natural white sand beach, our resort offers 107 ultra-luxury accommodations, a Balinese-inspired spa, and dining by Michelin-starred chef Jean-Georges Vongerichten.

The Ocean Club has a treasured history serving generations of luxury travelers. Expansive lawns and towering coconut palms provide an enchanting backdrop to the pristine beaches of Paradise Island.

The Ocean Club offers a rich roster of activities including water sports such as snorkeling, sailing and wind-surfing along with land-based activities including world-class golf and tennis plus a relaxing spa.

The role of the Public Area Attendant is to clean and maintain the standards throughout the public areas of the Resort.

jobs.title: Irrigation Technician
jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

The best of your adventures is the one you have yet to sail!

Your Purpose

Responsible for the operation and maintenance of all irrigation and drainage systems on the island and grounds. This role is based on MSC's island reserve, Ocean Cay. Staff accommodation provided.

Your Impact

  • Watering lawns, palms and flower beds and other areas as needed or scheduled.
  • Monitors daily water usage and informs Maintenance Engineer of any needed adjustments to the irrigation water usage and computer settings.
  • Operates irrigation heads in dry areas needing additional water.
  • Designs, implements and maintains mechanical and electrical components of island irrigation system.
  • Repairs equipment associated with irrigation (i.e., irrigation pipes and irrigation heads valves etc.).
  • Performs preventive maintenance on all equipment associated with irrigation.
  • Maintains complete records on all equipment maintenance associated with irrigation.
  • Controls expenses associated with irrigation equipment and activities.
  • Maintains inventory and ordering of parts needed for irrigation equipment.
  • Performs all record-keeping relative to irrigation system including weather and rainfall data; assists in recording fertilizer and pesticide applications.
  • Performs daily tank and pump water usage reports.
  • Helps apply or water-in pesticides and fertilizers under the supervision of the Pesticides Application Specialist through fumigation.
  • Operates dump trucks and other light equipment in hauling materials and removing debris.
  • May occasionally supervise crews for special projects.
  • Performs other appropriate tasks assigned by the Supervisor.

Your Journey so far

  • Fluent English, verbal and written. Knowledge of any other core language is an advantage.
  • High School diploma and GED required.
  • Some experience working for a landscaping service or golf course grounds crew, specifically working with the irrigation system.
  • Proven ability to work within a harmonious and diverse culture team environment.
  • Working knowledge of basic electricity and hydraulics related to an irrigation system, including automatic valves and controllers and various types of pumps and pumping systems.
  • Knowledge of Rainbird system preferred.
  • Knowledge of principles and practices of turf grass management and general horticulture.
  • Knowledge of pump station maintenance, operation, and repair.
  • Knowledge of tools, methods and materials used in grounds maintenance work.
  • Ability to operate irrigation pumps, sprayers and drip irrigation systems.
  • Knowledge of and ability to perform required role in emergency situations.

Your Essentials

Eligible to live and work in a remote location, in the Bahamas

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

jobs.title: Wholesale Negotiator (m/f)
jobs.description:
Description des tâches:
As a Wholesale Negotiator, you will secure, implement, and manage on an end-to-end basis wholesale discount agreements with partners and third-party Mobile Networks on behalf of Vodafone Markets. This role is a rare opportunity for a customer-obsessed commercial professional and/or Wholesale Negotiator within the Roaming industry to take this business to the next level.
As a Wholesale Negotiator, you will play an important part within Vodafone Roaming Services (VRS), based in Luxembourg. Commercial acumen, strong negotiation skills as well and the ability to establish or to already have a network in the roaming world are key selection criteria. Joining us as a Wholesale Negotiator, you can be part of our empowering global roaming function. You will:
Develop the wholesale strategy with a view to optimizing wholesale roaming cost and revenues
Prepare, lead and carry out negotiations with roaming partners in your own portfolio under strict deadlines
Co-define and implement a steering strategy, considering coverage, pricing and existing or future partnerships
Manage stakeholders – Internal, External, Partner Markets, Enterprise Units - to align strategies and build strong, productive relationships
Manage end-to-end the deal-making, implementation, and harvesting cycle of individual wholesale relationships by working closely with Legal, Finance, Tax, and other stakeholders. Create long-term financial plans and budget

2+ years of experience in wholesale, commercial analytics, business analysis, or related telecommunications/commercial functions.
Strong analytical and financial modelling skills, with experience developing 100+ business cases, profitability assessments, forecasting, and revenue optimization recommendations.
Advanced data analysis and reporting capabilities, with the ability to analyze large datasets, identify trends, monitor KPIs, and provide actionable business insights.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, including experience preparing reports and presentations for senior stakeholders, Directors, and Executive Committee audiences.
Strong commercial acumen, with experience supporting wholesale agreements, pricing validation, commercial performance analysis, and market opportunity assessments.
Stakeholder management experience, with the ability to collaborate effectively across commercial, finance, operational, and international teams.
Results-oriented mindset, demonstrated through revenue protection initiatives, fraud detection, process improvements, and operational efficiency gains.
Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex data into practical business recommendations and strategic actions.
Experience in budgeting, forecasting, and business performance management, supporting commercial planning and decision-making processes.
Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and data analytics tools; experience with SQL and business intelligence/reporting tools would be an advantage.
Ability to work effectively in multicultural and cross-functional environments, managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced setting.
Bachelor's degree in business administration, Management, Economics, Finance, or a related field.
Knowledge of wholesale telecommunications, roaming, commercial agreements, and market analysis would be highly desirable

About the FHSE

The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Faculty of Humanities, Education and Social Sciences (FHSE) at the University of Luxembourg brings together expertise from the humanities, linguistics, cognitive sciences, social and educational sciences. People from across 20 disciplines are working within the Faculty. Along with the disciplinary approach a very ambitious interdisciplinary research culture has been developed. The faculty's research and teaching focuses on social, economic, political and educational issues with the common goal of contributing to an inclusive, open and resourceful society.

Your role

The cohesion of liberal societies increasingly depends on high-quality, participatory human services spanning social, educational, and cultural domains. Strategies for reducing barriers to service uptake and enhancement, including through the co-production of specialist knowledge, are essential for the legitimacy of services and underlying policies. The University of Luxembourg aims to play a key role in this public-facing co-productive knowledge landscape. This position will contribute to the development of digital and face-to-face methods for public involvement, by shaping the theories, methodologies, and tools that underpin participatory knowledge production in human services. Active in research, innovation and teaching, the position holder will, in particular:

• Analyse and develop innovative approaches to service user engagement, public outreach, and multi-stakeholder dialogue focusing on unequal power relations and conﬂicting interests. These approaches should combine data-intensive digital tools with face-to-face interventions, enabling exchanges between human service providers and hard-to-reach populations. Examples include collaborative digital platforms, co-creative living labs, interactive exhibitions, and multisensorial participatory interventions
• Organize participatory events and lead the development of the department's outreach initiative ALICES (Agora Luxembourgeoise partICipative de l'intErvention Sociale) - a living lab launched in 2023 that engages with Luxembourg's human services sector
• Design and theorise participatory interventions and public outreach within the context of human services as well as in empirical research methods
• Teach conceptual and methodological courses in the Bachelor en Sciences Sociales et Éducatives (BSSE), playing a key a key role in its ongoing development and expansion. The postholder will also have the opportunity to contribute to the construction of a projected new Master's programme and to teach within the doctoral and lifelong learning programmes of the university

For further information about the role, please contact: Prof. Dr. Boris Traue, Director of the Bachelor en Sciences Sociales et Éducatives, Email: boris.traue@uni.lu

Your profile

• A doctorate in sociology, social work, education, anthropology or related ﬁelds
• A minimum of three years of postdoctoral experience acquired at a university or comparable research institution. Experience in participatory, qualitative, and digital research methodologies is essential
• Documented experience in at least two thematic areas among: digital and face-to-face user involvement; engagement of underserved or marginalised publics; and academic outreach and knowledge dissemination strategies
• An international research proﬁle demonstrated through peer-reviewed publications
• Ability to develop conceptual frameworks that integrate both face-to-face and digital participatory interventions. Experience in user-centred digital technologies and visual or multi-sensorial strategies for reaching vulnerable publics is desirable
• Involvement in outreach initiatives
• Experience in the acquisition of external research project funding, conference participation, and collaboration in national and international research and/or policy initiatives
• University-level teaching experience at the undergraduate and postgraduate levels should be documented

Language requirements

The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual context. The person hired on this position must be proﬁcient in English and French. Additional knowledge of German is advantageous. The University encourages its staﬀ to learn German (and other languages) and provides access to language courses to this end.

We offer

• An exceptional research environment and skilled support staff. High-quality equipment. Close ties to the business world and to the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban site with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and with numerous non-academic partners such as ministries, local governments, associations, NGOs, …
• Competitive salary and benefits packages. Very good opportunities for external funding. Support for career development and mentoring. Services to promote staff well-being and work-life balance

How to apply

Applications should be submitted online only and contain:

• Cover letter

Please indicate their relationship to you

Applications should be addressed to Prof. Dr. Robert Harmsen (Dean of the Faculty).
We encourage early application. To ensure full consideration, candidates should apply by 30th of November 2025. Applications will be handled in strict conﬁdence.

This role offers a structured introduction to client-facing responsibilities and regulatory developments, with a strong focus on learning and professional development.

Join us at a company that values your growth and offers amazing benefits. Learn alongside accomplished leaders and become the next standout member of our team. Your journey to an exciting and fulfilling career starts here at Palana.

Internal Audit

jobs.title: Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) (Medizinphysiker/in)
jobs.description:
Wollen Sie die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens mitgestalten? Wir bei Siemens Healthineers setzen auf Menschen, die ihre Energie und Leidenschaft diesem Ziel widmen – das sagt schon unser Unternehmensname. Siemens Healthineers steht für Pioniergeist unserer Mitarbeitenden, gepaart mit unserer langen Tradition als weltweit führender Technologiekonzern in der stets dynamischen Gesundheitsbranche.
Wir bieten ein flexibles und dynamisches Umfeld voller Gelegenheiten, über sich hinaus zu wachsen, um sich persönlich und beruflich weiterzuentwickeln. Klingt das interessant für Sie?

Dann werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams als Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) und unterstützen Sie uns dabei, die Zukunft der Präzisionstheranostik aktiv mitzugestalten und gleichzeitig die Patientenversorgung weiter voranzubringen. Diese Position richtet sich an ambitionierte Fachkräfte, die den nächsten Schritt in ihrer Karriere gehen möchten. Sie bietet die Möglichkeit, Strahlenschutzaktivitäten über alle Projektphasen hinweg zu verantworten – von der Standortplanung über Genehmigungsverfahren und Abschirmungskonzepte bis hin zu regulatorischer Compliance und Projektumsetzung für neue und bestehende radiopharmazeutische Einrichtungen.

Wählen Sie den besten Ort für Ihre Arbeit - im Rahmen dieser Stelle ist es in Abstimmung mit Ihrer Führungskraft möglich, bis zu einem durchschnittlichen Volumen von 60% der jeweiligen Arbeitszeit mobil (innerhalb Deutschlands) zu arbeiten.
Noch mehr Flexibilität? Mobiles Arbeiten aus dem Ausland ist unter bestimmten Voraussetzungen und in ausgewählten Ländern für bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr möglich.

Diese Position kann an den Standorten Erlangen (Deutschland), Venafro (Italien) oder Barcelona (Spanien) besetzt werden.

Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

- In enger, bereichsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit begleiten Sie Projekte von der Standortkonzeption bis zur Inbetriebnahme und steuern die fachliche Entwicklung sämtlicher relevanter Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Prozesse und ‑Verfahren.- Sie sind verantwortlich für die Erstellung, Einreichung und fortlaufende Betreuung aller Genehmigungsunterlagen für den Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen, einschließlich der erforderlichen behördlichen Korrespondenz.- Sie entwickeln Abschirmungskonzepte für neue Anlagen, neue Anwendungen sowie neue Zyklotron‑Installationen.- Sie führen Abschirmungsüberprüfungen sowie verifizierende und bestätigende Messungen durch.- Sie leisten Vor‑Ort‑Unterstützung, um die korrekte Umsetzung der erforderlichen Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Programme für einen erfolgreichen Anlagenbetrieb sicherzustellen.- Sie prüfen und reichen sämtliche erforderlichen Unterlagen für Stilllegungen ein.- Sie unterstützen Vor‑Ort als verantwortliche*r Lizenznehmer‑Stakeholder, um eine erfolgreiche Durchführung von Stilllegungsaktivitäten zu gewährleisten.- Sie steuern Projekte und stellen sicher, dass alle relevanten Fristen eingehalten werden.- Sie begleiten Standorte bei behördlichen Inspektionen, um Genehmigungen zu sichern und aufrechtzuerhalten.

Mehr über dieses Geschäftsfeld erfahren Sie unter Radiopharma (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de-ch/molecular-imaging/radiopharma)

Ihre Qualifikationen und Erfahrung:

- Sie verfügen über einen Masterabschluss in Medizinischer Physik, radiologischer Gesundheit, Strahlenschutz, Ingenieurwesen, Chemie, Pharmazie oder einem verwandten naturwissenschaftlichen Studiengang.- Sie bringen fundierte Kenntnisse im Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen sowie zu EHS‑regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen mit, idealerweise aus einem regulierten industriellen oder pharmazeutischen Umfeld.- Sie verfügen über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in radiochemischen oder radiopharmazeutischen Betrieben oder im angewandten Strahlenschutz mit offenen radioaktiven Stoffen.- Sie besitzen ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für GMP‑regulierte Umgebungen und die damit verbundenen regulatorischen Anforderungen.- Sie haben nachweisliche Erfahrung im Projektmanagement und sind in der Lage, Zeitpläne, Prioritäten und bereichsübergreifende Liefergegenstände effektiv zu steuern.- Sie verfügen über sehr gute Anwenderkenntnisse der Microsoft‑365‑Tools.- Wir freuen uns auch über Bewerbende mit Bachelor-Abschluss oder abgeschlossener Berufsaus- und Weiterbildung in Verbindung mit zusätzlicher Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich.

Ihr Profil und Ihre Fähigkeiten:

- Sie verfügen über ausgezeichnete schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und können technische sowie regulatorische Inhalte klar und verständlich für unterschiedliche Stakeholder aufbereiten.- Sie zeichnen sich durch eine kooperative, proaktive Arbeitsweise aus und arbeiten effektiv in bereichsübergreifenden sowie remote organisierten Teams – bei gleichzeitig hoher persönlicher Verantwortungsübernahme.- Sie fühlen sich in einem hybriden Arbeitsumfeld wohl.- Sie sprechen fließend Englisch; weitere Sprachkenntnisse sind ein großer Vorteil.- Sie sind flexibel und bereit, bis zu 30 % pro Jahr innerhalb Europas, des Vereinigten Königreichs und Indiens zu reisen.- Sie sind bereit, in Deutschland, Frankreich, Spanien oder Italien zu leben bzw. bei Bedarf umzuziehen.

Unser globales Team:
Siemens Healthineers ist ein weltweit führendes Medizintechnikunternehmen. Mit mehr als 74.000 engagierten Mitarbeitenden in über 70 Ländern gestalten wir die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens. Jeden Tag profitieren etwa fünf Millionen Patient*innen weltweit von unseren innovativen Technologien und Dienstleistungen aus den Bereichen Diagnostik und therapeutische Bildgebung, Labordiagnostik und molekulare Medizin sowie von unseren digitalen Gesundheits- und Unternehmensdienstleistungen.

Unsere Kultur:
Unsere Unternehmenskultur schätzt verschiedene Blickwinkel, offene Diskussionen und den Willen, Konventionen in Frage zu stellen. Ständiger Wandel gehört zu unserem Arbeitsalltag. Wir wollen in unserer Branche Veränderungen vorantreiben, statt nur darauf zu reagieren. Deswegen laden wir Sie ein, sich neuen Herausforderungen zu stellen, eigene Ideen auszutesten und Erfolge zu feiern. Wir legen Wert auf Diversität und Chancengleichheit und freuen uns über Bewerbungen mit vielfältigen Hintergründen und insbesondere von Menschen mit Behinderung. #myabilityshs
Sie möchten mehr erfahren und erste Fragen gern persönlich klären – Sprechen Sie uns an: recruitinggersupport.func@siemens-healthineers.com. Kontaktperson dieser Stellenausschreibung ist SALIMA BOURHANI.

Die Personalbeschaffung bei Siemens Healthineers wird intern verwaltet. Should maintenance or cleaning be required, you are to inform your supervisor immediately and list any such issues on the daily inspection form
  • Adhere to the busing schedules
  • Wearing issued uniform in a presentable manner
  • Observance of all Government traffic laws and best practices which are enforced by the RGPF,
