jobs.title: Commercial Counsel
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

We are looking for an experienced attorney to join our Commercial Counsel team. This senior role will help build and support Notion’s rapidly evolving Enterprise customer sales motions, bringing deep expertise in negotiating complex AI SaaS agreements with enterprise customers, as well as acting as an advisor and coach to our account teams and cross functional partners. Notion is scaling rapidly, and we need people who work well as a tight-knit team with a passion for driving revenue deals to conclusion. If you enjoy using your deep industry and technology transaction expertise to support revenue generating functions, this role is for you.


Our Commercial Legal team sits at the center of Notion’s growth. We simplify how customers contract with us, take clear and unambiguous positions on AI, privacy, and security, and drive revenue deals to a fast, predictable close. That means exercising real judgment and finding creative, pragmatic paths forward through complex customer requests and requirements.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Have broad responsibility for negotiating SaaS AI agreements and providing practical day-to-day commercial legal support - primarily in the Americas region - for the sales, marketing, channels, and customer success teams with a focus on supporting the Enterprise segment

 - Collaborate with Product Legal team on product and operational items that impact customer agreements and go-to-market initiatives

 - Draft and negotiate complex agreements regarding privacy, security, and AI regulatory matters

 - Identify and independently pursue process improvements for buy-side supporting motions

 - Develop and revise contract templates and playbooks as necessary, based on changes in our product offerings, organization, and law




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Admitted to the California State Bar, New York State Bar, or Registered In-House Counsel in good standing

 - 10+ years of combined experience practicing as a commercial attorney within a law firm or software technology company

 - 2+ years in-house experience at a SaaS and/or AI technology company

 - Privacy and artificial intelligence subject matter expertise, including privacy regulations (GDPR, e-Privacy Directive, CCPA, etc.) and AI regulations (EU AI Act) with the ability to incorporate evolving requirements into the customer facing agreements

 - Experience driving commercial transactions, SaaS, and enterprise B2B transactions

 - Strong negotiation skills, including ability to explain nuanced legal concepts to internal and external parties and tailor approach to the audience

 - Excellent drafting, written and verbal communication skills and ability to adapt legal requirements in balanced, creative and pragmatic ways to facilitate communication at all levels of the organization

 - Ability to directly interact and build meaningful relationships and trust with internal and external clients and leaders

 - Demonstrated curiosity about AI and a willingness to adopt AI tools to work smarter, move faster, and deliver better results. Developing your personal AI fluency is required for this role

 - Resilience, resourcefulness, and the ability to make recommendations and decisions with imperfect facts

 - Independent and strategic thought combined with excellent team player qualities and a willingness to take on additional responsibilities




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Certified Information Privacy Professional or equivalent

 - Prior experience with a fast growing technology company

 - Experience supporting channel and reseller partnerships

 - Experience supporting customers in the financial services industry

 - Familiarity using Notion



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $280,000-340,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. jobs.title: Data Platform Engineer m/w/d (Data Scientist)
jobs.description:
At Damia Group Portugal (Permanent)Portugal
Expires at: 2027-05-12
Remote policy: Full remoteAbout the company: Damia Group is an international tech recruitment agency with 3 decades of experience. Our arrival in Portugal, 7 years later, was set on a mission to transform IT recruitment experiences and, through them, achieve better results. We believe in long-term relationships with a transparent and relaxed mindset. In a short period, we have reached the hearts of both scale-ups and larger organisations by delivering spot-on curated candidate shortlists, increased job offer acceptance rates and shorter time-to-fill.

Main requirements

Role OverviewThis is a senior, hands-on role for someone who views Data Infrastructure as a product.You will define how billions of records are structured, indexed, and exposed to the rest of the company. Ideal for someone who combines strong backend engineering skills with deep expertise in data platforms, data lakes, and large-scale data systems. Key Responsibilities

-
Database Reliability & Scaling:

- Own the health and performance of their core databases.
- Own and optimize their MongoDB clusters and OpenSearch indexes, which houses billions of documents. You will design sharding strategies and indexing patterns to ensure search performance.
- Design and implement a multi-tier storage strategy. You will determine which data remains "hot" in production databases for their Product team and which data is offloaded to "cold/analytical" storage for AI and R&D.
-
Data Access Layer:

- Build and maintain internal APIs that allow internal teams to build features without worrying about the underlying database complexities.
-
Schema Evolution & Migrations:

- Lead the strategy for updating data structures across billions of records. You will design "no-downtime" migration paths for their production MongoDB and OpenSearch environments.
-
Data Platform & Architecture

- Own and evolve their Core Data Architecture, ensuring it supports analytics, product features, AI workflows, and internal consumption.
- Evaluate the feasibility and ROI of introducing a Data Lakehouse architecture for long-term storage and AI training.
- Define standards for how data is ingested, stored, versioned, and exposed to downstream systems.
-
Data Quality & Documentation:

- Ensure data accuracy, freshness, and consistency through validation and testing.
- Maintain clear, up-to-date documentation of pipelines, schemas, and data assets to enable internal adoption.
-
Collaboration:

- Act as a bridge between Core, Product, and R&D, ensuring research initiatives (e.g. data enrichment) are integrated into the Core platform.
- Translate business and product needs into scalable, maintainable data solutions.
- Comfortable working in async-first environments, keeping task statuses and documentation up to date for full team visibility.

What They're Looking For

- 5+ years of experience in Backend, Data Engineering and/or Data Platform roles, specifically within high-concurrency/high-volume environments.
-
NoSQL & Search Expert. Professional experience tuning MongoDB and OpenSearch/Elasticsearch at massive scale (sharding, cluster topology, query optimization).

-
Strong Python Skills. Proficiency in writing production-grade, highly efficient Python. Experience with asynchronous programming (FastAPI, etc.) for building high-performance Internal APIs is essential.

-
System Design & Architecture. A strong grasp of distributed systems, including eventual consistency, message queues (Kafka/RabbitMQ), and caching strategies to protect production databases.

-
Strategic Storage Thinking. Familiarity with Data Lakehouse concepts (e.g., Parquet, Delta Lake, Iceberg). Proven experience building one.

- Excellent communication skills and attention to documentation.
- Self-managed and comfortable working cross-functionally.
- Fluent in English.
- Tax residency in Portugal.

jobs.title: Job i udlandet - Tag dit sabbatår i udlandet – få job, oplevelser. Start med gratis professionel rådgivning af Cathrine.
jobs.description:
Tag dit sabbatår i udlandet – få job, oplevelser og professionel rådgivning så du kommer trygt afsted.

Jeg hedder Cathrine, og jeg arbejder hos JobHuntWorldwide. Jeg kender følelsen af at stå med lysten til at tage af sted, men ikke helt vide, hvordan man gør det. Det er præcis derfor, jeg er her, til at gøre processen nem og tryg for dig.

Drømmer du om at bruge dit sabbatår på noget helt andet end hverdagen i Danmark? Jeg hjælper unge danskere med at finde arbejde i udlandet – både hvis du vil udvikle dig fagligt, møde nye mennesker eller bare prøve noget helt nyt for en periode.

Vi samarbejder med virksomheder i bl.a. Spanien, Grækenland, Portugal, Malta, Cypern, Vietnam og Filippinerne, og mange stillinger kræver ingen tidligere erfaring.

Hvad kan du forvente?

✔ Gratis og uforpligtende karrieresamtale

Vi starter altid med en personlig snak om dine ønsker for dit sabbatår. Vil du opkvalificeres? Vil du have et socialt fællesskab? Eller vil du bare prøve noget helt nyt? Jeg hjælper dig med at finde den løsning, der passer til dig.

✔ Hjælp til at finde det rette job

Dine muligheder afhænger af, hvornår du vil afsted, og hvor længe du kan være væk. Mange virksomheder ansætter uden erfaring, mens andre har specifikke krav – det gennemgår vi sammen.

Du skal som udgangspunkt kunne sige ja til 4–6 måneder, og du får naturligvis betalt ferie, så du kan rejse hjem undervejs.

✔ Professionel forberedelse til jobinterview

Når vi har fundet et match, præsenterer jeg dig for virksomheden og klæder dig på til interviewet. Du får:

  • Feedback på dit CV

  • Råd om spørgsmål du bør stille

  • Forventningsafstemning om bolig, løn, kontrakt og praktiske forhold

Jeg følger dig hele vejen frem til din første arbejdsdag.

Hvilke typer job kan du få?

Der er mange muligheder – alt efter dine ønsker og kompetencer. Eksempler:

  • Kundeservice og teknisk support

  • Rejsebranchen og booking

  • Telemarketing og mødebooking

  • Reception og administration

  • Fundraising

  • Online kundekommunikation

  • Online gaming Presenter

  • Specialiserede roller (fx gaming support, ansvarlig spilrådgivning, medicinsk assistance)

Nogle stillinger inkluderer betalt fly, hotel eller firmabolig, afhængigt af landet og virksomheden.

Vigtige råd, før du siger ja.

Jeg hjælper dig med at træffe den rigtige beslutning ved at gennemgå bl.a.:

  • Arbejdsforhold og kontrakt

  • Boligmuligheder og økonomi

  • Løn, udbetaling og ferie

  • Oplæring og forventninger

  • Stabilitet i projektet

  • Hvad du ønsker at få ud af dit ophold

Det er vigtigt, at du vælger et job, der passer til dine mål – ikke bare det første og bedste.

Sådan kommer du i gang.

Du kan booke en gratis og uforpligtende karrieresnak med mig, hvor vi gennemgår dine muligheder og hjælper dig med at finde det rette match.

Kontakt os på Cathrine@jobhuntworldwide.com

Eller du kan også allerede nu booke en snak med mig via dette link: Book et kald

jobs.title: Produktion av reklamställ, mässmonterbyggnation samt slutbehandling av tryck och förpackning
jobs.description:
Produktionsmedarbetare till TETRIX – för dig som gillar att kunna lite av allt

På TETRIX bygger vi mässmontrar, displaysystem, ljuslådor, reklamställningar och speciallösningar för företag. En del produkter tillverkar vi om och om igen. Andra har vi aldrig byggt tidigare.

Därför söker vi inte nödvändigtvis någon som redan kan allt. Vi söker dig som **gillar att lära dig nya saker, lösa problem och få saker färdiga.**

Vad gör man då hos oss?

Aluminiumkonstruktionerna till våra produkter tillverkar vi i vår egen aluminiumverkstad. Där kapas lätta aluminiumprofiler, lås och beslag monteras och det förekommer borrning, gängning och enklare maskinarbete.

Du behöver inte kunna det från början. **Vi lär dig.**

Eftersom vi gör mycket kundanpassat dyker det regelbundet upp saker som inte riktigt finns i någon manual. Då behöver man kunna fundera:

_Hur löser vi det här på ett enkelt och smart sätt?_

Ibland finns svaret redan hos någon av oss. Ibland får man mäta, prova, fundera och prova igen.

Vi producerar också storbildsgrafik till våra mässmontrar och reklamställningar. Våra storbildsplottrar skriver ut bilderna, varefter grafiken ska renskäras, efterbehandlas och anpassas till systemen.

När alla delar är klara testbygger vi ofta produkten. Den ska passa ihop, fungera och se ut som den ska innan kunden får den.

Sedan packas den för transport – eller så åker vi ut och bygger upp hela lösningen hos kunden.

Ena dagen aluminium – nästa dag något helt annat

Det här är alltså inte jobbet för dig som helst vill göra exakt samma arbetsmoment varje dag.

En dag kan du kapa aluminium och montera beslag.

Nästa dag kanske du skär storbildsgrafik, packar en mässmonter som ska till Sverige, letar fram delar från lagret eller försöker lista ut hur vi ska bygga en specialkonstruktion som någon har ritat.

Och ibland står en mässa runt hörnet, transporten går snart och **allt ska bli klart.**

Då behöver vi arbetsmyran i dig.

Den som inte ger upp när det blir bråttom utan istället börjar fundera på vad som måste göras först, vad som kan göras samtidigt och hur vi tillsammans får allt över mållinjen.

Bråttom betyder däremot inte att det får bli dåligt. Kunden ska fortfarande få rätt delar, snygg grafik och en produkt som fungerar.

Vi tror att du passar hos oss om...

Du är lite av en **tusenkonstnär**.

Du behöver inte vara aluminiumexpert, grafiker, montör, lagerarbetare och uppfinnare redan när du kommer genom dörren. Det viktiga är att du är nyfiken nog att lära dig.

Du behöver inte heller vara någon maskinexpert. Men det är ett stort plus om du inte blir nervös av tanken:

_"Den där maskinen har jag aldrig använt. Visa mig."_

Vi visar. Du provar. Snart kan du den.

Du bör också ha ett naturligt öga för detaljer. Ser du att något sitter snett, ligger på fel plats eller borde städas undan är tanken att du fixar det – inte väntar på att någon ska skriva en arbetsorder.

Hos oss hör ordning faktiskt till produktionen. Delarna ska gå att hitta, lagret ska hållas i skick och arbetsplatserna ska vara sådana att nästa jobb går snabbt att starta.

Det viktigaste är hur du fungerar

Nästan alla enskilda arbetsmoment hos oss är ganska enkla när man väl har lärt sig dem.

Utmaningen ligger istället i **variationen och helheten**.

Du behöver kunna växla mellan olika uppgifter, tänka själv, fråga när du inte vet och efter hand lära dig att se vad som behöver göras utan att någon hela tiden pekar ut nästa arbetsmoment.

Vissa dagar behövs uppfinnaren.

Andra dagar behövs problemlösaren.

Och ibland behövs helt enkelt arbetsmyran som bestämmer sig för att:

**Det här ska bli klart.**

Vi uppskattar människor som vågar prova. Gör man många speciallösningar kommer inte första idén alltid att vara den bästa. Det viktiga är att kunna tänka om och hitta en bättre lösning.

Praktiskt

Du behöver **B-körkort**, eftersom arbetet ibland innebär transporter eller montering hos kund.

Vi arbetar med kunder på flera språk. Kan du svenska och finska är det utmärkt. Engelska är också mycket användbart eftersom både kunder, leverantörer och instruktioner kan vara internationella.

Erfarenhet från produktion, aluminium, snickeri, reklamproduktion, montering, lager, byggande, maskiner eller liknande är naturligtvis ett plus.

Men rätt inställning väger tungt.

**Kan du inte – lär vi dig. Förstår du inte – frågar du. Finns ingen färdig lösning – försöker vi hitta en.**

Det är ungefär så vi jobbar på TETRIX.

Så om du gillar praktiskt arbete, teknik, problemlösning och variation – och helst vill ha ett jobb där du fortfarande kan lära dig något nytt nästa år – då kan det här vara rätt plats för dig.

**Lapland Staff is looking for Clothing Team workers for various locations of Lapland Safaris for the Christmas season 2026. We are looking for Clothing Team workers to work in Saariselkä, Hetta and Olos.**

As a Clothing Team worker, you will assist guests to get properly dressed for winter activities for their entire holiday. Safari clothing includes overalls, woolen socks, boots, gloves, balaclava, and a hat if needed. After the safaris guests return the clothes and the clothing team is responsible for the washing and organizing of the clothing. The team also ensures that the customer premises are clean and organized. Work is an important part of the success of safari excursions.

You are the person we are looking for if you are customer service-oriented and have a positive attitude towards your work. We value diligence, initiative, teamwork skills, and conscientiousness in our employees. **In addition, please note that in order to work in Finland, EU-citizenship/passport or valid working permit to Finland is required. Please read more under the job advertisement.**

Due to the busy nature of seasonal work, we require flexibility in working hours and the ability to withstand pressure brought by the demands and challenges set by the work. Work is often physically demanding. Sometimes the working days can be long, and the work is done on weekdays, weekends, and Christmas holidays.

Communication with guests is conducted mainly in English. Your English language skills do not have to be excellent, but you need to be able to give instructions to our guests in English and at least briefly answer their questions or direct the questions to another colleague. Other language skills, especially Spanish and French, are also useful in our fell destinations. Previous experience of similar tasks in the field of tourism is considered advantageous, as well as experience driving a large van (class B drivers license) in arctic conditions.

**In Hetta** our Clothing team workers also work as Outdoor Activity Instructors for our Christmas-themed activities.

**In Olos** our Clothing team workers are responsible for distributing and maintaining the clothing of Charter guests in Lapland Hotels Olos area.

**We offer you:**

- A great team to work with

- Versatile and variable working days

- An easy way to start working in the field of tourism in Lapland

- Numerous leisure opportunities

- Comprehensive staff benefits of Lapland Hotels & Lapland Safaris. You will receive benefits for example from equipment rental, restaurants and Lapland Ski Resorts lift tickets.


Lapland Safaris provides new employees with paid, role-specific training at the beginning of their employment.

The employment relationship is a fixed term seasonal contract by the Collective Agreement in the Adventure Services sector. Work will begin at the end of November 2026 and will last approximately until the end of December or beginning of January 2027. Salary according to the Collective Agreement of Adventure Services grade A, hourly wage starting from 10,10 € (gross). Work will be done also during weekends and public holidays. Sundays and Finnish public holidays are paid double. Except for Rovaniemi, accommodation is arranged; in shared rooms at a rent that is reasonable compared to the local price level.

jobs.title: Chef, Restaurant Aihki, Pyhätunturi, Finnish Lapland
jobs.description:
**Join the team at Restaurant Aihki in Pyhätunturi!**

We are looking for a **Chef** to join Restaurant Aihki for the winter season 2026 - 2027, as part of Sunday Morning Resort in Pyhätunturi, Finnish Lapland.

Restaurant Aihki is known for its high-quality modern Nordic cuisine, where pure, locally sourced ingredients take centre stage. Our restaurant has twice been recognised among **Finland's Best Restaurants** by _Kauppalehti Optio_ (2022 & 2023, rating 16+).

As a Chef at Restaurant Aihki, you will work as part of our professional kitchen team and take an active role in daily food preparation and service. You will work with high-quality ingredients and help ensure that every dish leaving the kitchen meets Aihki's high standards.

This position is ideal for a chef with a few years of professional kitchen experience who is looking to develop their skills in a high-quality restaurant environment. Experience in à la carte, fine dining or Nordic cuisine is considered an advantage, but most importantly, we are looking for a professional attitude, a strong team spirit and a genuine passion for great food.

**Your responsibilities include:**

- Preparing and presenting dishes according to Restaurant Aihki's standards

- Working across different kitchen stations during daily service

- Preparing and handling ingredients

- Following Aihki's recipes, procedures and quality standards

- Ensuring the quality, proper storage and rotation of ingredients

- Following kitchen hygiene, food safety and self-monitoring procedures

- Keeping your workstation clean, organised and ready for service

- Working closely with the rest of the kitchen and front-of-house teams


**We are looking for someone who has:**

- Approximately 2-3 years of professional kitchen experience

- A relevant culinary qualification or equivalent practical experience

- Experience in an à la carte restaurant; fine dining or Nordic cuisine experience is considered an advantage

- Strong fundamental cooking skills and an interest in high-quality ingredients

- An organised, responsible and proactive approach to work

- The ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced kitchen environment

- Good teamwork and communication skills

- Good spoken English; Finnish and other languages are considered an advantage

- Motivation to learn and continue developing professionally

- Above all, a positive attitude and genuine passion for high-quality food


**We offer you:**

- The opportunity to work in one of Finland's highly regarded restaurants

- The opportunity to develop your skills in modern Nordic cuisine

- An inspiring working environment surrounded by the beautiful landscapes of Pyhätunturi, Finnish Lapland

- The support of a welcoming, professional and international team

- Comprehensive onboarding before your employment begins

- The possibility of staff accommodation close to the workplace

- Comprehensive occupational healthcare and local employee benefits

- Access to shared company season passes for Pyhä Ski Resort

- Employee benefits for selected activities

- The opportunity to work for a Sustainable Travel Finland certified company

- An excellent location close to Pyhä Ski Resort and local services

- A competitive salary based on your experience and skills, with the MARA collective agreement as the basis for salary


**Employment**

The position begins in **mid-November 2026** and continues until the **end of March 2027**.

This is a **full-time seasonal position**, approximately **40 hours per week**, with two days off per week. Shifts are mainly scheduled in the afternoon and evening.

Working a winter season in Pyhä also means experiencing the Arctic winter, snowy fells and the unique atmosphere of Finnish Lapland right outside your workplace.

**About us**

**Sunday Morning Collection is a Finnish family-owned tourism company** offering high-quality accommodation, dining and activity experiences in the breathtaking surroundings of Pyhä-Luosto National Park.

Sustainability is at the heart of what we do. We are committed to developing tourism responsibly, respecting the unique nature of Lapland and working closely with local businesses and partners.

As an employer, we believe in a positive working atmosphere, open communication, strong team spirit and opportunities for professional growth. With us, you'll work with international guests in the beautiful surroundings of Pyhätunturi as part of a skilled and close-knit team.

Restaurant Aihki is the restaurant of Sunday Morning Resort, combining the flavours and local ingredients of Lapland with contemporary Scandinavian influences. Throughout the season, we also organise themed dining events and guest chef evenings.

Discover Restaurant Aihki on Instagram **@restaurantaihki** and at **sundaymorning.fi/restaurant-aihki**.

**Interested?**

Please send your application with the subject line **Chef Aihki / \[Your Name\]**, together with your CV and salary expectation.

Tell us about your background, professional experience and why you would like to spend the upcoming winter season as part of the Aihki team.

We review applications throughout the recruitment period, so we encourage you to apply early.

In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Job Title: Car Paint Sprayer / Panel Beater Employer: Darius Gronskis T/A Golden Autobody Ltd Location: Unit 3, Larkins Cross, Parteen, County Clare V94 7X40 Annual Salary: €41,600 Hours of Work: 40h per week Job Description: Assess accident damage and vehicle bodywork to determine the appropriate repair and refinishing requirements. Remove, repair and replace damaged vehicle body panels and structural and non-structural components. Straighten, reshape and align damaged panels and vehicle bodywork using appropriate panel beating and body repair techniques. Carry out welding, cutting, grinding and finishing work where required as part of vehicle body repairs. Fit and align repaired or replacement panels, ensuring correct positioning, panel gaps and body alignment. Prepare vehicle body surfaces for painting by sanding, filling, grinding, cleaning and masking. Apply primers, sealers and undercoats to prepared surfaces as required. Match vehicle paint colours and mix automotive paints according to the required specifications. Apply base coats, colour coats and clear coats using professional automotive spray-painting equipment. Operate spray booths and associated painting equipment safely and effectively. Inspect painted surfaces and carry out polishing, blending, touch-ups and other finishing work where required. Reassemble vehicle panels, trims and fittings following completion of body repairs and paintwork. Carry out final quality checks to ensure body repairs, panel alignment and paint finishes meet the required professional standards. Maintain tools, equipment and work areas in a clean and safe condition. Comply with all relevant health and safety procedures when carrying out body repairs, welding, surface preparation and spray painting. Requirements: Previous professional experience as a Car Paint Sprayer, Panel Beater, Vehicle Body Repairer, Vehicle Paint Technician, or in a similar automotive body repair and refinishing role. Practical experience in vehicle body repair, including panel removal, repair, replacement, straightening and alignment. Practical experience in automotive surface preparation, including sanding, filling, masking and priming. Experience in automotive colour matching, paint mixing and professional spray painting. Ability to use panel beating tools, body repair equipment, welding equipment, sanding tools and automotive spray-painting equipment safely and effectively. Good knowledge of vehicle body repair methods, materials and automotive refinishing processes. Ability to assess vehicle body damage and determine appropriate repair methods. Ability to achieve accurate panel alignment and high-quality paint finishes. Strong attention to detail and commitment to professional repair standards. Good knowledge of workplace health and safety procedures relevant to vehicle body repair and automotive paint spraying. Ability to work independently and efficiently while maintaining high-quality standards.

jobs.title: Planning Engineer
jobs.description:
Enersense Engineering is currently looking for Planning Engineers to join our clients data centre project in Lohja, Finland. Work will start in the beginning of November 2026.

In this role, you will support the Planning Lead in coordinating project planning activities, including scheduling, progress tracking and reporting. You will work closely with project teams, contractors and other stakeholders, helping ensure that project timelines, resources and deliverables remain on track. This is an excellent opportunity to contribute to a large-scale project and gain valuable experience in a dynamic project environment.
Main tasks and responsibilities:
* Develop, maintain and update project schedules, including Level I–III schedules and the overall master schedule.
* Support baseline development, progress measurement and weekly/monthly reporting.
* Coordinate schedules and progress information from multiple contractors and integrate them into the overall project schedule.
* Monitor and forecast progress, identify potential delays and recommend corrective actions.
* Analyse critical paths and develop alternative scheduling solutions to support project execution.
* Develop and maintain plan-versus-actual curves, histograms and progress reports, analysing deviations from the plan.
* Monitor resource allocation and provide recommendations to maintain project progress.
* Coordinate key dates, interfaces and planning activities between project teams, contractors and other stakeholders.
* Collect and analyse progress data, actual dates and work-hour information.
* Participate in the analysis of contractor progress updates and schedules.
* Prepare and issue updated schedules, dashboards and weekly/monthly reports.

Requirements:
* Experience in project planning, scheduling or project controls, preferably in large-scale construction, industrial or data centre projects.
* Good working knowledge of Primavera P6.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Experience with progress measurement, schedule analysis and contractor coordination.
* Ability to identify risks and deviations and recommend practical solutions.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Structured and detail-oriented approach to planning and reporting.
* Ability to work independently while being an effective member of a multidisciplinary project team.

We understand that relocating for a new opportunity is a major decision. To support a smooth transition, we can assist international candidates with the relocation process to Finland.

We follow pay transparency principles and the salary level and the criteria used to determine it will be communicated to candidates before the interview.

Due to GDPR regulations, applications will only be accepted through our official application system.

We manage this recruitment process internally and therefore do not require support from external recruitment agencies.

If you have any questions, please contact: Sanna Uronen, HR Coordinator, +358 40 176 5270, sanna.uronen@enersense.com

We are Enersenses Expert Services team. We deliver qualified and compliant workforce solutions for our clients' demanding technical and engineering projects locally and internationally. jobs.title: Redovisningskonsult – föräldraledighetsvikariat till teamet för skandinaviska kunder
jobs.description:
Rantalainen är Finlands ledande och snabbväxande expertorganisation inom ekonomi- och löneadministrativa tjänster. Vi finns på över 100 kontor i Finland, Sverige och Norge. Vi erbjuder företag i alla storlekar ett brett utbud av tjänster inom ekonomi- och löneadministration, HR samt företagsbeskattning för att stötta deras affärsverksamhet och framgång. Våra närmare 45 000 kundföretag har tillgång till kompetensen hos över 2 700 experter. Läs mer om oss på vår webbplats här [https://www.rantalainen.fi/sv/].



Vi söker nu en redovisningskonsult för ett föräldraledighetsvikariat till teamet för skandinaviska kunder i Västra Nyland!



I denna roll arbetar du med ett konsultativt arbetssätt med våra kundföretags bokföring, bokslut och andra uppgifter inom ekonomiförvaltning. Du har regelbunden kontakt med dina kunder och använder din expertis för att omvandla ekonomiska siffror till beslutsunderlag samt bidra till utvecklingen av våra kunders verksamhet ur ett ekonomiskt perspektiv.

Du får planera och genomföra ditt arbete självständigt, men har alltid stöd av ditt eget team och hela vår breda expertorganisation. Som stöd i arbetet har du ett glatt och hjälpsamt team samt din närmaste chef.



Ditt teams bas finns på det Rantalainen-kontor som ligger närmast dig, till exempel i Västra Nyland eller huvudstadsregionen. Vi hoppas att du vid behov har möjlighet att arbeta på något av våra kontor tillsammans med de övriga teammedlemmarna. Enligt överenskommelse kan du också delvis arbeta på distans. Tjänsten är ett tidsbegränsat föräldraledighetsvikariat med en beräknad anställningstid från 1.10.2026 – 31.10.2027.



Vad erbjuder Rantalainen dig?

På Rantalainen erbjuder vi dig en intressant och ansvarsfull roll på Finlands ledande redovisningsbyrå inom en spännande bransch. Hos oss får du stöd av en kunnig organisation, goda möjligheter till kompetensutveckling och moderna arbetsverktyg. Som en flexibel arbetsgivare ger vi dig friheten att planera ditt eget arbete, flexibel arbetstid och möjlighet till distansarbete, så att det blir enklare att kombinera arbetet med övriga delar av livet.

Vår ambition är att vara den bästa arbetsplatsen inom ekonomi- och löneadministration, både idag och i framtiden. På Rantalainen värdesätts varje medarbetare för den hen är, och hos oss får du en trivsam arbetsmiljö och en rättvis värdegrund. Vi satsar på ett kvalitativt ledarskap och goda karriärmöjligheter inom företaget.



Läs mer om våra omfattande personalförmåner och om Rantalainen som arbetsgivare på vår webbplats. Du kan också kolla Markus medarbetarberättelse och läsa mer om hur det är att arbeta hos oss som redovisningskonsult.



Det här hoppas vi att du har med dig?

Vi hoppas att du har en utbildning inom ekonomiförvaltning och erfarenhet av arbete inom området. Att upprätta bokslut är välbekant för dig, och du behärskar helheten inom ekonomiförvaltning samt arbetar självständigt. Du arbetar smidigt med kunder, och därför förutsätter vi att du kan arbeta på både svenska och finska. Kunskaper i engelska räknas till fördel.



Vi värdesätter erfarenhet av olika programvaror inom ekonomiförvaltning samt en vilja att lära dig nya system. Till dessa erbjuder vi naturligtvis en grundlig introduktion. Hos oss får du möjlighet att upprätthålla och utveckla din kompetens genom mångsidiga och kontinuerliga utbildningar.



Vänligen ansök så snart som möjligt, dock senast 6.9.2026. Vi behandlar ansökningar redan under ansökningstiden och fattar beslut så snart en lämplig person hittas. Vänta alltså inte till sista ansökningsdagen. Vi kontrollerar kreditupplysningar för den person som väljs i slutet av rekryteringsprocessen. Observera att vi inte tar emot ansökningar per e-post.



Om du vill höra mer om tjänsten eller ditt framtida team berättar Business Director Joakim Lindfors gärna mer (010 321 6801).

jobs.title: Den selvejende institution. Stefanshjemmet søger pr. 1.10.2026 eller snarest derefter en medarbejder 15-20 timer i gennemsnit pr. uge.
jobs.description:
Den selvejende institution Stefanshjemmet søger pr. 1.10.2026 eller snarest derefter en medarbejder 15-20 timer i gennemsnit pr. uge.

Stefanshjemmet er et bo- og beskæftigelsestilbud til mennesker med erhvervet hjerneskade og/eller svære fysiske handicap.

Der er 10 beboere på en afdeling, og de har en erhvervet hjerneskade. På afdelingen er der ca.15 faste medarbejdere med forskellig baggrund og faglighed til at varetage pleje, omsorg, bostøtte og aktivitet for beboerne efter serviceloven.

På Stefanshjemmet værner vi om det tværfaglige miljø og har omkring 130 ansatte. Hovedgrupperne af ansatte består af SOSU-assistenter, pædagoger og ergo- og fysioterapeuter.

Det kan også være du er uddannet SOSU-hjælper eller sygehjælper.

Vi søger en medarbejder, der

·        brænder for sit fag

·        har lyst til at bruge tid sammen med beboerne i løbet af dagen til aktivitet og samvær og være med til at skabe en god hverdag for beboerne

·        evner at tage sig tid til nærvær med beboerne og påskønner livshistorierne

·        er engageret og god til at se muligheder

·        er udadvendt, opsøgende og initiativrig

·        ser værdien i dokumentation og deling af viden. Vi bruger dokumentationssystemet Modulus.

·        Det kan også være, du er fleksjobber, hvor timetallet passer godt

 

 

Som ansat på Stefanshjemmet er det vigtigt for os, at du er fagligt stolt, engageret og har hjertet på rette sted og et menneskesyn der stemmer overens med Stefanshjemmets værdier. Beboernes selvbestemmelse og værdighed ligger os meget på sinde.

Dagligdagen byder på mange spændende faglige udfordringer og etiske dilemmaer, gode kollegaer, godt arbejdsmiljø og højt humør.

Arbejdet på afdelingerne tager udgangspunkt i beboernes behov og muligheder og vi arbejder mere og mere med KRAP-modellens anerkendende og ressourceorienterede tilgang, såvel som vores neuropædagogiske tilgang, samt værdier og etik.

Alle medarbejdere indgår i arbejdet med plejeopgaver, bostøtte og aktiviteter for beboerne og byder ind i de fælles opgaver med hver deres faglighed. Vi søger en dedikeret medarbejder, der har lyst til at indgå i plejen, omsorgen og aktiviteterne for beboerne. Vi arbejder med udvikling af afdelingen såvel monofagligt som tværfagligt, så kompetencer og viden kommer bedst muligt i spil.

Du skal være indstillet på, at der er tale om et arbejde, hvor man skal have en god fysik samt kunne arbejde et sted, hvor man af og til udfordres følelsesmæssigt i sit arbejde.

Hvis du bliver ansat hos os, vil der blive udarbejdet et introduktionsprogram for dig, som en del af din oplæring i huset.

Vi får pr. 1.10.2026 også en ledig stilling i vaskeriet på ca. 10 timer pr. uge. Hvis du har interesse i også at søge denne stilling, må du gerne notere det i din ansøgning.

Vi vil glæde os til at modtage din ansøgning og håber, du kan se dig ind i de arbejdsopgaver, der er skitseret ovenfor.

Vil du vide mere er du velkommen til at kontakte afdelingsleder Tina Rudebeck Holm på tiruho@aarhus.dk  eller telefonnr. 4185 7871

Du kan også få mere at vide om Stefanshjemmet på vores hjemmeside: www.stefanshjemmet.dk.

Arbejdstiden er skiftende dag- og aftenvagter med arbejde hver 3. weekend.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår er i henhold til gældende overenskomster.

Vi har driftsoverenskomst med Aarhus kommune.

Ansøgningsfristen er onsdag den 23. september kl. 8.00 og ansøgninger kan sendes pr. mail på info@stefanshjemmet.dk mærket ”Medarbejder til HG2”

Vil du arbejde med renovering af beton?

Hos Christiansen & Essenbæk er vi på udkig efter flere dygtige kolleger til vores afdeling for betonrenovering. Har du erfaring med betonarbejde – og trives du både med at skabe noget nyt og give nyt liv til det gamle – så vil vi rigtig gerne høre fra dig.

Som en del af vores specialiserede entreprenørvirksomhed får du fingrene i alt fra fundamenter og bundplader til reparation og forstærkning af eksisterende konstruktioner. Vi løser både store projekter, der kræver tung faglighed, og mindre opgaver, hvor detaljen gør forskellen.

Du bliver en del af et hold, hvor faglighed, samarbejde og ordentligt håndværk står øverst på dagsordenen – og hvor der er plads til udvikling, sparring og gode kollegaer undervejs.

Eksempler på opgaver du kan komme til at arbejde med:
  • Udførelse af fundamenter, sokler og terrændæk
  • Betonrenovering og finisharbejder
  • Renovering af altaner
  • Støbning af trapper, ramper og støttemure
  • Mindre elementmontager og specialopgaver

Du bliver en del af et sjak, hvor man hjælper hinanden og løfter i flok. Nogle opgaver vil du løse selvstændigt, andre i tæt samarbejde med dine kollegaer og sjakbajs.

Vi forestiller os, at du:
  • Har erfaring med betonarbejde, fx som struktør eller betonarbejder
  • Har kendskab til armering, støbning, forskalling og arbejde med diverse mørtler
  • Er mødestabil og god til at samarbejde
  • Har mod på en alsidig og fysisk arbejdsdag
  • Er engageret og har lyst til at blive en del af fællesskabet
Hos os kan du forvente:
  • Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med gode kollegaer og ordentlig tone
  • Specialiserede og varierende opgaver inden for beton

jobs.title: Midwife with International Experience Wanted for the Labour Ward at Aalborg University Hospital
jobs.description:
Become Part of a Unique Community – Midwife with International Experience Wanted for the Labour Ward at Aalborg University Hospital
Do you dream of working in a place where professional excellence, compassion, and development go hand in hand?
Where you are surrounded every day by dedicated colleagues, and where your skills and experience are recognised, utilised, and appreciated?
If so, this is your opportunity to join our fantastic maternity team at Aalborg University Hospital.

We are seeking a midwife with international experience and knowledge of different childbirth cultures for a permanent position, starting on 1 September 2026 or as soon as possible. We wish to expand our work on childbirth culture and cultural understanding and are therefore looking for a midwife who can contribute to this development. The position is not a development role, but a standard clinical midwife position on the labour ward with a special professional profile.

We expect you to have experience working as a midwife in a non-European country and to be fluent in a widely spoken world language other than English. You must have completed the Danish adaptation and evaluation employment programme and hold Danish authorisation as a midwife.

Why Choose Us?
At Aalborg University Hospital, you will find more than just a job—you will become part of a strong, supportive, and professionally inspiring community.
We are the largest maternity unit in the North Denmark Region. As a highly specialised department, we provide care for approximately 3,300 pregnant women, women in labour, postpartum women, and their families each year. Here, you will have the opportunity to apply your professional expertise in a dynamic environment with varied responsibilities and room for both specialisation and professional development.

In addition, we offer:
  • A clinical supervising midwife on every shift as a dedicated professional mentor
  • A personal coordinator during your onboarding period
  • A buddy system on every shift
  • Opportunities for professional courses, supervision, and targeted competency development
  • Teams and professional communities that hold regular group meetings with both professional and social content

You will become part of a large and engaged professional community consisting of approximately 150 skilled colleagues—midwives, nurses, healthcare assistants, doctors, and administrative staff—all dedicated to creating safe, coordinated, and professional maternity care pathways.

Opportunities with Us
We understand that a long working life includes changing needs and interests. Therefore, we place great emphasis on flexibility and the opportunity to combine different functions according to your preferences.
This means you may combine work in areas such as:
  • Labour Ward and Midwifery Antenatal Clinic
  • Labour Ward and Maternity Assessment Unit
  • Labour Ward and Postnatal Ward

The majority of our midwives work in combined positions like these, creating professional variety, development opportunities, and job satisfaction.
We highly prioritise education and professional growth, and as a midwife with us, you will be part of a workplace where learning and development are natural parts of everyday practice.

Who Are You?
You are a qualified midwife with substantial professional experience from another country and exposure to a different childbirth culture.
You thrive in a professionally strong environment where teamwork, safety, and professionalism are central values.
You are passionate about working in the birthing suite. You enjoy building new relationships and work confidently both in complex obstetric cases and in births where the most important task is simply “being there” for the woman and her family.
You are able to identify the differences between childbirth cultures and contribute valuable insights and reflections to the daily professional discussions on the labour ward.

In addition, we expect that you are fluent in a widely spoken world language other than English. You must have completed the Danish adaptation and evaluation employment programme and hold Danish authorisation as a midwife.

Most importantly, you:
  • Want to become part of a committed and caring team
  • Contribute positively to a supportive and developmental work environment
  • Are passionate about creating safe and coherent childbirth experiences

Our Values – Your Foundation
Our work is based on the North Denmark Region’s core values: Involvement, Trust, Decency, and Professionalism (I-TOP).
This means that we meet women, families, and relatives with empathy and respect—and we treat each other in the same way.

We Offer You
  • A workplace characterised by high professional standards, warmth, and humour
  • Strong interdisciplinary collaboration where everyone contributes
  • A quality standard that ensures one midwife for every woman in labour
  • A work environment where psychological and physical well-being are prioritised
  • Supervision by trained supervisors in structured group programmes
  • A unique collaboration between Health and Safety Representatives, Union Representatives, and Management, based on openness, respect, and trust
  • A department where ideas are encouraged and where your voice matters
  • A workplace that values your experience and is genuinely curious about your professional background

And last—but certainly not least:
The best colleagues in the world and a workplace you look forward to coming to every day.

Salary and Employment Conditions
Salary and employment terms according to the current collective agreement for non-managing midwives, etc., concluded with the Danish Midwives' Association.

Further Information
For questions about the position, please contact:
Arianne Brandborg Nørhave
Acting Deputy Head Midwife and Manager of the Labour Ward
Phone: +45 20 73 07 50
Email: a.noerhave@rn.dk

Recruitment Process
Application deadline: 20th of september 2026
Please submit your application, CV, and any other relevant documents electronically to this e-mail: m.cederstroem@rn.dk

Interviews: Expected to take place shortly after the application deadline.

Starting date: 1th of October 2026 or earlier by agreement.

jobs.title: Financial Controller
jobs.description:
Har du starka kunskaper inom redovisning och ekonomi, och motiveras du av att skapa struktur, kvalitet och insikter i finansiella processer? Trivs du i en roll där du får ansvar för rapportering, controlling och ekonomisk uppföljning? Då kan detta vara rätt möjlighet för dig.

Om rollen

Tjänsten är baserad på vårt nordiska huvudkontor i Albertslund, Danmark. Som Financial Controller får du en viktig roll i den löpande ekonomistyrningen och rapporteringen av våra verksamheter. Ditt huvudsakliga ansvarsområde blir att stötta och följa upp våra svenska och finska bolag samt säkerställa hög kvalitet i den finansiella rapporteringen och ekonomiska uppföljningen.

Du ansvarar för finansiell uppföljning, månads- och årsbokslut samt för att säkerställa noggrannhet och kvalitet i våra redovisningsdata och finansiella rapporter. Du kommer att delta aktivt i budget- och prognosprocesser, analysera ekonomiska resultat och bidra med insikter som stödjer ledningens beslutsfattande.

Du kommer även att arbeta med processförbättringar och interna kontroller för att säkerställa effektiva och robusta finansiella processer. Rollen innebär nära samarbete med både interna och externa intressenter, och du kommer att bidra till att säkerställa efterlevnad av gällande redovisningsprinciper och interna riktlinjer.

Ditt arbete kommer att vara avgörande för att skapa transparens, kvalitet och kontroll i våra finansiella processer.

Vem är du?

Vi söker dig som inte bara är erfaren, utan även har ett genuint intresse för att skapa struktur och kvalitet i ekonomiska processer. Du har en relevant utbildning inom ekonomi, redovisning eller finans samt erfarenhet från en liknande roll.

Du behärskar engelska och minst ett skandinaviskt språk och har stark analytisk förmåga. Du arbetar strukturerat och noggrant och är bekväm med att hantera stora datamängder och finansiella analyser. Erfarenhet av ERP-system och Excel är meriterande.

Som person är du proaktiv, ansvarstagande och självständig. Du trivs med att samarbeta över organisatoriska gränser, skapar förtroende genom din professionalism och har ett naturligt intresse för att förbättra processer och arbetssätt. Du tar ägarskap för dina uppgifter och levererar resultat med hög kvalitet inom överenskomna tidsramar.

Intresserad?

Vi genomför intervjuer löpande, så skicka in din ansökan och ditt CV redan idag.

Har du frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta Heidrun Thorsteinsdottir på +45 2234 6657.

Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

jobs.title: Paving Worker / Landscaping Construction Worker – Practical Skills
jobs.description:
Work location: Denmark
Working hours: 37 hours per week
Employment type: Full-time, permanent position
Salary: After qualificatons
Start date: By agreement

About the position

We are looking for practical and reliable employees to carry out paving and landscaping construction work in Denmark.

The position is suitable for candidates who have good practical skills, an aptitude for manual work and an interest in construction and outdoor work.

A formal vocational qualification as a paving worker or landscaper is not required.

Instead, we value practical experience, a good understanding of manual work, accuracy, reliability and the ability to learn new working methods.

Main duties

The work will primarily include:

  • Paving and surfacing work

  • Laying paving stones, concrete slabs, cobblestones, kerbstones and other paving materials

  • Measuring, setting out and preparing work areas

  • Excavation and preparation of ground and sub-base

  • Levelling and compacting sub-base and sand

  • Cutting and adapting paving materials

  • Establishing and adjusting edges, levels and gradients

  • Minor landscaping and groundworks

  • Using hand tools and small construction machinery

  • General maintenance and cleaning of the work area

  • Following applicable health, safety and environmental regulations

The exact tasks may vary depending on the project and the employee's practical experience.

We are looking for someone who

  • Has a natural aptitude for practical and manual work

  • Is comfortable with physically demanding work

  • Works accurately and takes pride in the quality of their work

  • Can work independently based on instructions

  • Works well as part of a team

  • Is reliable, punctual and responsible

  • Is motivated to learn and develop practical skills

  • Preferably has previous experience in paving, landscaping, construction, groundworks, installation, renovation or other practical work

A formal vocational qualification is not required.

Relevant practical experience from construction, civil works, groundworks, installation, renovation, agriculture or other practical occupations is considered an advantage.

Language requirements

English is an advantage.

Danish is not required at the time of employment. However, the employee must be able to understand relevant work instructions and health and safety instructions sufficiently to perform the work safely.

Salary and employment conditions

The fixed and guaranteed salary is:

DKK 37,500 gross per month for 37 hours of work per week.

In addition, the employer provides an occupational pension in accordance with the applicable employment terms.

The fixed cash salary corresponds to your qualifications

The salary is fixed and guaranteed and is not dependent on bonuses, commissions or overtime.

Employment conditions, including working hours, pension, holiday entitlement, overtime and notice periods, will be specified in the employment contract and will comply with applicable Danish legislation and customary Danish employment conditions for the position.

Occupation / DISCO-08

DISCO-08: 711220 – Paving Work

The position specifically involves paving and surfacing work, including the preparation, installation and finishing of paved surfaces.

What we offer

  • Permanent full-time employment in Denmark

  • 37-hour working week

  • Fixed salary matched to your qualifications

  • Training and introduction to the company's working methods

  • Varied projects within paving and landscaping construction

  • A professional working environment

  • Opportunity to develop practical and manual skills

How to apply

Please send your CV and a short description of your previous work experience.

You do not need to have a formal vocational qualification.

Instead, please describe the practical work you have previously performed, the tools or machinery you have experience using, and the types of tasks you are accustomed to carrying out.

Candidates will be assessed based on their practical experience, aptitude for manual work, motivation, reliability and ability to learn.

This is a genuine full-time position in Denmark and the vacancy will be advertised through Jobnet and EURES.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer! Build production software – and raise the engineering bar around you
jobs.description:
If your definition of seniority is more than simply having written code for many years, this could be interesting.

Cubris develops software that helps rail operators run smarter, safer and more sustainable railway services.

As part of Hitachi Rail, we are now strengthening our engineering organisation and developing Cubris into a high-performing technology competence centre around our GreenSpeed® platform.

We are therefore looking for a Senior Software Engineer who combines strong hands-on development skills with technical ownership.

This is not a role where you receive a Jira ticket, implement it and move on.

You will take ownership of delivery within a product area – from understanding requirements and making implementation decisions to coordinating development, identifying risks and getting robust software into production.

What you will do

You will:

  • Design, develop and ship production-grade software

  • Translate requirements into clear technical tasks and solutions

  • Take ownership of technical execution within a product area

  • Coordinate development across multiple engineers when required

  • Identify dependencies, blockers and technical risks before they affect delivery

  • Challenge unclear requirements constructively

  • Participate actively in design discussions and technical reviews

  • Design and document architecture at component level

  • Develop and maintain release pipelines

  • Work closely with Product and Quality Engineering

  • Support colleagues through technical sparring, reviews and coaching

  • Improve code quality, testability, maintainability and delivery practices

The role is deliberately broader than coding alone. Cubris expects senior engineers to take responsibility for outcomes, not just assigned tasks.

What you bring

We are looking for substantial software engineering experience and a strong track record of taking software from requirements into production.

Your technical foundation should include:

  • Strong C#/.NET experience

  • Docker/container experience

  • Azure DevOps Cloud

  • Solid software design fundamentals

  • Testing and code-quality practices

  • CI/CD and modern delivery workflows

  • Debugging and performance thinking

  • Database and data-access experience

Experience with .NET MAUI, Blazor, Android/device-based UI or embedded UI solutions is relevant for parts of the GreenSpeed® environment and would be an advantage.

But technical skills alone are not enough.

You should also be comfortable creating momentum when requirements are ambiguous, making sound engineering decisions and helping other developers become better. The formal role description specifically calls for experience leading technical initiatives without necessarily having formal people-management responsibility.

Why Cubris?

You join at a point where your experience can make a visible difference.

You will work close to Product, Quality Engineering and experienced technical colleagues while helping define the standards, tools and engineering practices of the organisation Cubris is becoming.

You get:

  • A technically meaningful product

  • Direct influence on engineering decisions

  • A focused Danish technology environment

  • International reach through Hitachi Rail

  • The opportunity to help build the engineering culture rather than simply become part of an established one

Location: Ballerup, Denmark
Company: Cubris – a Hitachi Rail company

Interested?

Reach out for an informal and confidential conversation.

Please note that work permit needs to be in place before applying and that there is no relocation package included. You must be able to commute to the office in Ballerup every work day.

jobs.title: Tech Lead! 50% Lead Developer. 50% Software Architect. 100% technical leadership.
jobs.description:
Are you the engineer people turn to when the code is difficult, the architecture matters and the team needs a technical direction?

Cubris is strengthening its engineering organisation around GreenSpeed® as part of our ambition to build a high-performing technology competence centre for intelligent railway solutions within Hitachi Rail.

We are looking for a Tech Lead who combines deep hands-on software engineering with architectural judgement.

This is deliberately not a traditional management role.

You will spend approximately 50% of your time as a Lead Developer and 50% as a Software Architect – building production software, solving difficult engineering problems and coaching developers while also representing your team in the Architecture Group and translating architectural direction into practical solutions.

Your role as Lead Developer

You will:

  • Write and ship production code

  • Take ownership of technically complex stories

  • Unblock other engineers when problems become difficult

  • Coach developers through pairing, design discussions and high-quality PR reviews

  • Raise standards for automated testing and CI/CD

  • Improve pipeline reliability and engineering effectiveness

  • Strengthen observability through logs, metrics and traces

  • Drive systematic reduction of technical debt

  • Establish useful patterns, runbooks and reference implementations

In other words: you are expected to remain technically credible because you are still doing the work.

Your role as Software Architect

At the same time, you will:

  • Represent your team in Cubris’ Architecture Group

  • Translate architectural decisions and ADRs into practical team standards

  • Define service boundaries, APIs, events and data contracts

  • Establish and verify non-functional requirements around security, reliability, performance and cost

  • Lead technical migrations and integrations

  • Manage architectural dependencies and compatibility

  • Maintain architectural documentation, roadmaps and decision records

You become the technical bridge between Product, Engineering and Architecture.

What you bring

We expect you to have:

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience

  • Experience leading technical initiatives or engineering teams

  • Strong C#/.NET expertise

  • Experience designing distributed systems and/or microservices

  • Good SQL/NoSQL fundamentals

  • Experience with APIs, domain modelling and event-driven architectures

  • Strong understanding of CI/CD and modern software delivery

  • Experience with cloud technologies, containers and orchestration

  • An engineering mindset around reliability, observability, security and performance

  • The ability to mentor developers and communicate technical decisions clearly

Avoncourt Packaging Ltd is seeking a Junior Thermoforming Process Technician to join our manufacturing team. This is a technical manufacturing position suitable for a candidate with a qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Manufacturing Engineering or a related technical discipline. The successful candidate will work alongside experienced technical, engineering and production personnel and will receive practical training in thermoforming equipment, process control, machine setup, troubleshooting and manufacturing systems. Support preventative and routine maintenance activities on manufacturing equipment. Learn and assist with tooling and mould changes and associated machine setup. Read and interpret engineering drawings, machine documentation, technical specifications and production requirements. Assist with troubleshooting and monitoring automated and PLC-controlled manufacturing equipment. Carry out technical quality-control checks and assist with identifying the root causes of manufacturing defects. Record relevant machine settings, process parameters, technical interventions and production information. Assist engineering and technical personnel with machine modifications and continuous-improvement projects. Support initiatives aimed at reducing machine downtime, manufacturing waste and production defects. Work closely with engineering, maintenance, quality and production personnel to maintain safe and efficient manufacturing operations. Comply with company quality, food-safety, environmental and health-and-safety procedures. Undertake technical training in thermoforming machinery, manufacturing processes and associated equipment. Requirements: A qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Manufacturing Engineering, Automation Engineering or another relevant technical/engineering discipline. Good mechanical and technical aptitude. Ability to understand and interpret technical drawings and equipment documentation. Understanding of mechanical systems and manufacturing equipment. Good problem-solving and analytical skills. Ability to work effectively as part of an engineering and manufacturing team. Good communication and organisational skills.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Platform Integrations (Monetization)
Chef- Zoku Copenhagen
jobs.description:
Are you a passionate chef with great cooking skills who loves to work in an open kitchen? Then keep reading.

Zoku provides a home for business travellers who want to live in a city for between a few days and a few months. We’re a new type of hotel offering a relaxed place to live, co-work and socialize – while wiring residents into the local scene. Join an international team of driven, proactive and fun-loving Zokus who all have one thing in common: a passion for connecting people across the globe.

TELL ME MORE

Life doesn’t become more social than through sharing food. That’s our founding food philosophy and it can be yours too. The food that comes out of our Living Kitchen is fresh, simple, honest, healthy and local. With short-end preparation times, simple ingredients and limited preparation steps, our assortment is incredibly intelligent and facilitates fast service.

As our new chef you'll be responsible for any food that comes out of our Living Kitchen. You'll plate beautiful dishes and at times make creative buffets that not only look good, but also taste amazing.

You’ll work closely together with our team of chefs, to develop menu offerings and forecast supply needs. You like to take on responsibility, thrive with independence in your work and function as a substitute for our chefs. 

WHAT MAKES OUR KITCHEN UNIQUE?

  • You won’t hide in the background. You'll get to work in an open kitchen environment with plenty of space and natural daylight.

  • You'll get the ultimate flexibility. You can come up with your own dishes and let your creativity run wild.

  • You can have good conversations with visitors. You’re the face of the kitchen and you'll get to directly chat with guests.

  • You get to be independent in your work. You like doing your own thing and can cook solo when you need to.

  • You can get to know the entire team. You'll be in close contact with our front of house and the entire Zoku team.

  • You can work in a unique kitchen setup. We’re not like your average kitchen (feel free to stop by our rooftop to see for yourself!).

  • You are encouraged to work with fresh and seasonal ingredients. We put a strong emphasis on incorporating vegetables into our dishes.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

  • A market conform salary package including pension and health insurance.

  • Cool benefits like an after-work drink, access to all community events, various discounts like 40% discount on F&B for you and 4 friends, plus Employee and Friends & Family rates in all Zoku Locations.  

  • A free night stay for you and your +1 in your first 3 months at your Zoku (dinner & breakfast) and a free night at any Zoku location for your birthday, including welcome drink & breakfast to experience Zoku as a true guest. 

  • No boring canteen!! Staff meals enjoyed from our Living Kitchen.

  • A personal budget unlocked after 1 year at Zoku to spend on extra days off, learning & development, extra cash or discounted vouchers. 

  • A fun, young, and international team to grow with. Plus, exciting training and events to celebrate every step of the journey!

  • A job at one of the 25 coolest hotels in the world, that feels like a second home and is purpose-driven.

WE LOVE PEOPLE WHO...

  • Show their creativity through their passion for food and never settle for less.

  • Can juggle many tasks at the same time while remaining cool headed and warm hearted.

  • Enjoy variety in their day and are happy to switch things up, whether that means breakfast, brunch, lunch buffets, a la carte dinners or cheffing up something special for our Meetings & Events.

  • Have experience in working independently and don't believe in traditional kitchen hierarchies.

  • Enjoy working in an open kitchen and love to chat up a storm with our residents.

  • Have experience in healthy homestyle cooking – vegetarian cooking skills are a plus.

  • Have provable knowledge of various cooking techniques.

A FEW MUST HAVES

  • You have a minimum of 1 year working experience in a kitchen or restaurant environment. 

  • You have experience with implementing the local HACCP guidelines (Hygiejnebevis).

  • You are fluent in English – Danish and other languages are a plus.

  • You are an EU resident or have a working and living permit valid for Denmark including a CPR.

  • You are fully flexible, as there won't be fixed working days / hours, including availability on some weekends. Shifts include AM, Mid-shifts, and PM.

  • You love to work as we'll need you Full Time (37 hours- 5 shifts weekly)

  • Available to start As Soon As Possible.

WHAT WE ARE PROUD OF 

Our fresh take on hospitality has been recognized around the world with plenty of press attention and design awards.

We’re also proudly B Corp certified at all four of our locations (Amsterdam, Copenhagen, Paris and Vienna), which means we hold ourselves to high standards when it comes to social and environmental impact, transparency and accountability.

WHAT IS ZOKU

Zoku is a new type of hotel that offers a place to live, co-work and socialize in Europe's most livable cities: Amsterdam, Vienna, Copenhagen & Paris. 

Designed for the new generation of travellers, Zoku is so much more than a long stay hotel. It is a place you can call your second home, even on your first visit. Zoku is a hive of private Lofts and rooftop Social Spaces, so travellers can stay connected and well rested as they live and work throughout Europe. Throw yourself into your work and play, and effortlessly discover one of our home cities.

jobs.title: Production Worker (Day/night)
jobs.description:
Would you like to help ensure a more sustainable future? Vestas is currently looking for unskilled workers with experience in production work. We are looking for someone who wants to help ensure quality and prioritize safety and well-being in the workplace.

Being hired as a production worker at Vestas is not just about experience, it's about motivation, curiosity, and interest in learning new things. Through thorough training and instruction, we will provide you with all the tools to become skilled at making wind turbines. The Nakskov factory produces blades for our offshore wind turbines; the factory is an epoxy workplace, so everyone must complete an epoxy course or have a certificate no older than 5 years.

This posting is for those who thrive on working 12-hour shifts, either day or night.

Responsibilities

  • Safety: At Vestas, safety is the first priority, which means you must prioritize your own and your colleagues' safety, both physically and mentally.
  • Quality: Our next priority is top-notch quality, so we expect you to take pride in producing a product that meets standards.
  • Production Plan: At Vestas, we also have some plans that need to be met to deliver on time. So, we expect an employee who is diligent and strives to meet deadlines without compromising safety or quality.

Qualifications

  • You are in good physical shape and accustomed to standing and walking throughout the workday.
  • It is advantageous if you have experience with 5S and Lean.
  • It is advantageous if you have experience with production work, but if you are willing to learn, we would like to hear from you.

Competencies

  • You are quality-conscious and focus on safety.
  • You contribute to creating a good atmosphere at work.
  • You don't mind changing tasks.
  • You have an interest in learning new things and are curious.

We Offer

A workplace with a focus on employees, their safety, and providing them with the tools to create quality in their work. We offer an attractive salary package with health insurance, dental insurance, and a canteen arrangement.

Additional Information

  • Workplace: Nakskov
  • Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis.
  • Reference check will occur after interviews. Please state in your application if you have a reference. 

Our commitment to a fair hiring.
 At Vestas, we evaluate all candidates solely based on their professional experience, education, and relevant skills. To support a fair recruitment process, we kindly ask that you remove any photos, dates of birth or graduation, gender pronouns, marital status, or other personal information not relevant to the role before submitting your CV/resume. Your CV/resume should focus on your professional and educational background, along with the necessary contact details (email and phone number). We train our hiring teams in inclusive evaluation and regularly review process outcomes to ensure fairness.

DEIB Statement
 At Vestas, we recognize the value of diversity, equity, and inclusion in driving innovation and success. We strongly encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply, particularly those who may hesitate due to their identity or feel they do not meet every criterion. As our CEO states, "Expertise and talent come in many forms, and a diverse workforce enhances our ability to think differently and solve the complex challenges of our industry". Your unique perspective is what will help us powering the solution for a sustainable, green energy future.

BEWARE – RECRUITMENT FRAUD
 It has come to our attention that there are a number of fraudulent emails from people pretending to work for Vestas. Read more via this link, https://www.vestas.com/en/careers/our-recruitment-process

About Vestas
 Vestas is the energy industry’s global partner on sustainable energy solutions. We are specialised in designing, manufacturing, installing, and servicing wind turbines, both onshore and offshore. Across the globe, we have installed more wind power than anyone else. We consider ourselves pioneers within the industry, as we continuously aim to design new solutions and technologies to create a more sustainable future for all of us. With more than 185 GW of wind power installed worldwide and 40+ years of experience in wind energy, we have an unmatched track record demonstrating our expertise within the field. With 30,000 employees globally, we are a diverse team united by a common goal: to power the solution – today, tomorrow, and far into the future. Vestas promotes a diverse workforce which embraces all social identities and is free of any discrimination. We commit to create and sustain an environment that acknowledges and harvests different experiences, skills, and perspectives. We also aim to give everyone equal access to opportunity. To learn more about our company and life at Vestas, we invite you to visit our website at www.vestas.com and follow us on our social media channels. We also encourage you to join our Talent Universe to receive notifications on new and relevant postings.

  • A positive working environment with great colleagues and a high level of commitment
